Equiti is a pioneering fintech firm and world\-class provider of multi\-asset fintech products \- from liquidity solutions to in\-house tech hubs to online trading platforms. With over 400 global specialists in 9 languages, Equiti provides clients with access to individual, professional, and institutional brokerage services in Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.
 



  





 At Equiti, we believe that financial opportunities can unlock potential for everyone, everywhere. We’re on a mission to deliver accessible online trading products around the world through education and accessibility.
 



  





 Think finance is stuffy? Think again.
 



  





 At Equiti, we’re building fintech with a purpose: making wealth tools accessible to everyone. As we continue to grow, we’re seeking talented individuals who thrive in innovative environments. , and we are on the lookout for talented individuals who can perform and excel in a dynamic and innovative working environment. Our Technology department would like to welcome a detail\-oriented.
 



  





**Head of Engineering Excellence** 
 in our office in Dubai.
 



  





 As the Head of Engineering Excellence, you will…
 



 Be the force that turns Equiti’s engineering principles into everyday practice. Reporting directly to the CTO, you will own the operating system of the technology organisation — the standards, processes, delivery cadence and metrics that keep a fast\-scaling, multi\-domain engineering org accountable, aligned and continuously improving. You will be the CTO’s trusted partner for execution: making sure the right things get done, by the right owners, to the right standard — without the CTO having to chase.
 



 You will define and enforce how the engineering org works — ways of working, communication and accountability standards, and delivery governance — and make performance visible through engineering KPIs and dashboards. You will lead a culture of Kaizen (continuous improvement), running the cadences and retrospectives that turn data and incidents into lasting improvements across mobile, web, backend, data, platform, QA and trading teams.
 



 You will also be Equiti’s engineering voice to the outside world — championing our work through blogs, talks and conferences, growing our presence in the developer community, and building the technical brand that draws great people to us.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Own and enforce Equiti’s engineering principles, standards and ways of working across all technology domains.
* Define, track and report engineering KPIs — delivery throughput and predictability, DORA metrics (deployment frequency, lead time, change\-failure rate, MTTR), responsiveness/SLA attainment and quality — and turn them into action.
* Run the engineering operating cadence: planning, delivery reviews, incident/postmortem reviews and the operations review that holds owners accountable to SLAs.
* Drive a culture of Kaizen / continuous improvement — facilitate retrospectives, identify systemic bottlenecks, and land process improvements that stick.
* Embed the communication \& accountability framework — ownership/RACI, triage lanes, escalation and channel standards — so nothing falls through the cracks.
* Govern cross\-team delivery for major programmes and product launches; surface risks and dependencies early and unblock them.
* Partner with domain leads to raise engineering maturity, consistency and governance — without slowing teams down.
* Act as the CTO’s go to on execution — translate strategy into tracked outcomes, prepare leadership and board\-ready updates, and ensure follow\-through on decisions.
* Champion engineering quality, change management and operational excellence in partnership with SRE / Engineering Platforms.
* Establish lightweight tooling and dashboards (within the ticketing and observability stack) that make standards and metrics self\-serve for every team.
* Lead Equiti’s external engineering evangelism — represent the technology org through conference talks, meetups and panels, and grow our standing in the wider engineering community.
* Own the Equiti engineering blog and technical thought leadership, and shape the engineering employer brand that helps attract and retain top talent.



  





**Experience Requirements** 



* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 10\+ years in software engineering, technical programme management, or engineering operations, with at least 5 years leading process or delivery excellence in scaled engineering organisations.
* Proven track record defining and enforcing engineering principles, ways of working and delivery governance across multiple teams.
* Deep fluency in engineering KPIs and metrics (DORA, delivery predictability, quality, reliability) and in building dashboards that change behaviour.
* Hands\-on experience leading continuous improvement / Kaizen, Agile, and incident/postmortem practices at scale.
* Strong technical credibility — able to hold weight with senior engineers and architects — without needing to be the deepest coder in the room.
* Exceptional influence and stakeholder management; able to enforce standards through trust and clarity, not authority alone.
* A confident public communicator — a track record of external technical writing, conference speaking, or developer\-community engagement (engineering blogs, talks, open source).
* Experience operating as a trusted partner to a CTO or VP of Engineering (programme leadership / execution\-focused role) strongly preferred.
* Experience in fintech, brokerage, or regulated industries preferred.
* Based in, or willing to relocate to, Dubai.



  





  





**Perks** 




  





 Each of our offices has its special perks; be it ‘no ties’, free lunches, charity events, or a hybrid work policy – but whenever you walk into an Equiti office, you’re sure to see a friendly face. We encourage international collaborations and always keep our eyes open to how we can do more.
 



 The benefits you can expect at your Equiti workplace include:
 


* Competitive salary package
* Performance\-based bonus
* Medical insurance coverage for employees and family members
* Smart working options
* Employee wellness initiatives
* Personalized career development
* Company lunch in the office
* Regular company events



  





 With energy, drive, and imagination, there’s no limit to where your career can go at Equiti. With a diverse workforce and geographical spread of offices, we strongly support career development initiatives as well as provide a range of opportunities for professional and life experiences.
 



  





 Equiti is an equal opportunity employer.
 



  





 “Equiti” refers to a group of companies consisting of seven regulated financial services companies licensed to operate in the respective jurisdictions of their incorporation, in addition to our tech and marketing hubs. Equiti has presence in Africa, Europe, and the Middle East.

data.jd_text:
I am currently looking for an experienced
 **Project Director** 
 to lead the successful delivery of several High\-Rise projects across Dubai. This is a senior leadership position suited to an individual with a proven background in delivery of High\-Rise buildings from construction stage through to successful handover.
 



  





 The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing all site activities, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and to the highest standards of quality. You will act as a key point of contact between clients, consultants, and project teams while providing strategic leadership throughout the project lifecycle.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Lead the delivery of complex, large\-scale construction projects, overseeing all site operations from mobilisation through to completion and handover.
* Manage project teams, contractors, subcontractors, and consultants to ensure successful project execution.
* Develop and implement project strategies, programmes, schedules, and delivery plans aligned with client expectations and contractual requirements.
* Monitor project budgets, commercial performance, resource allocation, and overall project progress.
* Oversee contract administration, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations, variations, claims, and project requirements.
* Identify potential project risks and implement effective mitigation strategies to protect programme, cost, and quality objectives.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, stakeholders, authorities, and project partners.
* Lead coordination between design, commercial, construction, and technical teams to ensure efficient project delivery.
* Ensure compliance with Dubai construction regulations, authority requirements, health \& safety standards, and quality procedures.
* Drive best practices across project delivery, improving processes, efficiency, and overall project performance.
* Provide clear reporting and project updates to senior leadership and key stakeholders.
* Mentor and develop project teams, creating a high\-performance and collaborative working environment.



  





**Requirements:** 



* Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
* PMP certification or equivalent project management qualification is preferred.
* Minimum 18 years’ experience within construction, project management, or supervision, with a strong track record delivering major developments.
* Previous experience operating as a Project Director or Senior Project Manager on High\-Rise projects is a Must.
* Strong Middle East experience is essential, with proven knowledge of the Dubai construction market.
* Strong understanding of construction methodologies, project controls, planning, cost management, and risk mitigation.
* Ability to manage large multidisciplinary teams.
* Excellent client\-facing skills with experience dealing directly with developers, consultants, subcontractors, and government authorities.
* Strong leadership, communication, and decision\-making abilities.



  





 This is an excellent opportunity for an established Project Director to play a key role in delivering high\-rise developments in Dubai.

data.jd_text:
As the General Manager \& Pre\-Opening Operations Lead, you will lead the successful pre\-opening, launch, and operation of Earth Jumeirah Beach while supporting the operational development, future pre\-openings, and ongoing evolution of the Earth Hotels portfolio.
   

  

 This role combines hands\-on hotel leadership with strategic pre\-opening support, helping shape the operating standards, guest experience, service philosophy, and opening frameworks that will support future Earth Hotels properties.
   

  

 You will work closely with the Co\-Founders to build not only an exceptional hotel, but a scalable operating model that can be replicated across future openings.
   

  

**What on Earth Will You Do?**
* Assume full responsibility for the day\-to\-day leadership, management, and performance of Earth Jumeirah Beach.
* Lead the successful pre\-opening, launch, and stabilization of the property, ensuring operational readiness across all departments.
* Oversee all operational functions including Rooms, Food \& Beverage, Engineering, Security, Finance, and Citizen \& Culture.
* Recruit, develop, and inspire a high\-performing leadership team aligned with Earth Hotels' values and service philosophy.
* Deliver agreed financial objectives through effective budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and commercial decision\-making.
* Drive guest satisfaction and brand advocacy by ensuring consistently exceptional guest experiences.
* Maintain a strong presence within the hotel and serve as the face of the property to guests, partners, owners, and the local community.
* Ensure full compliance with all statutory, licensing, health, safety, and regulatory requirements.
* Lead Executive Committee meetings and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Partner closely with Revenue, Sales \& Marketing, and Finance teams to maximize performance and achieve business targets.
* Develop a high\-performing leadership team capable of sustaining operational excellence as the business and portfolio continue to grow.
* Review, define, and continuously improve brand standards, SOPs, and service philosophy in collaboration with Brand, Design, and Commercial teams.
* Develop operational playbooks and KPIs across Rooms, F\&B, Engineering, Front Office, Housekeeping, Sales \& Events.
* Ensure brand standards are embedded into daily operations and consistently upheld.
* Leverage operational data and analytics to drive commercial and strategic decisions.
* Participate in ongoing strategic reviews with the Managing Partner and executive leadership.
* Own the end\-to\-end operational opening program including timelines, RACI structures, milestone tracking, and readiness checklists.
* Oversee core operational deliverables: OS\&E, kitchen commissioning, systems integrations (PMS/POS), inventory planning, and compliance documentation.
* Support recruitment and onboarding of opening teams; validate readiness before launch.
* Plan and execute mock services, soft openings, and final readiness assessments; provide go/no\-go recommendations.
* Coordinate with project teams, authorities, and consultants to secure operational approvals and licenses.
* Support recruitment and onboarding of property leadership teams with focus on operational capability and culture alignment.
* Develop structured training programs including leadership bootcamps and SOP certifications.
* Establish operational rituals and accountability systems that drive performance and retention.
* Partner with Citizen \& Culture team on compliance, workforce planning, and performance management frameworks.
* Act as primary operations liaison with Development, Design, Procurement, F\&B Concept, Revenue, Marketing, and Finance.
* Lead cross\-functional workshops translating design and concept into executable operating procedures.
* Represent Operations in executive steering committees, owner discussions, and investor engagements, providing clear updates on performance, operational priorities, risks, and strategic initiatives.
* Communicate operational risks, mitigation strategies, and performance updates clearly and proactively.
* Lead system implementation and validation across PMS, POS, CRS, HRIS, EMS, and inventory platforms.
* Ensure system integrations are operationally ready before opening.
* Manage brand\-level vendor relationships and SLAs for outsourced services.
* Validate vendor performance and contract compliance across properties.
* Establish structured guest recovery frameworks and CRM feedback loops.
* Monitor online reputation and guest sentiment during opening and stabilization phases.
* Implement rapid corrective plans to protect brand positioning and service standards.
* Support the planning, operational readiness, and successful delivery of future Earth Hotels pre\-openings, working alongside project and property teams from concept through opening.
* Travel to future Earth Hotels projects as required to support pre\-opening activities, operational readiness, hotel openings, and post\-opening stabilization.
* Support the Co\-Founders in shaping the operational foundations and pre\-opening strategy of the Earth Hotels brand.
* Contribute to the development and refinement of brand standards, SOPs, service rituals, and operational playbooks for future properties.
* Share learnings and best practices from the opening and operation of Earth Jumeirah Beach to support future openings.
* Lead or support feasibility reviews, operational planning, and pre\-opening strategies for future Earth Hotels projects.
* Provide operational leadership, coaching, and opening support to future General Managers and hotel leadership teams.
* Collaborate with Development, Design, Procurement, and Brand teams to ensure concepts are translated into executable operating models.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, consistency, and scalability across the growing portfolio.
* Support the establishment of operational KPIs, reporting frameworks, and quality assurance processes for future expansion.
* Represent Operations in strategic discussions relating to the growth and evolution of the Earth Hotels portfolio.
* Undertake additional operational projects and responsibilities as assigned by the Co\-Founders in line with the business's stage of development.
* Ensure all property safety, health, and service regulations are followed consistently.
* Maintain a clean, safe, and welcoming environment in operational and site visits.
* Remain flexible and adaptable, stepping in wherever needed to support portfolio success.
* Perform additional duties as assigned by management.


**Deliverables**
* Successful opening and operational stabilization of Earth Jumeirah Beach.
* Achievement of agreed financial, guest satisfaction, and operational performance targets.
* Development of a high\-performing and engaged leadership team.
* Strong online reputation and effective guest recovery processes.
* Full operational readiness, compliance, and execution across all hotel functions.
* Operational playbooks, SOP libraries, and training frameworks supporting future growth.
* Opening readiness documentation and post\-opening improvement plans.
* Scalable operational standards and frameworks to support future Earth Hotels openings.
* Successful support of future Earth Hotels pre\-openings, operational readiness, and opening programmes.

The Apex Group was established in Bermuda in 2003 and is now one of the world’s largest fund administration and middle office solutions providers.
   

  

 Our business is unique in its ability to reach globally, service locally and provide cross\-jurisdictional services. With our clients at the heart of everything we do, our hard\-working team has successfully delivered on an unprecedented growth and transformation journey, and we are now represented by over circa 13,000 employees across 112 offices worldwide.Your career with us should reflect your energy and passion.
   

  

 That’s why, at Apex Group, we will do more than simply ‘empower’ you. We will work to supercharge your unique skills and experience.
   

  

 Take the lead and we’ll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game. And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry\-changing realities.
   

  

 For our business, for clients, and for you
   

  

**REGIONAL HEAD OF OPERATIONS – CLOSE ENDED (MIDDLE EAST)**
**Location: UAE**
**About Apex:**
 The Apex Group is a global financial services provider with over 13,000 employees across 85 offices globally. We look to recruit bright, articulate, and numerate employees who are not afraid of a challenge and are prepared to work hard and love what they do.
   

  

 Every employee plays a part in making Apex who we are today and the more we grow, the more important that becomes. Whatever your career path or specialism, Apex provides a global platform to allow you to thrive.
   

  

**The role:**
 Apex Group has created a regionalised operational organisation structure, divided into sub\-product segments, that enables Apex to sustain service delivery levels of the highest standards and maximize productivity and efficiencies.
   

  

 In this position you will be responsible for the end\-to\-end operational performance of the closed\-ended funds business in the different countries within the Middle East region, reporting to the Regional head of Fund Solutions – MEAIM.
   

  

 You should have extensive experience in the administration of close\-ended funds. You should have a proven track record of demonstrating your knowledge of fund accounting and a proven track record in leading multi\-jurisdictional operational platforms.. The role requires a strong combination of operational leadership, client delivery excellence, commercial awareness and transformation capability.
   

  

**Technical Tasks:**
* Oversee and lead the end\-to\-end delivery of the fund accounting service for close\-ended funds, ensuring accuracy and compliance with fund governing documents and regulatory guidance.
* Provide leadership on complex client and operational matters requiring senior judgment.
* Ensure full adherence to the prevailing control environment.
* Be a leading participant in the continuous development of our operating processes and procedures.
* Be an escalation point for technical queries from all stakeholders in your region.
* Oversee the timely completion of all audits.
* Ensure local teams’ adherence to regulatory compliance and underlying reporting.


**Tasks/Responsibilities:**
* Translate strategy into an operational plan for delivery of service and provide guidance to ensure consistent organisational leadership and day\-to\-day business running.
* Ensure effective implementation of the operating model with ownership for both onshore and offshore components, work closely with other regional functional leads across operations and wider CRM and Product teams.
* Implement agreed best practices while striving for continuous improvement.
* Develop and foster client relationships and ensure we exceed their expectations and are their provider of choice.
* Team collaboration across multiple jurisdictions globally including global operations centres and ensure that client deliverables are being met.
* Monitoring of actual versus target hours per fund/client and action as required. Ensure there is a continuous drive to improve our efficiency.
* Contribute to the achievement of regional financial and operational performance targets.
* Ensure effective \& timely resolutions to any errors identified.
* KPI’s to be consistently above the specified target for each team in your region (accuracy, timeliness, and delivery)
* Team capacity planning and full awareness of incoming pipeline, including ownership of hire requests.
* People management with a focus on development, motivation, and succession planning/talent management.
* Identify training needs within your teams in the region and interact with our training department.
* Manage employee performance and salary review process.
* Partner with the relevant Country Head, HR lead and senior leadership team to implement effective strategies for employee engagement and retention.
* Ensure adherence to all internal and external audit standards.
* Ensure stakeholder awareness, engagement, and support through effective and timely communication.
* Actively support Groups strategy, plans, and values, contributing to the achievement of a high\-performance culture.
* Demonstrate visible leadership and promote collaboration and accountability across the multi\-jurisdictional teams.
* Develop, maintain and role model a culture that is open to change and innovation, and supports collaboration, respect, and accountability.
* Maintain knowledge of industry trends.


**Skills Required:**
* Bachelor or Master level degree.
* Strong accountancy knowledge, a professional designation such as CA, CPAA, or ACCA etc., would be an asset.
* Solid experience working with private markets / closed\-ended fund structures across multiple jurisdictions.
* Extensive practical experience, 15\+ years of fund accounting work experience.
* Experience managing a large team / managing regional or multi\-location teams.
* Extensive experience working with external clients and an ability to inspire confidence.
* Excellent communication skills and proficiency in English (both verbal and written).
* Motivated, bright, and diligent individual who is driven to meet deadlines \& targets.
* Attention to detail and ability to work on multiple projects.
* A team player who is genuinely motivated by improving our service and teams.
* An ability to think critically and objectively while having strong organizational and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to resolve complex issues in a timely manner.
* Advanced level MS Excel, proficient with MS Word, MS PowerPoint.
* A detailed understanding of the various fund types covered by this role (Private Equity, Real Estate, Credit \& Venture Capital).


**What you will get in return:**
* A unique opportunity to be part of an expanding large global business and to lead teams across different locations.
* A friendly, co\-operative, and supportive environment.
* Exposure to many different fund types and a wide variety of clients.
* An opportunity to make an impact in a leading product for Apex.
* Training and development opportunities.


**Disclaimer:** 
 Unsolicited CVs sent to Apex (Talent Acquisition Team or Hiring Managers) by recruitment agencies will not be accepted for this position. Apex operates a direct sourcing model and where agency assistance is required, the Talent Acquisition team will engage directly with our exclusive recruitment partners.

**Job Purpose**
 At Emirates IT, we are dedicated to staying ahead of the curve by embracing the latest technologies and strategies to streamline integration processes and enhance infrastructure efficiency. As a valued member of our team, you will play a pivotal role in managing and optimizing our integration landscape, ensuring smooth data flow and system interoperability across our enterprise platforms. If you are passionate about creating seamless integration solutions and driving technological excellence, we invite you to apply and to contribute to the success of Emirates Group.
   

  

 Join our
 **Agile Delivery** 
 team on a mission to create technology solutions that enhance customer experience and drive revenue growth. We focus on leveraging agile methodologies to deliver innovative and secure technology quickly and efficiently. If you are passionate about delivering value, embracing agility, and leading projects in a dynamic environment, we invite you to apply and become a key player in our journey to drive success at the Emirates Group.
   

  

 The
 **Agile Delivery Manager** 
 is responsible for planning, leading, organising and motivating scrum teams, either within a Release Train or outside, to achieve a high level of performance and quality in the delivery of outputs that provide exceptional value to end users and customers. The Agile Delivery Manager may be responsible for managing several concurrent high visibility initiatives using agile/hybrid methods, in a fast paced environment that may involve multiple business units.
   

  

**In This Role You Will**
* Facilitate key ceremonies such as PI planning and Review, and play a consultative role to help put in place the appropriate people, process, and tools supporting the Agile framework and coaching members of the team as needed to optimize the efficiency of the Release Train team.
* Act as a Champion in blending traditional project management principles and practices with an Agile development approach in the right proportions to fit initiatives of all sizes with the appropriate level of planning and provide the right balance of agility and predictability based on PMI\-ACP principles.
* Build a trusting and safe environment where problems can be raised without fear of blame or retribution, with an emphasis on healing and problem\-solving. Protect and provide all support to the team/s using a servant leadership style whenever possible and lead by example. Facilitate getting the work done practicing servant leadership and encourage discussion, decision making and conflict resolution.

data.jd_text:
**Summary** 




 The Programme Manager will lead the design, development, and execution of Pearl Initiative’s (PI) Governance in Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) Programme. This role will build Pearl Initiative’s thought leadership and impact in strengthening and enabling the MSMEs sector in the GCC region. Programming will especially focus on building the long\-term success and resilience of MSMEs, especially in supply chains, by advancing corporate governance, ethical, strategic, and accountable decision\-making; transparency and disclosure; and innovation. They will lead the business development, revenue generation, and fundraising initiatives of the programme, ensuring high\-impact and compliant delivery of all projects and contracts.
 



  





 Success in this role requires a strategic, detail\-oriented, and relationship\-driven leader who can design and implement high\-impact programming. This includes managing a strategic regional working group, delivering targeted interventions and projects, producing research and thought leadership that address the evolving needs of the sector, and hosting convenings and dedicated trainings.
 



  





  





**Key responsibilities** 




  





**Programmatic development and innovation** 




  





 • Lead the design, development, and execution of the governance in MSMEs programme, ensuring alignment with organisational goals and strategic objectives.
 



 • Continuously innovate and enhance the programme offering, identifying opportunities for improvement and greater impact in MSME governance.
 



 • Develop and implement programme strategies that address emerging trends and challenges faced by MSMEs, ensuring relevance and long\-term sustainability.
 



 • Collaborate with subject matter experts, external consultants, and partners to co\-create high\-quality programme content and deliverables.
 



 • Identify synergies between the programme and other organisational initiatives to drive greater impact across multiple business sectors.
 



 • Co\-create a strategic communications strategy, including priority social media channels and email campaigning, for the programme.
 



  





**Business development, community enablement, and financial sustainability** 




  





 • Develop and execute a business development and market stakeholders engagement strategy by identifying key target markets, potential funding sources, and partnership opportunities.
 



 • Manage an annual market engagement calendar.
 



 • Co\-define funding targets to cover programmatic costs and work towards reserving longer\-term working capital to ensure the financial sustainability of the programme.
 



 • Explore and develop new revenue streams for the programme to diversify funding and enhance financial sustainability.
 



 • Develop and lead community\-building initiatives, such as workshops, convenings, online forums, and networking events, to facilitate knowledge sharing, collaboration, and relationship development.
 



 • Represent the organisation by actively participating in relevant events, building new relationships with potential partners and collaborators, and promoting the organisation's programmes.
 



 • Lead the development of compelling proposals that effectively communicate the value proposition of programmes to potential funders and partners, highlighting impact, sustainability, and strategic alignment with their objectives.
 



 • Negotiate and finalise funding agreements and partnership contracts.
 



  





**Projects management and contracts compliance** 




  





 • Manage the design, execution, and timely high\-quality delivery of collaborative needs\-based projects and flagship initiatives, focused on research, executive education, capacity\-building, and convenings.
 



 • Adopt best practices in project management across all projects and initiatives, defining clear project scopes, developing detailed project plans, assigning roles and responsibilities, and implementing robust tracking and reporting.
 



 • Manage programme teams and insourced third parties to ensure high accountability, strong performance, and preemptive risk management.
 



 • Oversee the successful execution and delivery of all projects in line with contractual obligations, project timelines, and quality standards.
 



 • Run projects and initiatives with careful cost control and resource allocation to support efforts to achieve financial sustainability with long\-term working capital.
 



 • Proactively communicate project and initiative updates to clients, partners, and internal stakeholders with timely reports on progress, challenges, and successes.
 



  





**Expertise development and thought leadership** 




  





 • Identify, study, and learn from market needs and pain points through research and stakeholder engagement to identify strategic opportunities for impact and growth.
 



 • Lead the development of market\-driven solutions by translating identified market needs and pain points into actionable programme initiatives.
 



 • Curate and convene the programme’s working group, bringing in together working group members and special guests.
 



 • Monitor the market’s offering, notable trends, and any disruptions to consistently strategically position the programme.
 



 • Produce a consistent pipeline of high\-quality, original bi\-lingual content (e.g., op\-eds, articles, blog posts, white papers, research reports, and working group position papers) that showcases expertise and generates meaningful conversations within the industry.
 



 • Build a strong online presence by actively engaging in priority social media channels (e.g., LinkedIn, Twitter, industry\-specific forums) to share content, participate in discussions, and network with other thought leaders.
 



 • Cultivate relationships with journalists, analysts, and other industry influencers to amplify thought leadership and reach a wider audience.
 



  





**Team mentorship and development** 




 • Lead, mentor, and develop the programme team members, ensuring ongoing professional growth and skill development.
 



 • Provide regular performance feedback and create growth opportunities for team members, including guidance on career development and training needs.
 



 • Foster an inclusive, collaborative work environment that encourages creativity, continuous learning, and innovation.
 



 • Encourage cross\-team collaboration and facilitate professional development opportunities to enhance team effectiveness and cohesion.
 



 Impact measurement and reporting
 



 • Co\-define quarterly and yearly key impact metrics and engagement KPIs for the programme, ensuring milestones are achievable and validated with feasibility assessments.
 



 • Develop surveys and feedback forms for programmatic impact and performance based on impact strategy, methodology, and templates.
 



 • Coordinate data collection of surveys and feedback forms for programmatic impact and performance.
 



 • Analyse data of surveys and feedback forms to study and learn from achieved and non\-achieved programmatic impact and performance, based on key impact metrics and engagement KPIs identified in impact strategy.
 



 • Develop an impact baseline assessment for the programme to measure progress towards meeting key market needs and addressing critical market gaps.
 



 • Recommend and implement programmatic improvements, expansions, and other strategic directions from data and insights.
 



 • Prepare impact reports and communicate findings on key impact metrics and engagement KPIs at key programme and project milestones.
 



 • Curate, co\-author, and publish programme specific sections for the annual report.
 



 Tech\-enabled skills development
 



 • Proficiently use tools and technology solutions to strengthen team productivity, project management, business development, and research through continuous learning and training.
 



 • Attend expert\-led or executive training workshops relevant for programme development, project management, impact management, storytelling and writing.
 



 • Attend expert\-led or executive training workshops relevant for programme and related special topics.
 



  





**Qualifications and experience** 




 • A master’s degree in a relevant field such as Business Administration and / or a related discipline, with proven expertise and strong analytical skills.
 



 • Additional certifications in project management, corporate governance, impact measurement, small medium enterprise operations are highly desirable.
 



 • At least 7 years of relevant experience in managing, coordinating, and executing programmes, academic institutions, think tanks, research centers, member\-based networks/councils, or non\-profit organisations.
 



 • Work experience with MSMEs, entrepreneurial ventures and / or start\-ups is highly desirable, with a deep understanding of governance and impact frameworks, regulatory compliance, and sustainability practices.
 



 • Demonstrated experience leading in business development, revenue generation, and / or fundraising for programmes, projects, and / or initiatives.
 



 • Demonstrated ability to deliver programmes independently while managing and building relationships with multiple senior market stakeholders, partners, and vendors.
 



 • Expertise in research, impact analysis, impact\-driven programme development, and curriculum design is highly desirable.
 



 • Strong verbal and written communication skills, and a portfolio of published writings is highly desirable.
 



 • Fluency in English is required.
 



 • Fluency in Arabic is required.
 



  





**Personal attributes** 




 • Self\-initiator and self\-learner
 



 • Emotional and social intelligence
 



 • Strategic and solutions\-driven
 



 • Passionate about subject area
 



 • Hardworking and meticulous
 



 • Natural leader and team manager
 



 • Collaborative and adaptive
 



 • Open and transparent communicator
 



 • Purposeful and driven by impact
 



 • Strong work ethic embodying good governance and integrity

data.raw_snippet:

 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective
data.jd_text:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision\-making through our leading AI\-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.
 



 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.
 



 Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies who rely on our best\-in\-class platform.
 



 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
 
 our wins – big and small.
 



 Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next \- together!
 



 We are seeking a highly driven self\-starter with exceptional program\-level delivery experience to join Anaplan in UAE. This is a rare, high\-impact opportunity to lay the groundwork and shape the success of our most strategic enterprise customers across the Middle East.
 



 At Anaplan, we are redefining how businesses plan and make decisions through our cutting\-edge Connected Planning platform, powered by our unique deterministic calculation engine and advanced AI capabilities. In this role, you will be at the forefront of this transformation.
 



 You will bring a proven track record of leading complex, high\-stakes implementations—ideally within Supply Chain, Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A), or Workforce Planning. Thriving at the intersection of delivery and strategic advisory, you will scope, negotiate, manage escalations, and serve as an indispensable partner to both customer and internal stakeholders. From C\-level executives to daily end\-users, you will excel at influencing decisions and cementing your status as a trusted advisor.
 



 This is a hands\-on leadership position tailor\-made for a delivery expert who can seamlessly orchestrate multiple enterprise programs, ensure strict adherence to budget and scope, and expertly pivot to recover projects that have drifted off track.
 



**Your Impact (What You’ll Do)** 



* **Drive Delivery Excellence:** 
 Lead end\-to\-end Anaplan deployments alongside internal teams and external partners, establishing robust governance, ensuring precise scoping, and proactively uncovering hidden assumptions.
* **Be the Strategic Anchor:** 
 Serve as the primary point of contact for delivery, building alignment with customer stakeholders ranging from operational leads up to the C\-suite.
* **Master Complex Programs:** 
 Navigate intricate, multi\-faceted programs, ensuring flawless delivery while expertly balancing scope, risk, budget, and resourcing.
* **Accelerate Decision\-Making:** 
 Anticipate bottlenecks and drive critical project decisions across design, testing, timelines, and organizational change management.
* **Build Consensus:** 
 Leverage top\-tier negotiation skills to resolve conflicts, maintain project momentum, and unite diverse teams behind a shared goal.
* **Champion Excellence:** 
 Advocate for and implement the "Anaplan Way" methodology, ensuring the delivery of scalable, highly intuitive, and user\-friendly solutions.
* **Deliver Transparency:** 
 Provide clear, actionable reporting on project status and overall portfolio health to both internal leadership and external stakeholders.



**Your DNA (What You Bring)** 



* **Enterprise Expertise:** 
 Demonstrable history of exemplary program or project management across complex, large\-scale enterprise initiatives.
* **Agile Mastery:** 
 Deep, hands\-on experience in Agile project delivery methodologies—this is essential for driving our fast\-paced implementations.
* **Turnaround Architect:** 
 Proven ability to recover and realign complex projects led by partners or vendors. We are looking for a track record of delivering—and rescuing—large\-scale projects under tight timelines and budgets.
* **Executive Influence:** 
 Exceptional customer engagement and communication skills, characterized by the ability to negotiate, influence senior leadership, and confidently act as a trusted strategic advisor.
* **Domain Knowledge (Bonus):** 
 While not strictly essential, domain expertise in Supply Chain, FP\&A, or Workforce Planning will highly differentiate your application.
* **A Fluent Arabic Speaker** 
 required for this role.



**Why Join Us?** 
 As the first Principal Solution Implementation Manager in the region, you won't just be managing projects; you will be building a legacy. You'll work with industry\-defining AI and planning technology, partner with the world's leading brands, and have a tangible impact on how global enterprises operate.
 



**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)** 




 We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!
 



 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  
 



**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer** 
  
 



 It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.
 



 Anaplan does not:  
 


* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.



 All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

**Your mission**
 We are seeking an experienced and forward\-thinking Project Director to lead the delivery of some of the most ambitious and innovative Spatial Experience projects in the region and beyond. This is not a traditional project management role \- it is a senior leadership position for someone who can drive complex turnkey projects with confidence, precision, and commercial clarity.
   

  

 You will take ownership of a portfolio of high\-profile international projects across museums, visitor attractions, cultural destinations, and large\-scale experiential installations. From tender strategy and planning through execution and close\-out, you will shape delivery standards, elevate performance, and ensure exceptional outcomes for both clients and stakeholders.
   

  

 Operational excellence is essential, but what sets this role apart is leadership. We are looking for a strategic decision\-maker and delivery\-driven leader who can build strong teams, manage complexity at scale, and consistently raise the bar in a fast\-paced, high\-expectation environment.
   

  

 Key responsibilities will include:
   

  

* Lead a portfolio of complex international projects from tender stage through planning, execution, delivery, and close\-out, ensuring full project organization and control.
* Oversee the development of the master project schedule and ensure effective implementation across all phases.
* Monitor project performance with a strong focus on quality, deadlines, and cost control.
* Conduct project reviews and produce detailed reporting for internal and external stakeholders.
* Lead and manage multiple projects simultaneously, from pre\-construction through completion.
* Ensure strict adherence to ethics, compliance, and internal governance requirements at all times.
* Actively participate in the tender process, including design coordination, submission preparation, and tender review.
* Provide leadership in risk assessment, contract negotiations, fee structures, and pricing decisions.
* Tender, negotiate, and award supplier and subcontractor contracts.
* Collaborate with Crew Management on resource planning for assigned projects using EasyJob software.
* Coordinate with QHSE teams on\-site to ensure delivery in line with HSE and QAQC standards and compliance requirements.
* Build and maintain strong long\-term client relationships and actively expand the client network.
* Identify and secure growth opportunities, initiating and supporting new project development.
* Support Project Managers and project teams, proactively resolving escalated issues and ensuring smooth project delivery.


**Your profile**
* Proven experience in project management and delivery of turnkey projects (scenic, fit\-out, AVL) such as museums, visitor experience centers, EXPO pavilions, and other permanent or semi\-permanent installations within the entertainment and cultural sector.
* Degree in Construction Management, Architecture, Audiovisual Engineering, or a related field is highly desirable.
* Solid technical understanding of Audio, Video, Lighting systems, and control technologies, with experience in large\-scale installations (preferred).
* Demonstrated ability to develop, manage, and control large\-scale project budgets.
* Strong industry network within the UAE and KSA is highly desirable.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
* Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional languages are an advantage.
* Flexible and adaptable, with willingness to work according to project and industry requirements.
* Strong understanding of technical, commercial, and contractual interfaces across complex project environments.


**Why us?**
* Unified CAT A Silver Premium Medical Insurance provided as standard to all team members – yes, you read that correctly, we all enjoy the same insurance category benefits!

* Team Engagement Initiatives – team\-building activities, health and wellness drives, etc.
* Team Socials – team BBQs, season opening and closing parties.
* Worker’s Compensation and Accident Insurance.
* Annual Flight Allowance.
* Recruitment Referral Bonus Scheme for team members who refer successful applicants for our open positions.
* Project Referral Bonus Scheme for team members who refer successful project leads.
* The opportunity to work in an international and multi\-cultural team with collaboration across our offices in the Middle East and Europe.
* Collaborative and motivated working environment.
* Trusting and partnership\-based cooperation across all units.
* An innovative and growth\-oriented company with a matrix organizational structure and an open corporate culture.


**About Us**
 BeWunder is your turnkey partner specializing in Event Production and Spatial Experiences.
   

  

 We create inspiring and unforgettable experiences for our clients and their guests. Our renowned and highly\-skilled team of industry experts in both live events and permanent construction is well\-versed in bridging the gap between vision and reality. We design, deliver and service complex, challenging, and large\-scale projects in the field of museums and exhibitions, EXPO and brand pavilions, visitor and experience centers, digital art spaces, live events \- both corporate and sporting, as well as conferences and multimedia shows.
   

  

 Our passion lies in producing multisensory and immersive experiences, a perfect blend of new technologies and content, staged lighting and interactive elements.
   

  

 With our international track record in Europe, the Middle East and Asia, we are perfectly positioned to realize exceptional projects for our clients around the globe, from initial concept design through to final installation and beyond!

data.jd_text:
Join Our Team at Eaton: Empowering Tomorrow, Today!
   

  

 Dubai serves as a strategic hub for Eaton’s Middle East operations, bringing together commercial, engineering, manufacturing, and support teams within a globally connected business environment. Building on more than 40 years in the region, Eaton recently announced the development of a new sustainable campus in Dubai, reinforcing our long‑term investment in growth, collaboration, and capability building.
   

  

 Eaton's Global Data Center Segment is focused on helping data centers realize real business benefits today while optimizing their operations for the future. With the rise of big data, edge computing and cloud, data centers are under pressure to be more high\-performing, sustainable and cost\-effective than ever, without compromising resilience or security. At the same time, new opportunities and revenue streams require faster speed\-to\-market. With our digital intelligence, world\-class cyber\-secure products and services, reliable, compatible solutions and engineering expertise, we help data centers realize real business benefits today while optimizing their operations for the future.
   

  

 Within this segment, Eaton has an opening for
 **Global Program engineer Manager \- Multi‑Tenant Data Centers (MTDC).** 
 The role is a globally focused leadership role within the Post‑Order CoE, accountable for driving consistent execution, operational alignment, and customer outcomes across Eaton’s largest MTDC customers. This role ensures that Eaton delivers as One Eaton for multi\-tenant customers by coordinating post‑order activities across regions, business units, and functions. The position is based in Dubai and operates with global responsibility across EMEA, Americas, and APAC.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Strategic Account Operations Leadership**
* Act as the global post‑order CoE operational lead for assigned MTDC strategic accounts.
* Ensure Eaton delivers as One Global Organization, with consistent execution models and customer experience worldwide
* Serve as the primary operations interface between Eaton and MTDC customers following contract award.
* Ensure alignment between commercial commitments and execution capabilities across regions.


**Global Execution Governance**
* Drive adoption of standardized global execution models, operating rhythms, and governance frameworks for MTDC customers.
* Lead cross‑regional operating reviews focused on schedule, quality, risk, cost, and customer satisfaction.
* Establish performance visibility through dashboards, metrics, and structured reporting.


**Risk Management \& Issue Resolution**
* Proactively identify delivery, capacity, quality, and schedule risks across global deployments.
* Lead structured mitigation plans and escalations in partnership with regional and functional leaders.
* Ensure rapid issue resolution while maintaining strong customer confidence and trust.


**Cross** 
**‑** 
**Functional Coordination**
* Coordinate execution across Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Project Management, Quality, Services, and regional delivery teams.
* Influence outcomes in a highly matrixed global environment without direct line authority.
* Support alignment between Global Account Management, regional sales teams, and post‑order execution.


**Continuous Improvement \& Scalability**
* Champion continuous improvement initiatives to enhance execution efficiency, predictability, and scalability for MTDC programs.
* Capture lessons learned and deployed best practices across regions and accounts.
* Support digitalization and process maturity initiatives aligned with Eaton Business System (EBS) principles.


**Qualifications**

**Skills**

* Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, or structured continuous improvement methodologies.

**Why Join Eaton**
* Competitive compensation and benefits, aligned with your experience and impact.
* Opportunity to work on challenging, high‑impact projects within a dynamic and collaborative team environment.
* Your aspirations matter – Eaton actively supports internal mobility and promotes from within whenever possible.
* Your growth matters – We invest in long‑term development through continuous learning, upskilling, and global programs via Eaton University.
* Your contributions matter – Reliability, safety, efficiency, and sustainability are at the heart of what we do, driving meaningful impact on people’s lives and the environment.
* Your wellbeing matters – Health, safety, and wellness are a priority. At Eaton, wellbeing goes beyond programs, empowering employees with the tools and environment to thrive.


**Living And Working In Dubai**
 Dubai is an internationally connected city that offers strong professional opportunities within a truly global environment. data.jd_text:
Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As the Director Experience, Fraud and Operational Excellence you will lead talabat's end\-to\-end experience function across four pillars — Customer Experience, Partner Experience, Fraud Operations, and CX Insights — spanning 8 markets in MENA. You will be accountable for setting and executing multi\-year strategies that drive customer and partner satisfaction, govern multi\-million EUR budgets with direct P\&L impact, and oversee the integrity of the platform through robust fraud governance.
   

  

 This is a high\-impact senior leadership role requiring the ability to operate at both a strategic and executional level — influencing product and commercial roadmaps, shaping cross\-functional policy, and developing a team of senior managers and specialists. You will serve as a key voice in the COO leadership team, championing data\-driven decision\-making, operational excellence, and a culture of continuous improvement.
   

  

 If you are passionate about building world\-class experiences at scale, this role is for you.
   

  

**WHAT’S ON YOUR PLATE?**
**Customer Experience Strategy \& Leadership**
* Own the end\-to\-end CX strategy across all verticals (Food, tMart, Local Shops, DineOut) and 8 MENA markets.
* Define and govern cNPS, cSAT, and other north star metrics — setting targets, driving methodology, and leading cross\-functional execution to move them.
* Translate customer data, behavioral trends, and support signals into prioritized initiatives that improve retention, satisfaction, and order frequency.
* Champion process automation, standardization, and digitalization of key CX workflows.


**Partner Experience \& Budget Governance**
* Oversee talabat's Partner Experience function, ensuring vendor satisfaction (vNPS/vSAT) is treated as a strategic competitive differentiator linked to commercial performance.
* Maintain full accountability for the Functional budgets \- customer and vendor compensation program — a multi\-million EUR annual budget — including annual planning, policy design, market rollout sequencing, and ongoing financial governance.
* Govern the complete portfolio of partner\-facing policies and SOPs across all markets and verticals.


**Fraud Operations \& Risk Governance**
* Provide strategic oversight of talabat's Fraud Operations function, covering prevention, detection, and response frameworks across the ecosystem.
* Ensure fraud governance is aligned with compliance, audit, and legal standards.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment between Fraud, Product, Finance, and Legal to balance risk mitigation with customer experience quality and platform growth.


**Insights \& Analytics**
* Oversee the Insights function, ensuring real\-time visibility into performance across all markets through robust dashboards and structured reporting.
* Champion a data\-first culture across the department — ensuring insights translate into action.
* Partner with BI, Data Science, and Product to build the data infrastructure that underpins reliable departmental performance visibility.
* Run primary research, NPS programs to gather structured, well represented qualitative feedback \- using these to inform local and regional priorities


**People Leadership \& Organisational Development**
* Lead and develop a team of middle managers and specialists and analysts.
* Design the department's OKR framework, KPI architecture, and Business Review structure.
* Set clear goals for the function and drive high performance and professional growth across all levels — fostering a culture of ownership, innovation, and customer\-centricity.


**Senior Stakeholder Management \& Cross\-Functional Leadership**
* Serve as the experience authority in senior leadership forums, influencing Product, Commercial, Finance, and Operations decisions.
* Present strategic insights, budget performance, and departmental OKRs to COO and ExCo leadership.
* Lead high\-complexity, cross\-functional programs assigned at department or company level with no existing playbook.


**Qualifications**
**WHAT DID WE ORDER?**
**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Operations, CX, Data Analytics, or a related field.
* 10\+ years of experience in customer experience, operations, or strategy, preferably in e\-commerce, food delivery, or a high\-growth tech environment.
* Proven track record of leading mid level managers and large team members across multiple functions in a matrixed organization.
* P\&L or budget accountability, experience ideally at a multi\-million EUR scale.
* Strong background in data analysis, performance management, and CX or operational strategy.
* Experience working across multiple markets and geographies.


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Exceptional leadership skills — able to inspire, align, and develop high\-performing teams.
* Strategic mindset with strong execution discipline; comfortable operating at both the 30,000\-foot and ground levels.
* Data\-driven decision\-making, with the ability to synthesize complex datasets into clear insights and recommendations.
* Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills — able to influence and present to ExCo and Board level.
* Deep customer and partner empathy, with a passion for delivering exceptional experiences at scale.
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills across Product, Finance, Legal, and Operations.
* Ability to lead through ambiguity and drive clarity in complex, fast\-moving environments.
* AI\-first mindset — comfortable leveraging automation and emerging tools to drive scale and efficiency.

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 The Vice President, Operations \& Systems, is responsible for defining and executing the P\&T operational systems vision, architecture, and roadmap for all operational systems across the P\&T Pillar. This executive role ensures that operational technology platforms, software applications, integrations, and digital solutions align with business objectives, operational excellence goals, and long\-term growth strategies.
   

  

 The VP leads the development of system strategies, functional and technical specifications, roadmaps, and implementation plans while working closely with business leaders, operations teams, technology teams, vendors, and executive leadership. The role is accountable for maximizing business value through technology innovation, standardization, automation, and scalable digital solutions.
   

  

* Develop and maintain the P\&T strategy for operational systems and software platforms.
* Define the long\-term vision, target architecture, and digital transformation roadmap for operational technologies.
* Align technology initiatives with corporate strategy, operational objectives, customer requirements, and industry trends.
* Act as the executive sponsor for major operational technology and software transformation programs.
* Provide thought leadership on emerging technologies, automation, AI, analytics, IoT, and digital operations.
* Establish governance frameworks for operational systems, software selection, architecture standards, and lifecycle management.
* Ensure consistency, scalability, interoperability, and standardization across operational platforms.
* Define system ownership models, decision\-making processes, and performance measurement frameworks.
* Provide guidance to Business Units, Regional offices and HO with regards to all in\-house P\&T Systems (Zodiac, CCS, Rostering, Oracle, Maximo, Smart Solutions, Business Analytics) and other related technology across Ports and Terminals.
* Implement guidelines, processes, procedures for Terminal Operating Systems smart applications, system utilisation and fine tuning, quality and productivity, over the entire portfolio of terminals.
* Promote collaboration and best practice sharing amongst Business units, setting up TOS user groups and form a centralized TOS knowledge base for system implementation, testing and system migration. Assist the Business Units in selecting and implementing the right systems and related periphery technologies.
* Ensure accurate data collection from each P\&T business across the DP World Portfolio.
* Oversee successful integration globally of all in\-house P\&T Systems.
* Ultimately responsible for successful and customer service issue free go\-live of P\&T systems.Managing and ensuring fluid movement between ideation and project delivery stage, delivering a committed portfolio of Innovation projects and programs that add value.
* Deliver solutions to DP World Group challenges in all disciplines.


**Key Accountabilities**
* Develop and maintain multi\-year operational systems roadmaps aligned with strategic business priorities, capability gaps, modernization opportunities, and future technology requirements.
* Prioritize initiatives based on business value, risk reduction, operational efficiency, and return on investment, while monitoring technology trends and recommending strategic investments.
* Define and oversee implementation strategies for new systems, upgrades, integrations, and digital transformation initiatives, ensuring successful program execution and a smooth transition into operational support and continuous improvement.
* Lead organizational change, stakeholder engagement, training, adoption, and user readiness strategies to support successful implementation and sustained value realization.
* Establish enterprise architecture principles and technology standards for operational systems, including cloud, hybrid, and on\-premises solutions where appropriate.
* Ensure seamless integration between operational systems, ERP platforms, customer\-facing applications, data platforms, and third\-party solutions, promoting data consistency, interoperability, scalability, and real\-time information sharing.
* Partner with business stakeholders to understand operational needs and translate them into business cases, functional specifications, technical requirements, and solution designs.
* Ensure operational systems and solution designs support current and future business processes while meeting security, compliance, reliability, performance, and design integrity requirements.
* Lead evaluation, selection, and management of software vendors and technology partners for Ports \& Terminals, including negotiation of strategic agreements, monitoring of performance and innovation roadmaps, and management of contractual obligations.
* Govern the commercial and contractual relationship between business units and internal/external system providers.
* Ensure operational systems comply with cybersecurity, regulatory, privacy, and industry standards, and identify, assess, and mitigate technology\-related operational risks.
* Establish business continuity and disaster recovery strategies for critical operational systems.
* Standardize processes and align key performance indicators to reduce customization across system implementations and improve consistency across disciplines.
* Support comparison, selection, and implementation of operational systems and technologies across the Ports \& Terminals portfolio.
* Assess TOS utilization effectiveness across business units and strengthen adoption through training recommendations in collaboration with DP World Hub and relevant learning tools.
* Direct the development roadmap of the internal TOS, Zodiac, in alignment with the global TOS strategy.
* Manage TOS and peripheral technology vendor relationships from a central head office perspective, including regular user groups to build alignment, knowledge sharing, and operational adoption.
* Advise senior management on AFE for P\&T Systems.
* Act as liaison and quality control point for collecting business requirements for operational system implementations and system enhancements.
* Maintain relationships with all third\-party service providers and vendors supporting operational systems and technology.
* Direct and improve the Group’s Innovation portfolio, strengthening innovation maturity across all pillars, including Ports \& Terminals, Logistics, Digital Solutions, and Marine.
* Champion an innovation culture across DP World by encouraging idea generation, experimentation, knowledge sharing, and adoption of new solutions across all pillars.
* Measure the impact of innovation outcomes on DP World’s business, including value creation, cost savings, customer satisfaction, and human safety and wellbeing.
* Direct the groupwide Innovation Platform (INNOGATE) development roadmap and ensure innovative projects and solutions are integrated into commercial, marketing, supply chain, and operational processes.
* Manage geographically dispersed and functionally diverse internal and external teams to maintain a single view of the innovation portfolio and ensure effective delivery.
* Stay abreast of industry and technology trends and market developments, and make recommendations to DP World accordingly.


**Education**
 Qualifications, Skills and Experience:
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Logistics, Technology Management, Computer Science or related field. Master's degree (MBA, Technology Management, Logistics, Engineering, or equivalent) preferred.
   

  

 Experience in managing the terminal business.
   

  

* 15\+ years of experience in terminal operations, enterprise software, operational systems, digital transformation, or technology leadership roles.
* 8\+ years in senior leadership positions managing large\-scale technology portfolios and transformation programs.
* Proven experience defining technology strategy, roadmaps, architecture, and implementation plan for complex operational environments.
* Experience leading enterprise\-wide software implementations and business transformation initiatives.
* Strong understanding of operational technology platforms, enterprise applications, integration architectures, cloud technologies, and data platforms.
* Experience in global container/non\-container terminal industry with a keen interest in TOS planning, implementations, and optimization.
* Experience in terminal automation and the various modes of operation, ASC/RTG/RMG/SC
* Business leader with proven track record of change management. Is widely recognised and respected and well known to BU and regional leadership.
* Ability to influence the decision makers in executive management.
* Detailed process thinker and strategist.


**Project Management**
* Strong negotiation and relationship management skills. Ability to work with program / project managers and teams from other areas.
* Previous project management experience within the container / non\-container terminal industry


**Subject Knowledge**
* Must have in\-depth knowledge of terminal processes.
* Detailed knowledge of all terminal concepts and modes of operation ASC/RTG/RMG/SC/RS/AGV
* The desire to learn and take on\-board business\-related matters regarding business practices and assessments.
* Knowledge of Safety, Environmental and Security related matters and how they relate to terminal operations and company commitments.
* An ability to maintain current knowledge of developments related to business matters of interest to internal assessment particularly legislation changes and developments as they affect DP World operations.


**Catalyst**
* An ability to be catalyst to new ideas and technologies
* Embrace new technologies and processes


**About Us**
 Trade is the lifeblood of the global economy, creating opportunities and improving the quality of life for people around the world. DP World exists to make the world’s trade flow better, changing what’s possible for the customers and communities we serve globally.
   

  

 With a dedicated, diverse and professional team of more than 115,000 employees from 160 nationalities, spanning 78 countries on six continents, DP World is pushing trade further and faster towards a seamless supply chain that’s fit for the future.
   

  

 We’re rapidly transforming and integrating our businesses \-\- Ports and Terminals, Marine Services, Logistics and Technology – and uniting our global infrastructure with local expertise to create stronger, more efficient end\-to\-end supply chain solutions that can change the way the world trades.
   

  

 What's more, we're reshaping the future by investing in innovation. From intelligent delivery systems to automated warehouse stacking, we’re at the cutting edge of disruptive technology, pushing the sector towards better ways to trade, minimizing disruptions from the factory floor to the customer’s door.
   

  

 DP World is on a mission to transcend boundaries and bridge the gap between all nations and cultures – not just in what we do but also in how we behave.
   

  

 We are dedicated to creating a culture where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to reach their full potential. We believe that embracing inclusion and diversity, drives innovation and growth and helps us connect people, businesses, and societies. Free minds and different perspectives are changing our world, and together we can change what’s possible.
   

  

 WE MAKE TRADE FLOW

* Provide clear, executive\-level reporting aligned to business outcomes.

* Strong understanding of multidisciplinary engineering principles within the built environment.

data.jd_text:
**About noon** 




 noon is the region's leading consumer commerce platform. Since its launch on December 12th, 2017, in Saudi Arabia and the UAE, and its expansion into Egypt in February 2019, noon has grown into a diverse ecosystem spanning marketplaces for food delivery, quick commerce, fintech, and fashion. noon is a work in progress \- six years in, but only 5% done.
 



  





**noon’s mission:** 
 Ring every doorbell, every day.
 



  





**Role Overview \- Senior Security Program Manager** 




  





 Noon’s Group Cybersecurity is hiring a Senior Security Program Manager to run the execution engine of security org across the noon group of companies. We need a senior program manager who can turn a complex security roadmap into predictable delivery.
 



  





 The role spans keeping the security portfolio moving with clean artifacts and executive\-grade reporting. It is designed to be more hands\-on and cross\-cutting than a traditional PMO function, while also being broader in scope than a TPM role focused on delivering within a single engineering team or system.
 



  





 You will PM the security roadmap across Platform Security, Application and Product Security, GRC, and engineering partners. You will own the planning system, the delivery rhythm, the reporting model, and the closure standards for security initiatives.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Own the cybersecurity portfolio execution model including planning, governance rhythm, risk, reporting, and closure standards
* Drive quarterly planning for the security roadmap including sequencing, resourcing assumptions, and critical path
* Translate CISO projects and priorities, regulatory commitments, and audit requirements into executable program plans with owners, milestones, dependencies, and measurable outcomes
* Run weekly execution reviews with security leadership, enforce action closure, and manage decision deadlines
* Build and maintain the Group Security Scorecard across entities and functions, defining the metric set, targets, owners, and data sources and including it in the monthly reviews.
* Maintain the cybersecurity portfolio system of record covering initiative status, milestones, risks, dependencies, and decisions
* Produce executive\-ready reporting packs with consistent format across progress, risks, decisions required, and next milestones
* Write one\-pager program briefs for major initiatives covering scope, success metrics, owners, milestones, acceptance criteria, and timelines
* Track hiring and onboarding critical path for roadmap delivery milestones, without owning recruiting execution
* Improve execution visibility through automation, tooling, and dashboards that keep portfolio health current with minimal overhead on teams



  





**Who we need?** 




  




* Senior PM experience running cross\-functional portfolios across multiple teams with tight delivery expectations
* Strong ability to drive accountability through clarity, structured pressure, and escalation, without relying on formal authority
* Strong ability to build a delivery system including cadence, artifacts, templates, dashboards, and consistent reporting
* Executive\-grade writing and communication with concise updates, clear risk framing, and clean decision asks
* Strong judgment on prioritization, sequencing, and tradeoffs under competing demands and constrained capacity
* Ability to convert ambiguity into scope, milestones, owners, and measurable outputs
* Strong program management fundamentals with a bias toward execution, not ceremony
* Security fluency across variety of security domains, enough to pressure\-test plans and timelines without being the technical decision maker.
* High ownership and maturity handling sensitive information while representing the security leaders and CISO.



  





**Preferred experience** 




  




* Experience in a CISO office, security leadership office, or security program portfolio in a large tech company
* Experience delivering security transformation programs across multiple geographies and business units.
* Experience PM’ing security roadmaps that include detection and response maturity, platform security modernization, secure engineering programs, and governance remediation.
* Experience building governance rhythms and reporting packs used by executives, audit committees, or senior leadership stakeholders
* Experience in high\-scale consumer internet, e\-commerce, fintech, payments, logistics, or marketplace environments
* Strong program management tooling depth (or equivalent) and dashboarding habits that leadership can actually consume.



  





 Is this you?

 The Programme Manager will lead the design, development, and execution of Pearl Initiative’s (PI) Governance in Technology Programme.
