They will lead the business development, revenue generation, and fundraising initiatives of the programme, ensuring high\-impact and compliant delivery of all projects and contracts.
 



  





 Success in this role requires a strategic, detail\-oriented, and relationship\-driven leader who can design and implement high\-impact programming. This includes managing a strategic regional working group, delivering targeted interventions and projects, producing research and thought leadership that address the evolving needs of the sector, and hosting convenings and dedicated trainings.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Programmatic development and innovation** 



* Lead the design, development, planning, and budgeting of the programme strategically aligned with organisation goals and impact objectives ensuring cost\-effectiveness and efficient resource allocation.
* Drive programmatic innovation within existing offering, identifying opportunities to enhance programme effectiveness, efficiency, and impact.
* Identify and enable cross\-programmatic synergies, intersections, and collaborations.
* Identify and integrate subject matter experts, executive trainers and coaches, researchers, and any other third parties to co\-create programmatic projects and deliverables.
* Co\-create a strategic communications strategy, including priority social media channels and email campaigning, for the programme.

* Develop and execute a business development and market stakeholders' engagement strategy by identifying key target markets, potential funding sources, and partnership opportunities.

* Develop and lead community\-building initiatives, such as workshops, convenings, online forums, and networking events, to facilitate knowledge sharing, collaboration, and relationship development.

* Negotiate and finalise funding agreements and partnership contracts.



  





**Projects management and contracts compliance** 



* Manage the design, execution, and timely high\-quality delivery of collaborative needs\-based projects and flagship initiatives, focused on research, executive education, capacity\-building, and convenings.
* Adopt best practices in project management across all projects and initiatives, defining clear project scopes, developing detailed project plans, assigning roles and responsibilities, and implementing robust tracking and reporting.
* Manage programme teams and insourced third parties to ensure high accountability, strong performance, and preemptive risk management.
* Oversee the successful execution and delivery of all projects in line with contractual obligations, project timelines, and quality standards.

* Cultivate relationships with journalists, analysts, and other industry influencers to amplify thought leadership and reach a wider audience.



  





**Team mentorship and development** 



* Mentor and coach Programme Associate, providing timely and actionable feedback, creating teachable opportunities, and offering programme career guidance.
* Define and monitor the development plan of Programme Associate, with regular pulse checks, ensuring time and any needed resources are allocated for training.
* Enable career growth, including promotions, for Programme Associate.



  





**Impact measurement and reporting** 



* Co\-define quarterly and yearly key impact metrics and engagement KPIs for the programme, ensuring milestones are achievable and validated with feasibility assessments.
* Develop surveys and feedback forms for programmatic impact and performance based on impact strategy, methodology, and templates.
* Coordinate data collection of surveys and feedback forms for programmatic impact and performance.
* Analyze data of surveys and feedback forms to study and learn from achieved and non\-achieved programmatic impact and performance, based on key impact metrics and engagement KPIs identified in impact strategy.
* Develop an impact baseline assessment for the programme to measure progress towards meeting key market needs and addressing critical market gaps.
* Recommend and implement programmatic improvements, expansions, and other strategic directions from data and insights.
* Prepare impact reports and communicate findings on key impact metrics and engagement KPIs at key programme and project milestones.
* Curate, co\-author, and publish programme specific sections for the annual report.



  





**Tech\-enabled skills development** 



* Proficiently use tools and technology solutions to strengthen team productivity, project management, business development, and research through continuous learning and training.

**Qualifications and experience**

**Personal attributes**

data.jd_text:
Role : Director\- Delivery \& Installation Operations
 



 Location: Dubai, UAE
 



  





 This role exists to industrialize delivery and installation operations by introducing scalable operational systems, process discipline, and advanced last\-mile execution methodologies into a high\-volume, concurrent project environment. The position does not replace existing technical expertise — it complements it by building the operational architecture, governance, and scalability layer the business requires for its next phase of growth.
 



  





 The organization currently operates approximately 25 active customer projects per day across varying project sizes, product categories, installation durations, site conditions, and customer expectations. The environment has transitioned from a linear model to a dynamic operational network requiring:
 



 • Concurrent multi\-site project management
 



 • Daily resource reallocation and scheduling
 



 • Continuous customer communication at scale
 



 • Real\-time operational dependency management
 



 • Structured escalation and SLA\-based execution
 



  





 The core challenge is not technical installation knowledge — the organization possesses strong field execution capability. The gap is the absence of advanced process\-driven operational leadership capable of transforming fragmented execution into a scalable, predictable, and systemized operational engine.
 



  





 1\. Operational Architecture \& Process Design
 



 • Design, document, and implement end\-to\-end operational workflows covering scheduling, dispatch, installation sequencing, and project closure
 



 • Standardize all field execution processes across crew types, project categories, and site conditions
 



 • Build and maintain operational SOPs, handover protocols, and quality checkpoints
 



 • Transition the department from reactive firefighting to a structured, repeatable execution model
 



 2\. Multi\-Project Scheduling \& Dispatch Optimization
 



 • Own the daily and weekly scheduling function for all active installation and delivery projects
 



 • Implement dispatch optimization logic to maximize crew utilization and minimize idle time
 



 • Develop priority sequencing models that account for site readiness, product availability, and customer commitments
 



 • Manage resource conflicts and reallocate teams dynamically in response to live operational changes
 



 3\. Operational Control Tower
 



 • Establish and operate a live control tower function providing real\-time visibility into all active projects
 



 • Define and monitor key operational KPIs: on\-time completion rate, revisit rate, crew utilisation, SLA adherence, and delay frequency
 



 • Build dashboards and reporting structures for daily operational review and senior management reporting
 



 • Identify operational bottlenecks early and drive structured resolution
 



 4\. Workforce Coordination \& Utilisation
 



 • Manage crew capacity planning, deployment, and productivity tracking
 



 • Coordinate with HR on workforce resourcing, shift planning, and contractor management
 



 • Develop performance frameworks for field teams aligned to operational KPIs
 



 • Reduce overdependence on key individuals by building cross\-trained, interchangeable crew structures
 



 5\. Customer Coordination \& SLA Management
 



 • Define and enforce SLA frameworks covering installation lead times, communication standards, and escalation thresholds
 



 • Work with customer\-facing teams to align operational capacity with customer commitments
 



 • Build structured customer coordination protocols for pre\-installation, day\-of, and post\-installation touchpoints
 



 • Own escalation handling for time\-sensitive or complex customer situations
 



 6\. Technology \& Systems Integration
 



 • Lead the evaluation, selection, and implementation of operational management technology (scheduling tools, field service management platforms, and dispatch systems)
 



 • Work with IT to integrate operational systems with ERP, CRM, and customer portals
 



 • Drive adoption of digital tools across field teams to improve real\-time communication and job visibility
 



 7\. Cross\-Functional Coordination
 



 • Act as the primary operational interface between the installation department, sales, logistics, procurement, and customer experience teams
 



 • Align project execution timelines with product availability, warehouse readiness, and client schedules
 



 • Participate in strategic planning discussions to translate business growth targets into operational capacity requirements
 



  





 8\. Leadership \& Culture
 



 • Build and mentor a high\-performance operational leadership team within the department
 



 • Establish a culture of accountability, process discipline, and continuous improvement
 



 • Champion data\-driven decision\-making and operational transparency across all levels of the team
 



  





 Academic Qualification :
 



 Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Supply Chain, Business Administration, or a related field
 



 Master's degree (MBA or MSc Operations/Supply Chain Management)
 



 Certification
 



 Relevant operational or project management certification (PMP, APICS CPIM, or equivalent)
 



 Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or Green Belt; PRINCE2; Certified Supply Chain Professional (CSCP)
 



 Industry knowledge
 



 Demonstrated understanding of last\-mile logistics, field service operations, or installation project management
 



 Experience with furniture, fit\-out, modular kitchen, or home installation industries
 



 Proficiency in operational management tools, scheduling platforms, and ERP systems
 



 Experience with field service management software (e.g. ServiceMax, FieldAware, SAP FSM)
 



  





 Experience :
 



 Minimum 15 years in operations leadership, with at least 5 years at a senior management or director level
 



 Last\-mile operations
 



 Proven track record in high\-volume last\-mile delivery or installation environments (25\+ daily projects)
 



 Process transformation
 



 Demonstrated experience transitioning reactive operational models into scalable, process\-driven execution frameworks
 



 Multi\-site management
 



 Experience managing concurrent projects across multiple sites with dynamic resource allocation
 



 Team leadership
 



 Experience building and leading cross\-functional operations teams of 20 or more
 



 Technology implementation
 



 Track record of leading operational technology deployments (scheduling, FSM, ERP, or dispatch systems)

**About the Company**
 Careem is building the Everything App for the greater Middle East — making it easy to move around, order food and groceries, manage payments, and more. Our purpose is simple: to simplify and improve people’s lives and build an awesome organisation that inspires.
   

  

 Since 2012, Careem has enabled earnings for over 2\.5 million Captains, simplified the lives of more than 70 million customers, and built a platform where the region’s best talent and entrepreneurs thrive. We operate in 70\+ cities across 10 countries, from Morocco to Pakistan.
   

  

***We’re now entering our next chapter — one powered by AI. We’re looking for AI talent: curious problem\-solvers who know how to apply AI to build tools, automate workflows, and create real impact. Whether it’s streamlining operations, enhancing customer experience, or reimagining internal systems — we want people who can make Careem work smarter and move faster.***
**About The Role**
 As a Program Manager within the Product organisation, you will be the bridge that brings colleagues together to deliver complex, cross\-functional technical initiatives — often with tight deadlines and multi\-layered dependencies. You will build relationships grounded in trust and integrity across the organisation and with third\-party partners, enabling you to break through collaboration barriers, resolve conflicts, and manage risks effectively.

* Drive progress transparency through structured communication of status, blockers, and upcoming milestones across all levels of the organisation

* Work and learn from great minds by joining a community of inspiring colleagues.

* Explore new opportunities to learn and grow every day.
* Work remotely from any country in the world for 30 days a year with unlimited vacation days per year.

**Job Description**
**Your mission**
 The Project Director is responsible for driving the successful delivery of projects while actively contributing to the creation and execution of the business plan for future projects.
   

  

 This role goes beyond project leadership \- it’s about strategically shaping our global presence with a primary focus on the Middle East, ensuring operational excellence, and contributing directly to the long\-term growth targets of the Event Production unit.
   

  

 Working closely with the Director of Event Production BU and the wider leadership team, the Project Director will translate the business plans into actionable initiatives, ensure targets are met, maintain and expand client relationships, and strengthen our competitive position in the market.
   

  

 The role also requires close collaboration with other Project Directors across the organisation to ensure alignment, knowledge sharing, and collective progress toward shared goals.
   

  

 This position reflects our new structure of appointing Project Directors with defined focus areas (e.g., KSA, UAE, Special Projects Global), ensuring scalability and dedicated leadership as our business continues to expand.

* Coordinate and collaborate with other Project Directors to ensure alignment of strategies, processes, and delivery standards across all focus areas.
* Drive efficiency, best practices, and continuous improvement in project delivery.

**Project Execution \& Delivery**
* Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of projects, ensuring quality, timeliness, and profitability.

* Ensure disciplined financial and operational management across projects.

* Apply project management methodologies, documentation, and approval processes that reduce risk and increase efficiency.

* Capture client feedback and integrate it into project delivery and future business planning.
* Nurture partnerships with subcontractors, suppliers, and freelancers to ensure reliable and high\-quality delivery.


****Financial \& Commercial Oversight****
* Manage budgets, forecasts, and margin protection across projects.
* Support the Director of Event Production in financial disciplines, risk management, and profitability strategies.
* Drive commercial success by balancing operational efficiency with exceptional client delivery.


****Innovation \& Continuous Improvement****

* Translate lessons learned into better processes and future planning for upcoming projects.
* Collaborate across units, regions, and with other Project Directors to ensure creative, technical, and operational excellence.


**Your profile**
* Demonstrated extensive project management experience in turnkey project delivery, including hands\-on experience with AVL and fit\-out installations in the field of events of various complexity and scales.
* Good understanding of technical, business and contractual correlations in all complexity.
* Proven ability to manage large budgets.
* Strong industry network in the UAE and KSA is highly desirable.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* English language proficiency is a must.
* Flexible to work based on the requirements of the live event industry.


**Why us?**
* Unified CAT A Silver Premium Medical Insurance provided as standard to all team members – yes, you read that correctly, we all enjoy the same insurance category benefits!
* Complimentary lunches provided daily in our Dubai office canteen.
* Team Engagement Initiatives – team\-building activities, health and wellness drives, etc.
* Team Socials – team BBQs, season opening and closing parties.
* Worker’s Compensation and Accident Insurance.
* Annual flight allowance.
* Recruitment Referral Bonus Scheme for team members who refer successful applicants for our open positions.
* Project Referral Bonus Scheme for team members who refer successful project leads.
* The opportunity to work in an international and multi\-cultural team with collaboration across our offices in the Middle East and Europe.
* Collaborative and motivated working environment.
* Trusting and partnership\-based cooperation across all units.
* An innovative and growth\-oriented company with a matrix organizational structure and an open corporate culture.


**About Us**
 BeWunder is your turnkey partner specializing in Event Production and Spatial Experiences.
   

  

 We create inspiring and unforgettable experiences for our clients and their guests. Our renowned and highly\-skilled team of industry experts in both live events and permanent construction is well\-versed in bridging the gap between vision and reality. We design, deliver and service complex, challenging, and large\-scale projects in the field of museums and exhibitions, EXPO and brand pavilions, visitor and experience centers, digital art spaces, live events \- both corporate and sporting, as well as conferences and multimedia shows.
   

  

 Our passion lies in producing multisensory and immersive experiences, a perfect blend of new technologies and content, staged lighting and interactive elements.
   

  

 With our international track record in Europe, the Middle East and Asia, we are perfectly positioned to realize exceptional projects for our clients around the globe, from initial concept design through to final installation and beyond!

data.jd_text:
**About Astrazeneca**
 At AstraZeneca we fuse the worlds of Medical and Commercial to spot opportunities and pioneer approaches that better serve our patients. Bridging Commercial and Scientific goals, we apply our people and leadership skills to launch cutting\-edge products into our growing healthcare ecosystem. It takes a holistic mindset to treat each unique patient and tailor the whole experience – from early diagnosis to treatment. We step up and take accountability to deliver new ways of doing things that will create a better future for our markets.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The role is responsible for leading a high\-performing Biopharmaceuticals Business Unit (BBU) Medical Affairs team across the CVRM and R\&I Therapy Areas in the AstraZeneca Gulf cluster. Prioritizes across both therapy areas according to BBU strategy and organizational impact, with a deep understanding of the Gulf healthcare systems, their priorities and challenges across the disease areas.
   

  

 Ensures excellence in the development and execution of integrated CVRM and R\&I Medical Affairs Plans – composed of confidence and evidence\-generation activities, as well as fundamental and sustainable clinical\-practice transformations that strengthen healthcare ecosystems, improve treatment outcomes, and enable equitable access to quality patient care in alignment with the BBU portfolio.
   

  

 Recognizes and leverages innovation wherever appropriate to drive strategic and sustainable impact internally and externally. Leads the team to identify, activate and measure scalable healthcare practice shaping initiatives across both therapy areas, with integrated partnership engagement plans composed of key traditional (e.g. HCPs and scientific leaders in cardiology, nephrology, endocrinology/diabetes, respiratory and immunology/rheumatology) and non\-traditional (e.g. policy and decision makers, PAGs, government, payers, innovative solution providers) stakeholders.
   

  

 Drives operational effectiveness, impact and efficiencies of the CVRM and R\&I Medical Affairs teams through measurable outcomes and a continuous improvement approach, balancing resources appropriately across the two therapy areas. Communicates on the quality, delivery and value of the BBU Medical Affairs teams with a good understanding of the internal business ecosystem.
   

  

 Leads the BBU Medical Affairs teams as a member of the Senior Leadership Team, partnering closely with the CVRM and R\&I commercial BUDs. Acts as part of the leadership team for the Gulf organization and participates in organizational decisions with an entrepreneurial mindset.
   

  

**Typical Accountabilities**
**Medical Strategy**
* Accountable for setting the integrated CVRM and R\&I Medical Affairs strategy for the Gulf cluster, ensuring appropriate resources and delivering the strategic Medical Affairs plans across both therapy areas with maximum impact and effectiveness.
* Accountable for the strategic direction, business planning and team leadership of the BBU (CVRM \& R\&I) Medical Affairs function within the Gulf cluster, aligning local plans with the global/area CVRM and R\&I medical strategies and the Gulf launch sequence.
* Translates the differing scientific, evidence\-generation and stakeholder needs of CVRM and R\&I into a single prioritized plan, balancing investment, capabilities and focus across the two therapy areas.
* Leads the BBU Medical Affairs organization as part of the cluster’s senior leadership team and represents the local company externally on the topic of science and healthcare across the cardiovascular, renal, metabolic, respiratory and immunology disease areas.
* Manages and leads change initiatives, challenges current thinking and assumptions within the organization, and collaborates with cross\-functional teams and across organizations at various levels.


**Team Leader**
* Manages and coaches the CVRM and R\&I medical teams – e.g. Medical Advisors, Medical Managers and MSLs – for performance with purpose, holding the team accountable for timely and effective delivery in the prioritized areas that drive the greatest impact across both therapy areas.
* Establishes required standards of medical core – and new capabilities, ensures medical operational excellence, business and resource planning and people processes (recruitment, talent management, motivation, retention).
* Drives performance with impact\-focused goals and measurable outcomes, continuously validating and improving strategies through data\-driven insights.
* Builds and sustains deep therapy\-area and scientific expertise across CVRM and R\&I, and drives a collaborative, patient\-centric culture with an innovative mindset that focuses on impact.


**External Engagements**
* Knowledgeable of the global and Gulf healthcare ecosystem – its priorities, challenges, opportunities and issues.
* Ensures scalable and sustainable strategic solutions to Transforming Care are incorporated and prioritized into the CVRM and R\&I Medical Affairs plans to strengthen healthcare ecosystems and improve treatment outcomes.
* Drives Scientific Leadership across cardiovascular, renal, metabolic, respiratory and immunology care.
* Establishes collaborative engagements with Key Opinion Leaders of the HC ecosystem (e.g. cardiologists, nephrologists, endocrinologists/diabetologists, pulmonologists, immunologists/rheumatologists, payers, policy makers, regulatory bodies and PAGs) to drive consensus and successfully advocate for policy changes that improve access to quality patient care.


**Medical Evidence Generation Oversight**
* Ensure building of high\-quality Gulf Medical Evidence Plans to generate Clinical, Payer, Policy evidence in line with brand strategy
* Ensure meeting local and above market RWE study program KPIs (startup timelines, recruitment, etc)
* Ensure high quality medical insights provided to area/regional Evidence Generation strategies
* Ensuring GCP Quality and compliance with local GCP Quality Management System (QMS) SOP and all applicable AZ policies and Standards


**Medical Excellence and Governance Oversight**
* Ensure Nominated Signatory, Medical Information, Ethical Interactions policies are implemented and tracked
* Ensure setting up and conduct regular review of Field Medical Quarterly Dashboard (KPIs) and assessment of MSL Capabilities
* Ensure Medical function are compliant with AZ Code of Ethics, Corporate Governance, Audit requirements, guidelines, policies, procedures, development/ updating of SOPs in timely manner. Ensures and monitors compliance by team members and third parties by (a) positively reinforcing the Code of Ethics and all relevant AstraZeneca Policies and Standards, (b) ensuring completion of all required training, (c) fostering a culture of openness in which employees are comfortable raising questions or concerns, and (d) immediately addressing and reporting, as appropriate, instances of non\-compliance.
* As a leader with accountability for GxP areas, understands the legal and regulatory requirements of the role in providing appropriate resources (human, financial, material, facilities and equipment) to maintain the Quality system and continually improve its effectiveness.
* Collaborates with Compliance to ensure full adherence to company standards on ethical interactions.


**Essentials For The Role**
* Science degree and/or Master’s degree in a scientific discipline.
* Extensive experience of the Medical Affairs function within the pharmaceutical industry.
* Therapy\-area knowledge across CVRM and/or R\&I (cardiovascular, renal, metabolic, respiratory or immunology).
* Experience leading or supporting Medical Affairs across more than one therapy area.
* Extensive experience in relationship and stakeholder management.
* Extensive team management / people\-leadership experience.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.


**Desirables for the role**
* Doctoral degree in a scientific discipline (e.g. M.D., Ph.D., Pharm.D.).
* In\-depth scientific expertise in one or more CVRM or R\&I disease areas (e.g. heart failure, chronic kidney disease, type 2 diabetes, severe asthma, COPD, immunology/rheumatology).
* Experience supporting product launches within CVRM or R\&I.
* Experience of the Gulf / GCC healthcare environment and stakeholders.
* Extensive knowledge of the latest technical and regulatory developments.
* Innovative and solution\-oriented mindset; ecosystem\-scaled project experience.
* Experience with research, drug discovery, drug development and drug lifecycle management.


**Date Posted**
 01\-يوليو\-2026
   

  

**Closing Date**
 19\-يوليو\-2026
   

  

 AstraZeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry\-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non\-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.

data.jd_text:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.
   

  

 The Company operates Snapchat, a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc., a wholly\-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji, Saturn, and other digital services.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Head of Public Policy, MEA to join Snap Inc. As a member of the EMEA Public Policy team, the role reports to the Senior Director Public Policy EMEA. You will be responsible for the public policy and government relations work across the MEA region, with a particular focus on UAE and Saudi Arabia, as well as Qatar and potentially further afield in Africa. Working from our office in Dubai, you will co\-design, and execute the implementation of the public policy plan for relevant markets. The Middle East and Africa are key growth regions for Snap and our relationships with the governments and other key public stakeholders are of the utmost importance. Ensuring that Snap’s distinctive voice is heard and accommodated in policy\-making circles will be a key priority.
   

  

 The Head of Public Policy is co\-responsible for development of positions on key local and regional policy issues impacting Snap and for developing effective strategies to achieve policy outcomes and mitigate risk. This person will work closely with the rest of the Global Public Policy team, wider Legal team, regional Sales teams, the Communications team, Platform Integrity and Product teams and, on occasion, senior business executives to ensure the public policy program supports business growth and protects the company’s interests.
   

  

 What you’ll do:
   

  

* Serve as the main day\-to\-day policy representative of Snap Inc in the Middle East and Africa. Further deepen relationships with relevant government officials, NGOs, trade associations, non\-governmental organizations, and other influential stakeholders.
* Work closely with the Senior Director EMEA of Public Policy, the EMEA Public Policy team, the SVP Global Policy \& Platform Operations and, on occasion, the senior executive organization.
* Being the Policy spokesperson of the company in the region in various fora, events etc.
* Be the first to act and respond to the appropriate public policy inquiries.
* Collaborate with Public Policy, Legal and Business teams to analyze legislative initiatives, advise on risks and opportunities and develop company policy positions and messaging
* Partner with the Communications team to help them appropriately respond to Policy\-related media inquiries, by providing the correct policy narrative that best represents Snap Inc.


 Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities:
   

  

* A proven ability for shaping, and working with, government officials, NGOs, coalitions and other stakeholder groups.
* Good tech policy understanding and existing relationships within government and the wider stakeholder community in the region.
* Excellent communication and advocacy skills and sound political judgment.
* Forward thinking and proactive ability on legislative, regulatory and public policy issues. Ability to rapidly understand and master complex policy issues.
* Ability to work with Snap business to identify pertinent issues and orient the public policy team to meet priorities.
* Ability to work independently/ self\-starter in a fast\-paced, multicultural environment
* Demonstrated ability to work with a wide range of external groups and individuals, including those who are opponents or critics.
* Teammate with a positive attitude, motivation and a sense of humor
* Articulate and thoughtful.
* Able to adapt communication on complex issues for different audiences.
* A passion for Snapchat and creativity.


 Minimum Qualifications:
   

  

* Master's degree or advanced studies in law/economics/public affairs
* 10\+ years relevant experience in MENA public policy and public affairs
* Strong experience (4\+ years) on MENA tech policy, ideally working on platform regulations


 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  

* Working experience in Dubai or Riyadh
* Previous experience working with the Government or regulators or other Public institutions is a plus
* Full Arabic and English proficiency necessary


 If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please don’t be shy and provide us some information.
   

  

 "Default Together" Policy at Snap: At Snap Inc. we believe that being together in person helps us build our culture faster, reinforce our values, and serve our community, customers and partners better through dynamic collaboration. To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4\+ days per week.
   

  

 At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. Snap is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. EOE, including disability/vets.
   

  

 Our Benefits: Snap Inc. is its own community, so we’ve got your back! We do our best to make sure you and your loved ones have everything you need to be happy and healthy, on your own terms. Our benefits are built around your needs and include paid parental leave, comprehensive medical coverage, emotional and mental health support programs, and compensation packages that let you share in Snap’s long\-term success!

**Job Description**
 What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?
   

  

 At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.
   

  

 As a Senior Project Manager, you are responsible for the strategic leadership and successful delivery of complex, multi\-disciplinary projects, with a focus on retail and mixed\-use developments, from early concept through to completion.
   

  

 The role requires a highly proactive and commercially astute approach, ensuring delivery aligns with client objectives, brand requirements, operational constraints, and fast\-track retail programmes. You will lead project teams, drive decision\-making, and manage key stakeholder relationships, ensuring high\-quality outcomes across all stages of design and delivery.
   

  

 You are expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, provide leadership across multiple workstreams, and act as a trusted advisor to clients.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Contract \& Scope
   

  

* Lead project set\-up, including contract finalisation, internal alignment and mobilisation of the team
* Fully understand and manage the contract, ensuring compliance with key obligations and deliverables
* Define, agree and manage scope across all disciplines, ensuring clarity of responsibilities
* Lead the appointment and coordination of sub\-consultants, including scope, fees and agreements
* Identify and manage changes to scope, leading variation preparation, negotiation and agreement with the client
* Ensure all deliverables meet WSP quality standards and client expectations


 Communication \& Team Leadership
   

  

* Act as the primary interface with the client, operators, tenants, and key stakeholders
* Provide clear leadership, establishing a high\-performing “one team” culture
* Lead client engagement, workshops and presentations, including executive\-level reporting
* Manage complex stakeholder environments, including retail tenants, landlords, operators and authorities
* Support clients with strategic decision\-making, balancing commercial, operational and design priorities
* Proactively manage expectations, risks and issues to maintain trust and project momentum Programme
* Lead development of detailed, realistic programmes aligned with retail delivery and tenant fit\-out requirements
* Manage programmes proactively, identifying and mitigating risks to delivery
* Coordinate with design teams to ensure alignment with anchor tenant, F\&B and retail unit handover milestones
* Oversee integration of base build, shell \& core, and tenant fit\-out packages
* Ensure programme reflects authority approvals, procurement strategies and phased handovers
* Work with Planning \& Controls to maintain robust P6 programmes and client reporting


 Design \& Technical Coordination
   

  

* Lead multidisciplinary design coordination through all stages (Concept to IFC and construction support)

 Risk Management
   

  

* Establish and lead the project Risk Register, ensuring regular review and active management

 Commercial Management
   

  

* Lead all project commercial aspects, including budget management and financial reporting Manage project invoicing, cost tracking and financial performance

 Delivery \& Handover
   

  

* Oversee project delivery through to completion, ensuring alignment with client and operational objectives

* Ensure smooth transition to supervision / construction teams
* Lead project close\-out, ensuring all deliverables, approvals and documentation are complete

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture or related field
* 13\+ years professional experience, with a strong focus on retail, mixed\-use or commercial developments
* Proven track record delivering complex, multidisciplinary projects from Concept through to IFC and construction
* Demonstrable experience in retail delivery, including tenant coordination and fit\-out integration
* Experience working with major developers, operators or retail brands preferred
* Experience managing large, multidisciplinary teams and multiple stakeholders


 Core Competencies
   

  

* Strong leadership and ability to operate at a senior, client\-facing level
* Strategic thinking with ability to manage competing priorities
* Excellent stakeholder management, particularly within complex retail environments
* Commercial acumen and contractual awareness
* Strong programme and risk management capability
* Ability to drive quality, coordination and technical excellence
* Collaborative and proactive communication style
* Ability to lead and motivate multidisciplinary teams
* Strong understanding of health and safety in design


**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**
 Join our close\-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.
   

  

**With us, you can. Apply today.**

data.jd_text:
Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drive everything we do. The Middle East markets (UAE and Kuwait) are one of our most dynamic and competitive markets. Functions include commercial, operations, and marketing, and teams in the Middle East partner closely with global functions such as product, technology, and consumer to deliver results for our customers.
   

  

 This role sits within Operations and leads all things Rider Experience. A large and impactful scope that includes Rider community management, Rider communications, several aspects of Rider Performance, Rider Support, and Rider Onboarding. The role entails building, improving, and implementing processes across the areas above, tracking and managing efficiency and effectiveness of how we are performing across a variety of metrics, and finally ensuring that we are able to deliver excellent support to riders across the region.
   

  

**The Role**
 Operating at scale in a hyper\-competitive, hyper\-growth environment is no easy feat. As such, you'll be faced with some of the most exciting problems across the food tech space. Reporting to the Director of Operations, Middle East, you’ll have a key role in ensuring the success of the logistics network in our Middle East markets. This centers around ensuring that we always have a fleet of highly engaged, highly satisfied, and highly performing riders on our network. Working with stakeholders within Ops to find the right approach through levers like communications, education modules, and rider events. This role is regional, and will be required to build world\-class frameworks and systems that are both effective and scalable. The objective is straightforward: build the best systems to ensure riders are able to deliver the best experience for our customers and merchants.
   

  

 You’ll work closely with other members of the Middle East rider operations teams, as well as wider teams within HQ Ops, Product, and Tech to ensure the best possible outcomes for our riders, restaurants, and customers.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
 Here’s what your day\-to\-day might look like:
   

  

* Managing a large team that owns and runs several processes across the scope of the team
* Building effective, scalable, and efficient frameworks and systems that can be centralized to manage and track several key metrics across our network
* Make recommendations on how to allocate our resources to ensure the best possible outcomes, for instance, managing rider churn to optimal levels to ensure best\-in\-class service levels
* Ensuring the quality and engagement of riders newly onboarded on our network is conducive to our strategy of having best\-in\-class service levels
* Track our key metrics, look for unusual trends in our data, and uncover root causes to ensure that we preserve the health of the network.
* Work alongside other members of the Middle East Rider Operations team to ensure that we operate to budget
* Provide regular, relevant, concise updates on rider experience to senior business stakeholders.


**What You'll Need To Thrive**
 Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:
   

  

* A high standard of university\-level education
* 8\+ years of experience in program management, consulting, banking, engineering, or a high\-growth start\-up
* Excellent problem\-solving skills – experience solving tough, complex problems
* An ownership mindset that means you know what is happening in your area of responsibility
* Experience managing a multi\-functional team
* Experience building scalable processes, tools, and structured change methodologies, and therefore enjoying working in a process\-driven environment
* Strong analytical mindset and comfortable with large data sets
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
* Comfortable handling multiple workstreams at the same time, working both individually and as part of a team


**Why Join Us?**
 At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real\-world problems in a three\-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.
   

  

 We’re Food Lovers, Problem Solvers, Community Builders, And More, Brought Together By a Shared Drive To Make Things Better. Working Here, You Can Expect To
   

  

**🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale** 
 Work on a complex, always\-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.
   

  

 🌱
 **See your impact, fast** 
 Ship, test, and improve ideas quickly in a low\-hierarchy, high\-ownership
   

  

 environment.
   

  

**🧠Grow through challenge and ownership** 
 Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.
   

  

**🌎A culture built for builders** 
 High standards, collaboration, flexible working, and continuous learning.
   

  

 We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3\-4 stages. Find more about how we hire
 **here.**
**Our Global Structure**
 Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
   

  

**Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**
 At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.
   

  

 We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio\-economic background, religion, or belief.
   

  

 If you have a disability or long\-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.
   

  

 If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast\-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

data.jd_text:
الهدف العام للوظيفة
 



 قيادة وتطوير استراتيجية الذكاء الاصطناعي في الوزارة، وتحمّل المسؤولية المؤسسية عن تحقيق القيمة المضافة من خلال توظيف أصول بيانات الوزارة ومنظومة الذكاء الاصطناعي بما يشمل تطبيقات الذكاء الاصطناعي التوليدي، وتحقيق الربط الفعّال بين التوجهات الاستراتيجية للوزارة وتقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي لقيادة مسيرة تبنّيه في مختلف قطاعاتها، وضمان توافق جميع المبادرات مع المعايير الأخلاقية ومتطلبات الحوكمة بما يعزز كفاءة اتخاذ القرار ويحقق أهداف التحول الذكي.
 



  





 المسؤوليات الرئيسية
 


* إعداد وقيادة استراتيجية الذكاء الاصطناعي للوزارة بما يتوافق مع أهدافها المؤسسية والوطنية، وتطوير نموذج التشغيل اللازم لتنفيذها وقياس أثرها في تحسين الكفاءة واتخاذ القرار.
* قيادة مبادرات التحول الذكي في الوزارة بما فيها تطبيقات الذكاء الاصطناعي التوليدي، واستثمار أصول البيانات المؤسسية لتحقيق قيمة مضافة قابلة للقياس.
* ضمان قابلية توسع نماذج الذكاء الاصطناعي وتكاملها مع سير العمل والأنظمة المؤسسية القائمة، مع ضمان جاهزية البيانات لمتطلبات الذكاء الاصطناعي.
* إنشاء وإدارة أطر حوكمة الذكاء الاصطناعي في الوزارة بما يشمل السياسات والمعايير ونماذج التشغيل، لضمان الاستخدام الأخلاقي والمسؤول وفق المعايير المحلية والدولية.
* تصميم وتطبيق إطار إدارة مخاطر الذكاء الاصطناعي بما يشمل تصنيف المخاطر وآليات التخفيف والمراقبة المستمرة لحماية الوزارة من الآثار السلبية المحتملة.
* الإشراف على تقييم واعتماد حالات استخدام الذكاء الاصطناعي وضمان امتثالها لمتطلبات الخصوصية وحماية البيانات والاشتراطات التنظيمية المعتمدة.
* التنسيق مع قيادات الوحدات والإدارات لتعزيز القدرات الذكية عبر الوزارة، وبناء ثقافة مؤسسية تثق في الذكاء الاصطناعي وتوظّفه بصورة فعّالة.
* التعاون مع الفرق التقنية لضمان أن البنية التحتية وعمليات تقنية المعلومات وهندسة البرمجيات وإدارة البيانات تدعم تشغيل حلول الذكاء الاصطناعي واستدامتها.
* متابعة أداء وأثر مبادرات الذكاء الاصطناعي وضمان تحقيق القيمة وفق مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية المعتمدة، وإعداد التقارير الدورية لقيادة الوزارة.
* تصميم وتنفيذ برامج التثقيف في الذكاء الاصطناعي وبناء القدرات التقنية لدى منسوبي الوزارة بما يضمن قدرتهم على التعامل مع أدواته وتطبيقاته بفاعلية.
* التواصل مع الجهات التنظيمية والشركاء الخارجيين والهيئات المعنية في شأن حوكمة الذكاء الاصطناعي واستراتيجيته.
* الإسهام في إعداد الخطط التشغيلية السنوية للقسم ومتابعة تنفيذها وضمان توافقها مع أولويات الوزارة الاستراتيجية.
* تنفيذ أي مهام أخرى يكلف بها مدير الإدارة في نطاق اختصاصه.



  





 المؤهلات والخبرة
 


* دكتوراه \- إحصاء / رياضيات تطبيقية / اقتصاد / علوم الحاسب / هندسة أو ما يعادلها (بدون خبرة)
* ماجستير \- الذكاء الاصطناعي / علوم البيانات / علوم الحاسب / هندسة أو ما يعادلها (3 سنوات)
* بكالوريوس \- علوم الحاسب / هندسة الحاسوب / هندسة البرمجيات / نظم المعلومات أو ما يعادلها (7 سنوات)



  





 الشهادات المهنية
 


* شهادة مهنية معتمدة في الذكاء الاصطناعي وتعلم الآلة مثل Google Professional ML Engineer / AWS ML Specialty / Azure AI Engineer Associate
* شهادة في الذكاء الاصطناعي التوليدي ونماذج اللغة الكبيرة مثل LLMs DeepLearning.AI Generative AI Specialization
* شهادة في حوكمة الذكاء الاصطناعي وأخلاقياته مثل IAPP AI Governance Professional / ISO 42001 Lead Implementer
* شهادة في علم البيانات وتحليل البيانات المتقدمة مثل IBM Data Science Professional / Databricks ML Associate
* شهادة في تشغيل نماذج الذكاء الاصطناعي وعملياته مثل MLflow MLOps Certified / Kubeflow Practitioner
* شهادة في إدارة المشاريع والتحول الرقمي أو ما يعادله ا PMP / PRINCE2 / SAFe
* شهادة في إدارة البيانات وهندستها أو ما يعادلها (CDMP)
* دورة في استراتيجية الذكاء الاصطناعي وتطبيقاته في القطاع الحكومي
* دورة في أخلاقيات الذكاء الاصطناعي والاستخدام المسؤول ومعالجة التحيز والشفافية
* دورة في قيادة التغيير وإدارة التحول المؤسسي باستخدام تقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي
* دورة في هندسة الطلبات وتطبيقات النماذج اللغوية الكبيرة (Prompt Engineering)



  





  





  





  





  





**Job Purpose** 




 Lead and develop the Ministry's Artificial Intelligence (AI) strategy and assume enterprise\-wide responsibility for delivering measurable value through the effective utilization of the Ministry's data assets and AI ecosystem, including Generative AI applications. The role ensures the alignment of AI technologies with the Ministry's strategic objectives, drives AI adoption across all sectors, and ensures that all AI initiatives comply with ethical standards and governance requirements, thereby enhancing decision\-making efficiency and achieving the Ministry's smart transformation goals.
 



**Key Responsibilities**

data.jd_text:
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Office Director to oversee and coordinate all aspects of the Office’s activities. This leadership role will focus on managing strategic partnerships, insights, and convenings while effectively managing a team. The Office Director will play a key role in strengthening communication and coordination among government and business leaders locally and internationally.
 



  





 The Office Director will ensure that strategic objectives are met by driving engagements, developing relationships, leading high\-level meetings, and fostering cross\-sectoral collaborations. This individual should possess deep expertise in managing partnerships, delivering insights, organizing convenings, and guiding team members to advance key initiatives.
 



  





**Primary Duties \& Responsibilities** 




**1\. Strategic Partnerships Leadership:** 



* Develop and implement comprehensive strategies to build and sustain relationships with key stakeholders in government and business sectors locally and in priority global regions.
* Oversee the identification, engagement, and management of partnerships with multilateral organizations, international forums, and influential family and corporate entities.
* Act as the primary point of contact for partners, facilitating productive interactions and ensuring alignment with strategic objectives.
* Collaborate with Embassies, diplomats, and government ministries to align partnership initiatives with Office goals and diplomatic missions.
* Drive the creation and management of a partnership database and maintain records of strategic engagements.



  





**2\. Insights Generation and Dissemination:** 



* Lead the design and execution of research projects, including studies, surveys, and workshops that inform strategy.
* Facilitate and manage regular insights sessions for senior businesses and governmental stakeholders on emerging geo\-economic and strategic issues.
* Oversee the development of high\-quality reports, briefings, and presentations that synthesize research findings into actionable insights.
* Guide content development in collaboration with team members to ensure alignment with Office objectives.
* Coordinate closely with the Communications Manager to ensure effective dissemination of insights through appropriate channels.



  





**3\. Convenings Management:** 



* Oversee the planning and execution of high\-level convenings, such as roundtables, conferences, and multi\-stakeholder meetings locally and key international locations.
* Ensure seamless coordination of event logistics, including venue selection, participant engagement, and on\-site management.
* Work collaboratively with team members to develop event agendas, speaker briefings, and session formats that align with strategic themes.
* Maintain a comprehensive annual convening strategy and identify opportunities to enhance or expand convening activities.
* Direct the collection and analysis of event feedback and post\-event reporting to guide continuous improvements.



  





**4\. Communication and Coordination with the Communications Manager:** 



* Establish and maintain open channels of communication with the Communications Manager to align messaging strategies with key objectives.
* Coordinate on the development of high\-quality content for various platforms, ensuring consistency and alignment with strategic themes.
* Work collaboratively on media relations, press releases, and social media campaigns to enhance visibility.
* Guide the Communications Manager in crafting strategic communication plans for key events and projects.



  





**5\. Coordination with the Office Manager:** 



* Regularly engage with the Office Manager to oversee day\-to\-day administrative activities and ensure smooth operations.
* Collaborate on project timelines, office logistics, and team schedules to ensure alignment with priorities.
* Review and approve budget tracking, expense reports, and procurement activities managed by the Office Manager.
* Ensure that HR processes, onboarding, and team member support initiatives are aligned with the Office's overall strategy.



  





**6\. Reporting and Accountability Activities:** 



* Lead the development of comprehensive reports and updates, summarizing the progress of strategic projects and partnerships.
* Implement standardized reporting practices for all functions within the Office to maintain accountability and transparency.
* Oversee the preparation of policy briefings and reports for key stakeholders.
* Ensure timely submission of reports to senior leadership, facilitating informed decision\-making and strategic planning.



  





**7\. Supervisory Responsibilities:** 



* Mentor and provide performance oversight for the Office Staff team members.
* Foster a collaborative environment that encourages proactive problem\-solving and innovation.
* Oversee team collaboration and ensure team members have the resources and guidance needed to achieve key objectives.



  





**Essential Professional Experience / Skills** 




 This role requires a dynamic, strategic thinker with exceptional interpersonal skills and a deep understanding of the interplay between government and business. The ideal candidate will be adept at navigating complex stakeholder landscapes and passionate about fostering collaborations that advance the Office's interests on the global stage.
 


* Minimum of 10 years of experience in senior management roles involving partnerships, strategic insights, and event convenings, ideally in government or diplomatic settings.
* Proven track record of developing and sustaining high\-level partnerships across business and governmental sectors.
* Strong understanding of the global landscape of business and diplomacy, with experience in strategic research and insights generation.
* Exceptional communication, networking, and relationship\-building skills with a diplomatic approach.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to oversee multiple large\-scale projects simultaneously.
* Fluency in English; Arabic language skills are highly desirable.
* Experience in leading and managing diverse, multicultural teams.

data.jd_text:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

 By concentrating on healthcare’s toughest challenges, we’ve been able to make many major breakthroughs, improving lives around the world. But there’s still work to be done.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are seeking a Patient Journey Partner (PJP) to join our team.
   

  

 The Patient Journey Partner (PJP) is at the center of the new Roche organization, turning upside down the role we play in society \- from mostly offering world\-class medicines towards much more partnering, innovating and leading generative disruption. By doing so the PJP will be directly accountable to deliver better outcomes for patients, their community, the ecosystem and the organisation, faster.
   

  

 The PJP is an empowered leader and the local face of Roche. She or he partners closely with all stakeholders directly touching the patient journey (in a given therapeutic or disease area), gaining a deep understanding of their needs in order to connect Roche’s capabilities to co\-create meaningful solutions.
   

  

 This role is locally embedded in the ecosystem, it is an integrated role, functionally agnostic, (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs)
   

  

 It has no profitability, sales objectives or incentives
   

  

**Your Impact**
 The PJP is a senior level role within the affiliate, who has decision making authority to request resources of Roche (both within the affiliate and broader network) in order to have improved impact on the patient journey
   

  

* The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem
* Acts as trusted partner and is the primary (but non\-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche; the PJP shares the patient and stakeholder community needs internally, prioritizes and secures resources, and drives solutions that deliver outcomes faster
* Partners with patient journey stakeholders to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community
* Stewards Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supports their appropriate use, which includes sharing their merits with HCPs in a truthful and balanced manner
* By overseeing the patient journey in its entirety, the PJP acts as a system thinker with the ability to identify shared purpose among stakeholders and leverages this to co\-create solutions with stakeholders in the ecosystem
* The role is empowered to pull in expertise and resources locally and from the network as needed, including in collaboration with other PJPs
* Ensuring great experiences whenever stakeholders in the ecosystem engage with Roche employees, products and services


**Who You Are**
* You possess a university degree in a scientific, economic, or business field; an advanced degree in life sciences or an MBA is a plus
* You have a proven track record in leading cross\-functional teams, formulating strategies, and orchestrating execution, with experience partnering with patient advocacy groups (PAGs) being highly desirable

* Drive early access strategies including:
* Named Patient Programs (NPPs)
* Compassionate use programs
* Managed access agreements
* Collaborate with Medical, Market Access, Regulatory, and Supply teams to ensure timely market entry.
* Develop launch readiness frameworks, KPIs, and tracking mechanisms.

* Partner with the Head of Global Commercial Oncology to ensure readiness for upcoming launches.
* Define target operating models for new markets.
* Support hiring strategy, role design, and capability frameworks (especially for distributor markets).
* Develop training frameworks and onboarding programs for new teams/partners.
* Resource Allocation \& Financial Planning
* Lead commercial budgeting and resource allocation across emerging markets.
* Optimize deployment of financial and human resources based on market potential and strategic priority.
* Track ROI on launch investments and commercial initiatives.
* Support long\-range planning (LRP) and annual operating plans (AOP).
* Strategic Planning \& Governance
* Act as a strategic advisor and deputy to the Head of Global Commercial Oncology.
* Support development of global oncology commercial strategy.
* Lead cross\-functional governance forums and business reviews.
* Drive alignment across global, regional, and local stakeholders.
* Cross\-Functional Leadership
* Serve as a central coordination point across: Medical Affairs, Market Access, Regulatory, Supply Chain, Finance
* Ensure integrated execution of launch and commercialization plans.
* Competitive Intelligence \& Market Insights
* Monitor competitive landscape across oncology markets.

* Ensure all commercial activities adhere to global compliance standards and local regulations.

* Successful launch of oncology assets in priority emerging markets.

* Budget adherence and ROI optimization.
* Distributor performance and market expansion outcomes.

* Global Oncology Franchise \& Brand Teams
* Country Medical Affairs, Market Access, Regulatory, Finance, and Supply Chain


**Desired Experience And Knowledge**
**Educational**
* MBA or master’s degree in business, Life Sciences, or related field preferred


**Experience**
* 12–15\+ years of pharmaceutical / biotech experience, with a strong focus on innovative oncology.
* Proven track record in global or regional commercial roles
* Experience in launch excellence, emerging markets, or distributor\-led markets.
* Experience operating in complex, fast\-evolving oncology markets.
* Prior country\-level or franchise leadership experience is strongly preferred.


**Knowledge And Skills (Functional And Technical)**
* Strong understanding of oncology market access and early access pathways.
* Experience with CRM systems (e.g., Veeva, Salesforce).
* Ability to work in cross functional groups and teams with a complex matrix organization.
* Ability to operate in ambiguity and build new market structures
* Exceptional stakeholder management, influence, and communication skills.
* Data\-driven decision\-making
* Entrepreneurial mindset with strong ownership
* High ethical standards with uncompromising compliance orientation.

The role delivers manufacturing excellence aligned with business strategy, approved budgets, and customer requirements, while ensuring compliance with UAE regulatory authorities and international standards.

data.jd_text:
At Lummus Technology, innovation thrives, and excellence is a shared pursuit. When you join Lummus, you are empowered to make an impact and be part of a dynamic team that celebrates creativity, encourages professional development, and fosters collaboration.
   

  

 From our technology portfolio to our global workforce, Lummus is growing at a rapid pace, and we hope that you will grow with us during this exciting time.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants International (LCI) is an autonomous business within Lummus Technology that provides technical, environmental \& social and management consulting services worldwide. We work primarily in the energy industry, with a depth of expertise in power generation, oil \& gas, refining and petrochemicals. We maintain a very strong presence in the international technical due diligence markets to support the global financial industry. LCI has a far\-reaching organization with offices in the United States, UK, the Middle East and Asia.
   

  

 Lummus Consultants is looking for a Business Development Director to grow the company into the area of technical and management consulting in the energy industry – offshore and onshore oil \& gas, LNG, pipelines, power generation and transmission, as well as refining and petrochemicals. This role will be expected to help grow the consulting practice area in the fields of oil\& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization and will primarily entail growing relationships with the financial community and project developers. Assignments require a high level of experience and ability to focus quickly on important issues.
   

  

 The individual we are seeking must be comfortable and confident to work in a seller/doer organization structure.
   

  

**Position**
 The Business Development Director will be expected to grow and lead a new consulting practice area in the fields of Oil \& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization. The group VP and the Leadership Team should have contacts and skills to help him achieve this goal. An international focus is expected. Areas of skill and knowledge should include knowledge of project financing, capex benchmarking analysis, O\&M practices and costs, M\&A support, due diligence and strategy development. The candidate will be expected to lead and participate in advisory assignments, conduct business development, and manage his/her practice business area and interface with Lummus Consultants’ senior management. Additional business areas may be identified based upon the candidate’s personal history and strengths and interests.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities/Accountabilities**
* Grow Lummus Consultants’ business – in cooperation with the existing business heads. His growth strategy should be heavily focused on technical solutions but with a broad business perspective beyond traditional due diligence assignments.
* Develop a business plan to capitalize on existing talents and resources within Lummus Consultants and Lummus Technology; the candidate’s strengths; and market opportunities.
* Grow name recognition of Lummus Consultants in all Energy industry segments (with assistance from the Lummus Communication team and other internal resources).
* Carry out business development, marketing, and proposal preparation efforts and lead Key Account Management teams efforts.
* Lead or participate in consulting project work.
* Prepare clear and concise written reports on assignments, develop conclusions and present clear and precise written and verbal results to clients.
* Expand the Lummus Consulting practice area (globally), consistent with the business plan – identify gaps in skills and potential recruits.
* Achieve objectives with minimal oversight.
* Management of the P\&L forecast by close collaboration with his supervisor and finance.
* Report to Senior Director of Lummus Consultants in Dubai office.


**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities Required**
* Strong leadership abilities and excellent interpersonal skills
* Strong communicator with excellent written and oral communication skills
* Must have a high degree of self\-motivation and energy
* Must have proven ability to manage business forecasting, short and long term projection
* Capability of earning respect from the team and capable of influencing others without authority
* Excellent professional image/presentation
* Knowledge of many cultures/international style
* Strong commercial savvy and negotiating skills
* Interest in being knowledgeable in all services offerings in Lummus Consultants portfolio
* Ability to work well with finance partners.
* Must have a strong balance of technical and commercial capabilities.


**Basic Qualifications**
* A degree\-educated Engineer; MBA is a plus but not required.
* The candidate should have at least 20 years relevant professional experience.
* Prior experience with an owner/operator or major engineering company and/or consultancy.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including ability to write clear and concise reports in English.
* The candidate should have strong interpersonal skills and be comfortable conversing with clients and senior management
* Demonstrated management and project management skills


**Office Location and Travel:**
* Dubai office. Relocation is not being offered.
* Job\-related travel (business trips usually requiring less than a two\-week duration; often just one or two days) which includes international travel to financial institutions in London, is an important part of the work. Time away from the office may average 10 to 30 percent of work hours.


 Lummus Technology is the global leader in developing technology solutions that make modern life possible and focus on a more sustainable, low carbon future. We license process technologies in clean fuels, renewables, petrochemicals, polymers, gas processing and supply lifecycle services, catalysts, proprietary equipment and digitalization to customers worldwide.

data.jd_text:
Would you like to contribute to Haskoning’s ambitious Strategy in the Middle East? The region is one of our strategic focus areas, currently with Water and Maritime at its core. Haskoning aims to build on this core to accelerate growth and expand other parts of the businesses through a cross\-business line Advisory Group.
   

  

**What You Do As a Director Advisory Group**
 As the Director of the Advisory Group (DAG) Water \& Maritime Middle East, you will lead, develop, and empower a dynamic international team of 30 plus highly skilled professionals based primarily in the United Arab Emirates, Oman and Saudia Arabia. You will be supported by the management team of Water \& Maritime Americas Middle East \& India and the Associate Directors in the Advisory Group based in Oman and the United Arab Emirates. In this pivotal role, you will not just manage a team — you will spearhead growth, drive innovation, and shape the future of the Haskoning business in the Middle East in a way that enhances sustainability and resilience for clients across the globe.
   

  

 Furthermore, you will also lead the development and growth of a cross\-business line Advisory Group. The group currently comprises around 10 staff and is expected to grow to approximately 50 over the next four years. You will be responsible for executing the group’s growth strategy, developing a strong and diverse team, and creating effective collaboration across different parts of Haskoning’s global business. This will include identifying new client opportunities, shaping multidisciplinary advisory services, strengthening relationships with key internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring the group achieves sustainable commercial performance. You will play a central role in establishing the cross\-business Advisory Group as a recognised platform for integrated advisory services in the Middle East, with a focus on growth, innovation, client impact, and long\-term value for Haskoning.
   

  

 In addition to the Director of Advisory Group it is expected that you will in due course assume responsibilities of Resident Director for the UAE. In this capacity, you will act as Haskoning’s senior representative in the United Arab Emirates, providing country\-level leadership across all Business Lines and Global Leading Markets. Resident Director is responsible for the effective management of the UAE entity, ensuring that local operations are aligned with company strategy, governance requirements, and regional and global priorities. This includes oversight of statutory and regulatory compliance, company registrations, finance and taxation, payroll, human resources, visas and work permits, facilities management, health and safety, risk management, and the overall performance and culture of the local office. Resident Director will also represent Haskoning with clients, partners, authorities, and other key stakeholders, helping to strengthen our market position, safeguard business continuity, and enable sustainable growth in the UAE.
   

  

 This opportunity has arisen as the current incumbent moves into a new role within Haskoning. We are seeking a successor who is committed to the Haskoning group and the region for the long term.
   

  

 Key Performance Indicators:
   

  

* P\&L Responsibility, Commercial success and continuous improvement: Drive the commercial and financial success of the Advisory Group by fostering co\-creation with global clients and partners. Generate focused growth in our key markets by connecting teams within the Advisory Group and with other expertise centres across the globe.
* Stakeholder management: Build strong communication channels within and outside Haskoning to encourage seamless cooperation and create a distinct, unified identity. You will serve as the glue that holds teams together, fostering relationships that accelerate both business and environmental impact.
* People management: Cultivate an environment and culture where both individuals and the business can thrive. Develop the Advisory Group strategy as part of Haskoning’s overarching corporate and Business Line / Business Unit strategies and enable the Associate Directors to implement it successfully under your guidance and leadership.


* Project Delivery (of proof of concepts, projects and support contracts), including:
+ Meeting client's expectations, achieving required scope and quality
+ Driving Financial performance
+ Promoting solid and accountable project management practices.


 You will report directly to the Business Unit Director of Water \& Maritime Americas Middle East \& India and be a key member of the Business Unit Management Team, collaborating on the broader vision and strategy of our business.
   

  

**Where will you work**
 Haskoning is a globally established and operating independent consultancy, engineering and project management firm which integrates over 140 years of domain expertise with digital technologies and software solutions. Our 6,500 colleagues work from offices in more than 25 countries across the world. Through our mission Enhancing Society Together, we take responsibility for having a positive impact on the planet.
   

  

 You will be based in our Dubai office with frequent travel across the region.
   

  

**What You Bring**
 We are looking for a visionary leader with a strategic mindset. You thrive in dynamic environments, have a natural ability to lead and inspire diverse teams, and are ready to drive the next chapter of growth for the Middle East.
   

  

* Higher Education in engineering, management or environmental disciplines;
* Extensive Experience in Engineering Consultancy in the Maritime or related industry, also with the knowledge of the Energy \& Industry sectors being advantageous;
* Minimum of 5 years Line management (including P\&L) responsibility, with proven experience to lead teams of at least 30 people;
* A network of clients in the Middle East region is a significant advantage;
* General management and entity management experience is an advantage;
* Fluent in English with the ability to engage stakeholders across cultures and geographies. Arabic would be an advantage but is not essential;
* An international outlook, with experience working in diverse, multicultural environments, ensuring effective communication across borders


**What we offer**
 Within our company you will be able to develop yourself while working on challenging projects across the globe. Besides that, we also offer:
   

  

* A good work\-life balance, with the flexibility to work from home up to 2 days per week;
* 25 annual leave days per year, based on a 40\-hour work week;
* A competitive salary package;
* Lifelong learning by offering you plenty of training \& development opportunities.
* Profit share based on company profit.
* Medical insurance


**Are you our new colleague?**
 We would like to meet you! Click on the apply button and upload your resume and motivation letter. After receiving your application, we will contact you as soon as possible. Are we all enthusiastic after this? Then you will receive an offer from us, and we will be happy to welcome you on board!
   

  

 In case of questions, please contact Anouk de Winter, recruiter, anouk.de.winter@haskoning.com.
   

  

 Please note the deadline for receiving applications is Wednesday the 15th of July 2026\.
   

  

 Due to the privacy law, please submit your application via the apply button and not via email.
   

  

***Acquisition of this vacancy by agencies is not appreciated and the candidates offered will not be taken into consideration.***
