data.jd_text:
**Locations** 
 : Dubai \| Riyadh
   

  

 Who We Are
   

  

 The Middle East IT Service Manager is the face of Tech@BCG in a key market for BCG. Spanning Dubai, Riyadh, Doha, Abu Dhabi, and Kuwait, this role is not a back\-office function: it is the primary connection between a demanding regional business and the global IT organisation. Local business leadership knows this person by name, calls them first, and relies on them to make technology work.
   

  

 The role sits at the intersection of the local business and the IT function. It owns regional IT service delivery end to end, manages senior stakeholder relationships, feeds office demand and business feedback into the IT organisation, and ensures that what is built and delivered globally actually works for the Middle East. The person in this role represents the business to IT, and IT to the business.
   

  

 In practice, this means running a tight operation, governing vendors and contracts with discipline, driving a sustained shift towards automation and AI\-enabled support, and always knowing what the numbers are telling you. It requires someone equally comfortable in a service review and a conversation with a Managing Director, who understands that trust with the business is the foundation everything else is built on.
   

  

 Beyond operations, this role demands a genuine people leader. Someone who invests in their team, listens before they act, and creates an environment where people do their best work. Within the broader EMESA IT Service community, this person is a collaborative and engaged peer: sharing what works, supporting colleagues across other regions, and contributing to a function that is stronger because its leaders work well together. If you lead with integrity, bring others with you, and take the success of the team as seriously as your own, this role is for you.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Stakeholder Relationships \& Business Partnering
* Serve as the primary point of contact for local business leadership across all Middle East offices as the face of Tech@BCG in the region
* Actively manage senior stakeholder relationships, building trust with office leadership and ensuring IT is seen as a partner, not a utility
* Capture, consolidate, and feed local business demand and feedback into the global IT organisation and translating office needs into inputs the IT function can act on
* Own the senior escalation path for critical incidents and high\-impact service events, and maintain playbooks for executive support and key office moments
* Capacity \& Financial Management
* Ensure regional capacity is managed in line with global and functional targets, escalating deviations and translating business demand into resourcing inputs for the IT organisation
* Build cost\-to\-serve visibility at office level to support data\-led conversations with both local leadership and global IT
* Challenge and reduce local service deviations where demand doesn’t justify them
* Drive the shift from human\-touch support to automation and self\-service. This is a direction of travel, not a one\-off project
* Automation \& AI\-Enabled Support
* Set and own targets for no\-contact and low\-contact resolution rates across the region
* Build out self\-service capabilities for high\-frequency, routine requests: if a human is handling it repeatedly, it should be automated
* Embed AI\-assisted triage and resolution tooling into local support workflows
* Maintain a live automation backlog and convert repeat demand into scalable workflows systematically
* Improve ticket and knowledge quality to cut engineering escalations and break the cycle of recurring incidents
* Security, Compliance \& Resilience
* Ensure secure fulfilment patterns are embedded in all service workflows, not treated as a separate workstream
* Enforce compliance with device management, access control, and privileged support standards
* Minimise operational risk through disciplined change management and resilience practices
* Partner closely with ISRM: regional security posture is a shared responsibility and I expect you to own your side of i


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* 8–12\+ years in IT Service Management, Digital Workplace, or End\-User Computing leadership
* Proven experience running multi\-site or regional service delivery across geographically dispersed teams
* Background in service transformation or operating model redesign : you have changed how a function works, not just run it
* Hands\-on familiarity with AI\-enabled / automated support tooling and modern ESM platforms
* Strong grounding in financial management, capacity planning, and cost\-to\-serve modelling
* Vendor management and contract governance experience in a contracted or hybrid delivery model
* Fluent English; Arabic proficiency is a genuine advantage in this region
* Readiness to travel occasionally across Middle East office locations : presence matters here

Established in 2004, Dubai Holding is a global investment company with investments in more than 34 countries and a combined workforce of nearly 45,000 individuals. In line with the vision of Dubai’s leadership and economic diversification strategy, Dubai Holding companies have nurtured sectors, irrevocably transforming Dubai’s socio\-economic landscape and positioning Dubai as a diversified, globally integrated economy.
 



  





 Dubai Holding is committed to the diversification of Dubai’s non\-oil economy. Our portfolio, valued at over AED 284\+ billion, spans 10 sectors, including real estate, hospitality, leisure \& entertainment, ICT, design, education, media, retail, manufacturing \& logistics, and science.
 



  





**For the Good of Tomorrow** 




  





 Dubai Holding is looking to hire a
 **Vice President – Digital Engineering** 
 within the
 **Information Technology Department** 
 at Dubai Holding Corporate. The role holder is responsible for defining and executing the Group\-wide Digital Engineering and Platform Strategy, with direct accountability for the design, build, and scaling of enterprise technology capabilities across AI, ERP platforms, Integration Services, Digital Products, and Service Orchestration.
 



  





 The role ensures that enterprise technology platforms are strategically aligned with Dubai Holding’s business priorities, enabling scalable growth, operational efficiency, and differentiated customer experiences. A key focus is the governance and execution of integrated product and platform roadmaps across these domains to drive long\-term value creation.
 



  





 The role acts as a strategic partner to the Group CTO and business leadership, translating technology strategy into integrated, platform\-driven capabilities that accelerate growth, efficiency, and enterprise value.
 



  





**Role Relationships:** 




  




* Group CTO, Group and Vertical Technology Teams, Strategy \& Value Creation, Business Verticals, Technology Vendors, System Integrators, Cloud \& Platform Providers

**Key Accountabilities:** 




  





**Group Digital Engineering \& Platform Strategy** 




  




* Define and own the enterprise\-wide Digital Engineering strategy aligned to Group and vertical priorities

* Drive platform consolidation, standardisation, and reuse across business units
* Translate business priorities into coherent cross\-domain platform strategies



  





**Product Roadmap Ownership \& Strategic Alignment** 



* Own definition, governance, and execution of product and platform roadmaps
* Align technology investments with business value creation objectives
* Prioritise initiatives based on ROI, strategic importance, and enterprise impact
* Eliminate duplication and fragmentation through centralised roadmap governance



  





**AI \& Intelligent Platform Enablement** 




  




* Define and execute the Group AI strategy across enterprise platforms
* Identify and scale high\-value data and AI use cases (automation, personalisation, analytics)
* Establish AI platform capabilities including data foundations, model lifecycle, and MLOps
* Drive enterprise adoption of AI\-enabled services



  





**ERP \& Core Enterprise Platforms** 




  




* Own strategy, operation and transformation of ERP platforms (Oracle) and adjacent systems
* Lead consolidation, simplification, and standardisation across business entities in line with Enterprise Architectural patterns
* Ensure ERP technology\-stack supports scalable, integrated, and efficient business operations
* Review and align ERP roadmap with business capability needs



  





**Integration Services \& Enterprise Connectivity** 




  




* Define and lead Group\-wide integration strategy (APIs, middleware, event\-driven architecture)
* Build, operate and scale integration platforms (API gateways, iPaaS) (Informatica, Frends)
* Establish standardised integration patterns to eliminate complexity
* Enable seamless interoperability across enterprise and vertical systems



  





**Digital Products \& Services** 




  




* Lead strategy and delivery of Group IT digital product platforms
* Define product operating models, lifecycle management, and engineering frameworks
* Drive development of scalable, reusable digital services
* Align digital product outcomes with growth, engagement, and customer experience
* Evaluate, implement and scale blockchain and tokenisation platforms to support digital asset enablement, new business models, and ecosystem partnerships with Strategy \& Value Creation



  





**Service Orchestration \& Platform Operating Model** 




  




* Define and implement service orchestration capabilities (ServiceNow)
* Enable end\-to\-end service delivery across ERP, integration, and digital layers
* Establish frameworks to unify fragmented workflows and services
* Drive adoption of platform\-based operating models



  





**Engineering Excellence \& Delivery** 




  




* Establish best\-in\-class engineering practices (DevSecOps, CI/CD, agile delivery)
* Drive engineering quality, productivity, and scalability
* Lead complex transformation programmes across multiple entities
* Ensure delivery aligns with strategic priorities and roadmap commitment



  





**Stakeholder Collaboration \& Communication** 




  




* Act as a trusted advisor to Group CTO and senior leadership across the Group
* Translate technology strategies into clear business outcomes
* Align stakeholders across technology, product, and business domains
* Provide executive\-level communication and reporting



  





**Vendor \& Partner Ecosystem** 




  




* Define and manage strategic partnerships (ERP, cloud, AI, platforms)
* Oversee system integrators and delivery partners
* Ensure vendor accountability, performance, and value realisation
* Continuously scout market for potential future technologies and partners to support the long\-term Group IT Strategy



  





**Who we are looking for:** 




  




* 12–15\+ years in large\-scale enterprise technology delivery and operations
* 8–10\+ years in senior leadership roles managing large engineering and product organisations
* Proven experience leading enterprise\-wide transformation programmes
* Experience in complex, multi\-entity organisations (real\-estate, hospitality, construction or similar sectors preferred)



  





**Education/Professional Certification:** 









**Minimum requirements** 



* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or related field
* Master’s Degree (MBA or MSc) strongly preferred
* PMP / PRINCE2
* ITIL v4
* TOGAF or Enterprise Architecture certifications
* Agile / SAFe certifications
* 



**Technical Competencies:** 




  




* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills

 Deep expertise across:

**Behavioural Competencies:**

**Help Us Build The Future of Travel**
 At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200\+ countries and regions around the world.
   

  

 Today, we're a team of 400\+ people across 60\+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.
   

  

 We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone.
   

  

**Your Next Destination** 
  

  

* Location: Remote, anywhere in Spain, the UK, or the UAE.
* Contract:
+ Spain: Full\-time, permanent contrato indefinido via Deel (our employer of record in Spain)
+ UK: Full\-time, permanent (local contract)
+ UAE: Full\-time, permanent via Deel (our employer of record in the UAE)

* Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async.


 Airalo is looking for a Strategy Director to join its growing Strategy team and become a driver in shaping the strategic direction of the company. This position will support in driving critical strategic initiatives, and contributing to the company's growth and success.The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in strategy consulting or a similar role, demonstrating exceptional leadership, analytical skills, and a deep understanding of business strategy and business planning.
   

  

**Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To**
**Responsibilities include but are not limited to:** 
  

  

* Strategy planning and execution:
+ Conduct in\-depth research and analysis to support strategic decision\-making across various areas, including market analysis, competitive intelligence, and financial modeling.
+ Oversee the implementation of the PMO driving strategic initiatives, ensuring alignment across departments and tracking progress against key metrics.
+ Manage strategic projects from initiation to completion, ensuring on\-time delivery and achieving desired outcomes.
+ Identify and evaluate new business opportunities for expansion and growth.
+ Monitor industry trends and competitive landscape, providing regular updates to the strategy team.
+ Identify potential risks and opportunities for the company.

* Performance management \& OKRs
+ Own the design and evolution of the OKR framework
+ Drive company\-wide OKR cycles (setting, alignment, tracking)
+ Support and lead/co\-lead on monthly / quarterly business reviews (MBRs/QBRs)
+ Identify performance gaps and drive corrective actions with stakeholders
+ Establish performance culture (accountability, transparency, data\-driven decisions)

* Corporate Development and M\&A:
+ Support the preparation of investor materials and participate in investor meetings as needed
+ Develop and maintain relationships with existing and potential investors and strategic partners.
+ Support in the development of M\&A strategy and framework
+ Assist in the identification, evaluation, and execution of potential M\&A transactions, including due diligence and financial analysis
+ Ensure to have an always up to date pitch deck and data room for the company

* Investor Relations:
+ Facilitate communication between the executive team and the board of directors.
+ Prepare and distribute materials for board meetings, including agendas, reports, and presentations.
+ Coordinate logistics for board meetings, ensuring that all necessary information is provided to board members in a timely manner.
+ Assist in the implementation of board decisions and resolutions.
+ Develop and implement strategies to enhance shareholder value and promote confidence in the organization.
+ Address shareholder concerns and inquiries, ensuring a positive and transparent communication process


**Must Haves**
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, such as business administration, economics, finance or engineering.
* 7\+ years of experience in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, or a related field, with a focus on technology or telecommunications.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information and develop actionable recommendations.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships and influence stakeholders at all levels.
* Demonstrated experience in M\&A transactions, due diligence, financial modeling, and strategic planning.


**Good To Have**
* MBA or equivalent advanced degree
* Experience or exposure to global consumer technology companies
* Demonstrated leadership experience, with the ability to manage and mentor a team of high\-performing individuals.


 £100,500 \- £136,500 a year
   

  

 At Airalo, we believe in roaming\-free recruitment. Just as we provide clear connectivity for travelers, we provide clear salary ranges for our candidates. 🌍

 📍 Spain: €89,000 \- €120,000
   

  

 Your Home Destination: 🛫 Specific salary ranges used in offers are determined by where you reside. We’re committed to discussing these ranges openly during your first call with our Talent to ensure we’re aligned for takeoff! 🎒✨
   

  

**Why People Join Us** 
**🇪🇸 Why people join us in Spain**
 We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product were customers first.
   

  

 Our team is united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact.
   

  

 For many of our teammates in Spain, it's the combination of stability, flexibility, and genuine work\-life balance that makes Airalo feel like home.
   

  

**🇬🇧 Why people join us in the UK**
 We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product first discovered us as customers.
   

  

 Our team spans 60\+ countries, but what people often notice quickly is how work actually feels here. There's trust to own what you do, space to focus without constant layers of process, and a clear sense of what you're responsible for from day one.
   

  

 As Airalo continues to grow, people tend to stay for a mix of things: the chance to work on a product used globally, the autonomy to shape how they work, and the opportunity to keep taking on new challenges without getting stuck in one lane.
   

  

**🇦🇪 Why people join us in the UAE**
 We're a fully remote team across 60\+ countries, built on a simple idea: trust people to own their work and deliver without unnecessary layers or heavy process getting in the way.
   

  

 Many people joining us from the UAE are looking for clarity in scope and real ownership in their role. They want to know what they're responsible for, how success is measured, and have direct access to the people making decisions.
   

  

 What often stands out is the combination of a global, product\-led company with a flexible remote setup. For many, it's the opportunity to work on a product used by millions of travelers worldwide, alongside a team that moves quickly and values clear ownership and accountability.

Rest assured that these checks will only occur upon your prior consent and at the end of the selection process, and will be strictly limited to what is allowed under the laws that are applicable to you.  We sincerely thank all applicants in advance for submitting their interest in this opportunity. Airalo is an equal\-opportunity employer and values diversity, equity \& inclusion. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. **Director Advisory Group Water \& Maritime Middle East** 




 Would you like to contribute to Haskoning’s ambitious Strategy in the Middle East? The region is one of our strategic focus areas, currently with Water and Maritime at its core. Haskoning aims to build on this core to accelerate growth
data.jd_text:
**Director Advisory Group Water \& Maritime Middle East** 




 Would you like to contribute to Haskoning’s ambitious Strategy in the Middle East? The region is one of our strategic focus areas, currently with Water and Maritime at its core. Haskoning aims to build on this core to accelerate growth and expand other parts of the businesses through a cross\-business line Advisory Group.
 



  





**What you do as a Director Advisory Group** 




 As the Director of the Advisory Group (DAG) Water \& Maritime Middle East, you will lead, develop, and empower a dynamic international team of 30 plus highly skilled professionals based primarily in the United Arab Emirates, Oman and Saudia Arabia. You will be supported by the management team of Water \& Maritime Americas Middle East \& India and the Associate Directors in the Advisory Group based in Oman and the United Arab Emirates. In this pivotal role, you will not just manage a team — you will spearhead growth, drive innovation, and shape the future of the Haskoning business in the Middle East in a way that enhances sustainability and resilience for clients across the globe.
 



  





 Furthermore, you will also lead the development and growth of a cross\-business line Advisory Group. The group currently comprises around 10 staff and is expected to grow to approximately 50 over the next four years. You will be responsible for executing the group’s growth strategy, developing a strong and diverse team, and creating effective collaboration across different parts of Haskoning’s global business. This will include identifying new client opportunities, shaping multidisciplinary advisory services, strengthening relationships with key internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring the group achieves sustainable commercial performance. You will play a central role in establishing the cross\-business Advisory Group as a recognised platform for integrated advisory services in the Middle East, with a focus on growth, innovation, client impact, and long\-term value for Haskoning.
 



  





 In addition to the Director of Advisory Group it is expected that you will in due course assume responsibilities of Resident Director for the UAE. In this capacity, you will act as Haskoning’s senior representative in the United Arab Emirates, providing country\-level leadership across all Business Lines and Global Leading Markets. Resident Director is responsible for the effective management of the UAE entity, ensuring that local operations are aligned with company strategy, governance requirements, and regional and global priorities. This includes oversight of statutory and regulatory compliance, company registrations, finance and taxation, payroll, human resources, visas and work permits, facilities management, health and safety, risk management, and the overall performance and culture of the local office. Resident Director will also represent Haskoning with clients, partners, authorities, and other key stakeholders, helping to strengthen our market position, safeguard business continuity, and enable sustainable growth in the UAE.
 



  





 This opportunity has arisen as the current incumbent moves into a new role within Haskoning. We are seeking a successor who is committed to the Haskoning group and the region for the long term.
 



 Key Performance Indicators:
 


* **P\&L Responsibility, Commercial success and continuous improvement** 
 : Drive the commercial and financial success of the Advisory Group by fostering co\-creation with global clients and partners. Generate focused growth in our key markets by connecting teams within the Advisory Group and with other expertise centres across the globe.



  




* **Stakeholder management:** 
 Build strong communication channels within and outside Haskoning to encourage seamless cooperation and create a distinct, unified identity. You will serve as the glue that holds teams together, fostering relationships that accelerate both business and environmental impact.



  




* **People management** 
 : Cultivate an environment and culture where both individuals and the business can thrive. Develop the Advisory Group strategy as part of Haskoning’s overarching corporate and Business Line / Business Unit strategies and enable the Associate Directors to implement it successfully under your guidance and leadership.



  




* **Project Delivery** 
 (of proof of concepts, projects and support contracts), including:



 \-Meeting client's expectations, achieving required scope and quality
 



 \-Driving Financial performance
 



 \-Promoting solid and accountable project management practices.
 



  





 You will report directly to the Business Unit Director of Water \& Maritime Americas Middle East \& India and be a key member of the Business Unit Management Team, collaborating on the broader vision and strategy of our business.
 



  





**Where will you work** 




 Haskoning is a globally established and operating independent consultancy, engineering and project management firm which integrates over 140 years of domain expertise with digital technologies and software solutions. Our 6,500 colleagues work from offices in more than 25 countries across the world. Through our mission Enhancing Society Together, we take responsibility for having a positive impact on the planet.
 



 You will be based in our Dubai office with frequent travel across the region.
 



  





**What you bring** 




 We are looking for a visionary leader with a strategic mindset. You thrive in dynamic environments, have a natural ability to lead and inspire diverse teams, and are ready to drive the next chapter of growth for the Middle East.
 



  




* Higher Education in engineering, management or environmental disciplines;
* Extensive Experience in Engineering Consultancy in the Maritime or related industry, also with the knowledge of the Energy \& Industry sectors being advantageous;
* Minimum of 5 years Line management (including P\&L) responsibility, with proven experience to lead teams of at least 30 people;
* A network of clients in the Middle East region is a significant advantage;
* General management and entity management experience is an advantage;
* Fluent in English with the ability to engage stakeholders across cultures and geographies. Arabic would be an advantage but is not essential;
* An international outlook, with experience working in diverse, multicultural environments, ensuring effective communication across borders



  





**What we offer** 




 Within our company you will be able to develop yourself while working on challenging projects across the globe. Besides that, we also offer:
 


* A good work\-life balance, with the flexibility to work from home up to 2 days per week;
* 25 annual leave days per year, based on a 40\-hour work week;
* A competitive salary package;
* Lifelong learning by offering you plenty of training \& development opportunities.
* Profit share based on company profit.
* Medical insurance



  





**Are you our new colleague?** 




 We would like to meet you! Click on the apply button and upload your resume and motivation letter. After receiving your application, we will contact you as soon as possible. Are we all enthusiastic after this? Then you will receive an offer from us, and we will be happy to welcome you on board!
 



 In case of questions, please contact Anouk de Winter, recruiter, anouk.de.winter@haskoning.com.
 



 Please note the deadline for receiving applications is Wednesday the 15th of July 2026\.
 



  





 Due to the privacy law, please submit your application via the apply button and not via email.
 



***Acquisition of this vacancy by agencies is not appreciated and the candidates offered will not be taken into consideration.***

data.jd_text:
The Construction Manager – Electrical is responsible for the comprehensive planning, execution, and delivery of medium to large\-scale EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) projects, particularly in the power and infrastructure sectors. The role requires a highly experienced professional with a Degree Electrical Engineering and 8 to 15 years of proven experience in executing electrical projects across Gulf countries and/or India. The candidate must possess strong technical knowledge and leadership skills to handle complex project environments, including substations, power plants, and overhead transmission line projects.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have extensive experience in the construction of medium and large substations, including associated civil and electrical works. Demonstrated expertise in handling power projects such as high\-voltage substations, transmission networks, and overhead lines is essential. The Construction Manager will be accountable for overseeing all construction activities, ensuring adherence to project specifications, design drawings, and contractual obligations.
   

  

 A key responsibility of this role is to ensure the smooth execution of the entire project lifecycle, from mobilization to commissioning and final handover. The candidate must possess strong project management skills to coordinate effectively with clients, consultants, subcontractors, and vendors. The role demands excellent communication and interpersonal abilities to manage stakeholder expectations and resolve project\-related challenges efficiently.
   

  

 The Construction Manager must take full ownership of project timelines, ensuring that all activities are completed within the stipulated timeframe and budget. This includes planning resources, scheduling work, monitoring progress, and implementing corrective measures when required. Strong supervisory and leadership capabilities are critical, as the individual will be responsible for managing multidisciplinary teams and fostering a productive work environment.
   

  

 In addition to construction oversight, the candidate must ensure strict compliance with quality standards and Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) regulations. The role involves implementing and monitoring quality assurance and quality control processes to ensure that all works meet industry standards and client expectations. The Construction Manager must proactively identify and mitigate risks associated with construction activities, ensuring minimal disruption to project progress.
   

  

 Experience in subcontractor management is a crucial requirement for this position. The candidate should have a proven track record of selecting, managing, and coordinating subcontractors to ensure that all work is executed efficiently and in compliance with project specifications. This includes reviewing subcontractor performance, resolving disputes, and ensuring alignment with project objectives.
   

  

 Risk management is another key aspect of the role. The Construction Manager must identify potential project risks at an early stage and develop mitigation strategies to avoid delays or cost overruns. The ability to make informed decisions under pressure and adapt to changing project conditions is essential.
   

  

 The candidate must be self\-motivated, proactive, and capable of working independently while maintaining a collaborative approach within the project team. Strong problem\-solving skills are required to address technical and operational challenges effectively. Attention to detail, combined with the ability to see the bigger picture, will enable the successful delivery of projects that meet or exceed client expectations.
   

  

 Overall, the Construction Manager – Electrical will have full responsibility for managing and supervising all construction\-related activities, ensuring the successful execution and timely completion of projects in line with contractual commitments. This role offers an opportunity to work on challenging and high\-profile projects, contributing significantly to the development of power and infrastructure sectors in the region.

data.jd_text:
Inhabit is a unique, multi\-disciplinary team of professionals who are passionate about making a positive contribution to our built environment.
   

  





 We are a collective of experienced architects, designers, engineers and detailers who work both independently and in partnership to form a holistic approach to the services that we offer. We believe that our respective areas of expertise can be integrated to allow seamless interdisciplinary synergy to create buildings that are more relevant to our evolving society.
   

  





 We are focused on design\-led engineering, providing technical and comprehensive solutions that thoughtfully and creatively consider aesthetics, engineering, cost, procurement, and sustainability driving towards a building that is sensitive and inspirational within its socio\-cultural context.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

**List of Responsibilities**




 The Associate Director forms part of the engineering team within the global structure of the company and assumes responsibilities that pro\-actively contribute to the growth of Façade Engineering and specialist design and engineering team within the global structure of the Inhabit and Egis company structure.
   

  





 The role assumes both KPI based and general responsibilities that actively contribute to project technical and commercial delivery, compliance, functional wellbeing, advancement and growth of facade discipline and all other specialist and general disciplines.
   

  





 This includes responsibility for all design, engineering, documentation, administration and compliance with project constraints undertaken for façade and all other disciplines. You will lead, develop, and manage a team of approx. (5\-10\) direct reports. You may also need to fulfil any legal responsibilities commensurate with your position.
   

  





 This includes responsibility for team engagement and growth, technical excellence, ethics, project leadership, design, engineering, documentation, administration and compliance with project constraints undertaken by the facade team. You will also need to fulfill legal responsibilities commensurate with your position.
   

  





 The following is an overview of responsibilities and performance standards required of the Associate Director:
   

  




* Major Function
* Project Operation / Management
* Strategic Management
* Financial Management
* Marketing and Business Development
* Staff Management, Mentoring and Training
* Client Management
* Project Management
* Consultancy Function
* Technical Excellence
* Personal Growth



**Major Function**




 Duties include but not limited to:
   

  





  

  




* Represent Inhabit on projects with clients and provide technical leadership and assistance to ensure projects meet high quality standards and are managed in accordance with timeframes and budget parameters
* Conduct presentations of proposals for prospective clients and/or projects
* Create, build and maintain business opportunities
* Manage projects and resources to ensure professional services are achieved and deliver high quality focused services on projects to ensure client satisfaction and repeat business
* Participate in a yearly management meeting to develop and contribute to strategic business planning and to set personal KPI’s relevant to your role
* Report to the Director on your performance and the performance of the team as directed
* Attend meetings with clients to manage projects according to Inhabits scope of services
* Provide training and mentoring to the team as the need arises always promoting inclusion and growth for all staff under your leadership
* Prepare project proposals including, where necessary, co\-ordination of inputs from other disciplines and report these bids / wins / losses to the Director
* Maintain regular contact with existing or prospective clients for establishing potential future work
* Active participation in a broad range of client\-focused functions to enhance the professional image of Inhabit
* Assist the Director with staff performance reviews
* Carry out research on potential materials and share knowledge and update technical library
* Keep up to date with relevant design software and products new to the market that will help develop our business
* Maintain an intimate knowledge of relevant codes and standards
* Continually strive to improve technical knowledge and encourage team technical discussions
* Evaluate opportunities for improved efficiencies and effectiveness in consultation with the Director including identifying, developing and implementing standards, systems, tools and processes to support improvement within the business
* Take an active interest in the other disciplines (BMU, Acoustics, Lighting, Sustainability, FLS etc.) to further develop your specialist skills



**Project Operation/ Management**




 You shall be responsible for profitable completion of all projects and tasks under your control whilst maintaining excellent technical standards and client satisfaction. Detailed responsibilities and/or targets include:
   

  




* Assist in the management of the project team in terms of time and cost
* Cost planning and outputs required to meet project budgets
* Business Development and marketing material preparation
* Managing clients to secure work, marketing and fee proposals
* Updating of the administrative systems for recording proposal activities
* Allocation and management of time to suit programs and project budgets
* Ensure projects are completed on\-time and without cost overrun
* Ensure high technical standing on the project such that client complaints do not arise.



**Strategic Management**




 The Associate Director will contribute to short and long\-term regional planning and assist in driving forward the strategy that embodies Inhabit’s values, vision, mission and objectives to successfully grow the business including:
   

  




* Assist in developing the regional business plan aligned to Inhabit strategic plan to be approved by the Regional Manager. Assist in setting regional objectives and in preparing and implementing strategies to achieve the business plan. Ensure staff are well informed and up to date on developments that affect them
* Assist in undertaking regional future workforce planning and projects with an emphasis on growth and innovation.



**Financial Management**




 The Associate Director shall assist in the proper financial management including:
   

  





  

  




* Assist in the development and implementation of annual budgets and ensure that adequate internal control mechanisms are in place
* Monitor financial aspects of projects including monthly invoicing to ensure the accuracy and debtor collection
* Follow up with clients on overdue fees for debtors greater than 90 days
* Assist in reviewing and monitoring monthly financial reports
* Assisting in managing business risks by following appropriate risk appraisal procedures prior to signing (and following award of) any consulting commission



**Marketing and Business Development**




 The Associate Director shall actively participate in the marketing of the practice as a multi\-disciplined engineering company and shall achieve agreed targets in all aspects of practice development, including:
   

  




* Maximise cross\-selling opportunities for Inhabit and prepare project proposals to support profit targets including, where necessary, co\-ordination of inputs from other disciplines (BMU, Acoustics, Lighting, Sustainability, FLS etc)
* Conduct presentations of proposals for prospective clients and/or projects
* Raise any challenges in competitive pricing across the region with the Regional Manager and propose solutions
* Build and expand the client base of Inhabit based on both established, prospective and new client relationships that you secure in the region
* Network within the Industry to develop industry intelligence, define and implement strategies to meet any challenges
* Ensure active participation in a broad range of client\-focused functions, networking events, conferences, seminars, committees etc. to enhance the professional image of both the Associate Director and Inhabit



**Staff Management, Mentoring and Training**




 The Associate Director is responsible for ensuring staff are managed and supported effectively including:
   

  




* Encourage and role model respectful, supportive and positive engagement and interactions across disciplines/support functions and all other Inhabit offices to support positive culture and drive engagement
* Identify the deliverables, tasks and activities required for workload throughout all phases of the project to ensure adequate staff resourcing and tools are available to meet project deliverables and expectations
* Recruitment activities (with prior approval from the Regional Manager and Regional Director, Australia and New Zealand) in accordance with company procedures
* Provide technical leadership, guidance, mentoring and support and build and oversee staff technical development to maintain standards and to operate efficiently
* Ensure staff are following Inhabit’s quality management system
* Hold regular meetings with the Technical Team to discuss scheduling of work in a planned manner including distribution of workload, resources etc. to meet deliverables
* Assist in setting objectives and standards for the expected performance of staff and encourage regular feedback discussions on project successes and challenges to capture lessons learned
* Assist in conducting regular and effective Performance Reviews in accordance within Inhabits’ review system for your direct reports and provide ongoing/regular feedback to foster work performance improvements and promote professional growth of staff
* Identify training needs of the team to increase their skill level, development and growth
* Identify training opportunities, both internally and externally including seminars, events, conferences, talks, university lectures, factory visits, construction phase training etc., to assist with the development of the team and to address any knowledge and skill gaps. Support staff writing technical notes from these training opportunities and/or project experiences
* Encourage and promote Inhabit online materials, technical notes, technical library
* Communicate regularly and proactively with Senior Management as required to assist the process of managing your work/lifestyle balance and of your team
* Ensure staff adhere to and are familiar with all Health and Safety requirements and safe work practices



**Client Management**




 The Associate Director shall continually strengthen client loyalty and gain repeat business by ensuring high quality service and creative (‘Leading Edge’) solutions to clients by way of:
   

  




* Communicate with clients to establish their needs and maintain a dialogue throughout the project
* Monitor feedback from clients and develop and implement action plans for continuous improvement
* Identify and implement ways to enhance current service offerings, systems and processes from a client and business perspective to maximise Inhabit’s competitive advantage
* Identify and implement ways to enhance internal systems, processes and procedures to improve client satisfaction
* Be a role model for exceptional favourable record in client response to timeliness, quality of work and high technical standing on projects and manage in conjunction with Project Director/Leader any client complaints
* Continually aim for repeat and new business from all clients in contact with Inhabit



**Project Management**




 The Associate Director will provide leadership to ensure the efficient and profitable completion of all tasks and projects under their control whilst ensuring the allocation of adequate resources, excellent technical standards and client satisfaction including:
   

  




* Provide overall strategy and technical solutions as required for project challenges
* Undertake or assist the project leaders with negotiation of fees and contracts where appropriate to ensure financial targets are achieved
* Manage business risks by following appropriate risk appraisal procedures prior to the signing contracts
* Allocate and manage project personnel to suit programs and project budgets
* Project lead internally with respective team colleagues to allow deliverables to be issued to client
* Coordinate and work with the design team to deliver project deliverables
* Help solve client/project team’s problems by lateral thinking and creating innovative solutions
* Ensure quality outputs and agreed cost/scheduled delivery time frames are met
* Manage projects, site meetings, design workshops and site inspection as required and/or as project planning stipulates
* As Project Leader, monitor and report on team performance against agreed timelines, and fees/budgets
* Oversee the work of Sub Consultants/Contractors and review outputs produced by them
* Ensure project sheets for each project are undertaken for compliance with project and office QA procedures



**Consultancy Function**




 The Associate Director shall assist in the consultancy functions including:
   

  




* Preparation and coordination of expressions of interest, tender submissions and similar consulting proposals
* Maintain a hands\-on approach to the provision of design and engineering, and assist in the co\-ordination of other consultancy inputs in relation to BMU, Acoustics, Lighting, Sustainability, FLS on an as needs basis
* Contribute and monitor the design and engineering of curtain wall and cladding systems, as well as specialty systems (i.e., structural glass, cables, ETFE etc.)

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**About Us**
 We are the real estate subsidiary of a well\-established, diversified business group with interests across multiple industries in the GCC. Our business focuses on the development, ownership, and management of a diverse portfolio of residential, commercial, mixed\-use, and retail real estate assets. With capabilities spanning the full real estate lifecycle—from project development and construction to leasing, property management, and asset operations—we are committed to delivering high\-quality developments and creating long\-term value for our stakeholders.
   

  

 As we continue to expand our portfolio and strengthen our market presence, we are seeking an accomplished Finance Director to lead our finance function and play a pivotal role in shaping the company’s financial strategy and supporting sustainable growth.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Finance Director will provide overall financial leadership, governance, and strategic direction across the organization. Reporting to senior executive management, you will drive financial performance, capital efficiency, and disciplined investment decision\-making across a diversified real estate portfolio.
   

  

 You will oversee both development and operational real estate assets, ensuring strong financial control across project delivery, leasing operations, property management, and investment activities. This role requires a strong combination of strategic vision, technical finance expertise, and hands\-on leadership within a complex real estate environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Financial Strategy \& Leadership
   

  

* Lead financial planning, forecasting, and performance management across the business.
* Support executive leadership in evaluating investments, acquisitions, and development opportunities.
* Provide financial insights to drive profitability, capital efficiency, and long\-term value creation.


 Development \& Asset Finance
   

  

* Oversee financial management of development projects from acquisition through completion and stabilization.
* Manage project budgets, cash flows, escrow accounts, and contractor/consultant payments.
* Monitor financial performance across leasing, property management, and retail assets.


 Treasury \& Funding
   

  

* Manage liquidity, cash flow planning, and banking relationships.
* Lead negotiations for project finance, banking facilities, refinancing, and restructuring.


 Financial Planning \& Analysis
   

  

* Lead budgeting, forecasting, and long\-term financial planning.
* Develop financial models and feasibility studies for new developments and investments.


 Commercial \& Investment Support
   

  

* Review and support negotiation of key commercial contracts and agreements.
* Provide financial input into investment structuring and strategic decision\-making.


 Governance \& Controls
   

  

* Ensure compliance with IFRS and internal control frameworks.
* Oversee audits, statutory reporting, and financial governance processes.
* Strengthen financial policies, systems, and controls across the organization.


 Leadership \& Team Development
   

  

* Lead, mentor, and develop a high\-performing finance team.
* Build strong finance capability across development and operational business units.
* Foster a culture of accountability, performance, and continuous improvement.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or Economics; professional qualification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, CMA) preferred.
* 15\+ years of progressive finance experience, ideally within real estate development and asset management.
* Strong experience in development finance, including project cash flows, escrow structures, and contractor payment processes.
* Strong financial modelling, feasibility analysis, and investment evaluation skills.
* Experience across both development and operational real estate portfolios, including leasing, property management, and retail assets.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience in contract review and investment decision support.


 Why Join Us?
   

  

 Join a leading real estate company within a diversified group, where you will play a key role in shaping financial strategy, enabling major developments, and driving long\-term value creation across a growing portfolio.
   

  

 Job Details
   

  

 Role Level: Not Applicable Work Type: Full\-Time Country: United Arab Emirates City: Dubai Company Website: https://www.qureos.com/ Job Function: Finance Company Industry/
   

  

 Sector: IT Services and IT Consulting

data.jd_text:
**About Faux Consultancy.** 




 Founded in 2011, Faux is the Middle East’s leading Public Relations and Events Consultancy, working in partnership with global brands and the region’s most exciting independent concepts. Based in Dubai and working actively across the whole of the GCC, Faux is a trusted on\-the\-ground partner for brands focused on amplifying their visibility and commercial success in the region. Faux’s client divisions focus solely on Fashion and Beauty, spanning the luxury and niche sectors. This sharp focus, along with the agency’s legacy of over a decade of innovative brand representation, allows for a level of experience and insight that is unmatched. We are committed to providing the most qualitative, thoughtful and effective representation for our brands.
 



  





 The Account Director is a central leadership role within Faux, spanning key pillars of strategic development and project implementation for both local and international clients. Working in direct collaboration with the Senior Management team, this is a position that involves engagement in both day\-to\-day Account Direction and team management, as well as high\-level strategic planning and the opportunity to be involved in Business Development.
 



  





 Overseeing a portfolio of Beauty brands, the Account Director is responsible for leading a team of employees in the successful management and representation of their ‘team portfolio’, ensuring a qualitative approach to Public Relations in the GCC, and achieving certain KPIs associated with the accounts.
 



 The Account Director ensures that best\-practice standards are always in place, from strategy development through to campaign execution, and enjoys a level of autonomy in the management of their ‘working group’ to best utilise and develop the talents of their team.
 



  





 This role requires significant industry experience in a similar Senior PR position, working specifically across Beauty clients, preferably with experience or insight into the GCC Market. The ideal candidate for this role will have a strong sense of self\-direction and a desire to take on a top leadership role within a market\-leading, fast\-paced and dynamic agency.
 



  





 Innovation, professionalism, and a qualitative approach to Public Relations lie at the heart of Faux's approach to client representation, and these qualities will be reflected in the successful candidate, in terms of their previous success and future goals.
 



  





**RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  




* Development and implementation of innovative and effective GCC\-wide strategies for PR clients, spanning Press, Influencer, VIP and CRM Relations
* Leadership of a dedicated team within the company, providing structure, mentorship and guidance to ensure smooth workflow and delivery
* Securing qualitative, high\-value PR coverage and other results in line with allocated KPIs, always aiming to exceed targets
* Demonstrate strong leadership skills, including allocation of tasks, mentoring of direct reports, and providing clear, critical feedback
* Responsibility for the successful delivery of organic and commercial PR projects carried out on behalf of clients, including planning, implementation, and post\-activity analysis
* Work in partnership with the Faux Events team to effectively plan and host events, activations, and other concepts for agency clients
* Provide active contribution to the business development goals of the agency, participating in the development and presentation of pitches for new business
* Maintain a strong awareness of industry trends, talents, and other movements, to provide the best possible insight to clients, GCC\-wide
* Planning and negotiation of commercial talent and media deals on behalf of clients, including advertorials, ambassadorship deals, and paid campaigns
* Local content creation: show expertise and ease in handling production and post\-production of localised campaigns, which are specifically targeted to the GCC market
* Daily budget management, including the responsible planning, spending, and tracking of client budgets
* Team management to ensure the accurate data gathering, analysis and client reporting are carried out within the provided deadlines
* Active contribution to the development of a positive workplace culture, collaborating and sharing suggestions with Senior Management on ways to best motivate and reward the team.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS** 




  




* A bachelor's or master’s degree in public relations, communications or other relevant discipline
* **At least 8 years of PR industry experience, including in the role of Public Relations / Communications Manager, specifically in the Beauty industry**
* **At least 3 years in a similar role or as a Senior PR Manager, specifically in the Beauty industry**
* **A strong media and influencer network across the GCC is an essential requirement**
* Proven leadership skills, with the ability to confidently guide, motivate and manage a team
* A creative thinker who values innovation, bringing to the table fresh ideas and strategies
* Proven success in a previous senior PR role, including the securing of high\-value coverage and the generation of market\-leading ideas
* Excellent regional networks with the leading press, influencers, stylists and celebrities
* A positive and engaged attitude to relationship development in the region
* An awareness and understanding of regional market nuances, and their impact on Beauty brand management
* A keen interest in social media trends and a keen interest in staying ahead of the curve, always to nourish our clients with fresh concepts and locally relevant and time\-sensitive social listening ideas
* Strong multi\-tasking and organisational skills, to thrive in a fast\-paced agency environment where many projects are carried out in parallel
* High level of organisation and experience in complex workflow management, with the ability to hit strict deadlines and KPIs
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into engaging stories
* Ad\-hoc regional and international travel will be required.

* 15\+ years PQE; able to work autonomously and at pace
* Proactive, collaborative, commercially minded

data.jd_text:
Equiti is a pioneering fintech firm and world\-class provider of multi\-asset fintech products \- from liquidity solutions to in\-house tech hubs to online trading platforms. With over 400 global specialists in 9 languages, Equiti provides clients with access to individual, professional, and institutional brokerage services in Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.
 



  





 At Equiti, we believe that financial opportunities can unlock potential for everyone, everywhere. We’re on a mission to deliver accessible online trading products around the world through education and accessibility.
 



  





 Think finance is stuffy? Think again.
 



  





 At Equiti, we’re building fintech with a purpose: making wealth tools accessible to everyone. As we continue to grow, we’re seeking talented individuals who thrive in innovative environments. , and we are on the lookout for talented individuals who can perform and excel in a dynamic and innovative working environment. Our Research \& Development department would like to welcome a detail\-oriented.
 



  





**Group Head of R\&D** 
 in our office in
 **Dubai** 




  





 We are looking for a Group Head of R\&D to lead Equiti’s research and development organization and own the build of Stratos — our proprietary pricing engine and Order Management System (OMS) designed to de\-risk Equiti from third\-party execution vendors. You will own the R\&D vision, the phased delivery roadmap, the vendor migration strategy, and the multi\-disciplinary engineering team that delivers it, working closely with our trading and quant functions.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Own the R\&D vision, strategy, and multi\-phase delivery roadmap for the proprietary execution program (market data, pricing engine, OMS, and advanced analytics).
* Lead the design and delivery of an in\-house pricing engine and OMS to progressively replace third\-party execution and platform dependencies.
* Build, hire, and lead a multi\-disciplinary engineering team (in\-house and specialist contractors), setting technical direction and engineering standards.
* Define and run the phased vendor migration and parallel\-run strategy, managing risk to live trading throughout.
* Partner with the Trading and Quant teams on pricing models, smart order routing, and execution quality.
* Own the R\&D budget, vendor relationships, hiring plan, and delivery reporting to technology leadership and the board.



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 



* Deep expertise in trading and market data.
* Strong knowledge of pricing engines, OMS/EMS, FIX connectivity, and liquidity provider integrations.
* Proven leadership of 10\+ reports across geographies, with hands\-on credibility.
* Experience de\-risking from third\-party platforms and managing complex vendor migrations.
* Strong commercial judgement on build\-vs\-buy, cloud cost, and delivery trade\-offs.



  





**Experience Requirements** 



* 12\+ years in financial leadership field, with 5\+ years leading organizations.
* Demonstrated delivery of trading, execution, or market\-data platforms in a regulated environment.
* Track record of building and scaling teams and shipping mission\-critical systems.
* Excellent written and spoken English.



  





**Perks** 




 Each of our offices has its special perks; be it ‘no ties’, free lunches, charity events, or a hybrid work policy – but whenever you walk into an Equiti office, you’re sure to see a friendly face. We encourage international collaborations and always keep our eyes open to how we can do more.
 



 The benefits you can expect at your Equiti workplace include:
 


* Competitive salary package
* Performance\-based bonus
* Medical insurance coverage for employees and family members
* Smart working options
* Employee wellness initiatives
* Personalized career development
* Company lunch in the office
* Regular company events



  





 With energy, drive, and imagination, there’s no limit to where your career can go at Equiti. With a diverse workforce and geographical spread of offices, we strongly support career development initiatives as well as provide a range of opportunities for professional and life experiences.
 



  





 Equiti is an equal opportunity employer.
 



  





 “Equiti” refers to a group of companies consisting of seven regulated financial services companies licensed to operate in the respective jurisdictions of their incorporation, in addition to our tech and marketing hubs. Equiti has presence in Africa, Europe, and the Middle East.

**BRANDSYSTEM**

**You'll be working directly alongside the Group Head of Finance \- together, you build the Finance function across the group.** 





 ·   
 

 Owning the production of the monthly consolidated reporting (P\&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) \- the framework is still being constructed; target is D\+8 delivery with budget variance analysis for each entity

 Driving the budget cycle alongside the Head of Finance \- continuously improving processes, driving reforecasts when needed, and leading the annual budget exercise for each business

 Designing and implementing the weekly cash flow reporting per entity with the automation team \- then running it as a key input to management meetings

 Embedding operational KPIs into each entity's P\&L \- making Finance speak the language of the business and delivering actionable insights to business teams

 Supporting the set\-up of the Group's banking structure and Cash Pool

 Monitoring and framing intercompany flows \- recharges, current accounts, management fees
 





 ·   
 

 Acting as the main point of contact for entity accountants \- coordinating, aligning, and ensuring the numbers are right
 





 ·   
 

 Ensuring data reliability across entities, working closely with the data and automation team to clean data at the source and automate reporting
 




  





**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR** 





 ·   
 

 2 to 3 years in FP\&A, audit, TAS, or corporate finance \- you know your way around a P\&L and you're not intimidated by a blank page
 





 ·   
 

 Grande École de Commerce, university master in Finance, or equivalent
 





 ·   
 

 Native French speaker, fluent in English \- French is the working language, English used with external partners
 





 ·   
 

 You build structure, you don't wait for it \- sharp on Excel; any FP\&A or BI tooling is a bonus
 





 ·   
 

 Some exposure to e\-commerce, retail, or high\-growth startups will make a difference
 




  





**WHY THIS ROLE** 





 ·   
 
 A genuine opportunity to build Finance from scratch across an entire group \- multiple businesses, multiple models
 




 ·   
 
 Concrete responsibilities from day one, with a direct impact on the business
 




 ·   
 
 A fast\-moving environment where the learning curve is steep and the pace keeps you sharp
 




 ·   
 
 A role designed to grow with you \- if you deliver, the scope expands
 




 ·   
 
 Competitive package, tax\-free \- health insurance, gym membership and one annual flight to home country covered

data.jd_text:
**About the role** 




 We are looking for a senior commercial leader to own the entire revenue function of the company. As Head of Business Development, you will report directly to the CEO and carry full P\&L responsibility for the BD division — setting strategy, owning the budget, managing a growing team, and driving revenue growth across three core streams: direct client acquisition, practitioner attraction, and strategic partnerships.
 



 This is a founding leadership role. You will build the commercial infrastructure from scratch and provide strategic direction to the Client Manager, Wellness Coaches, and potentially the Head of Marketing as a unified commercial and client experience function.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




***P\&L \& COMMERCIAL STRATEGY***



* Own the full P\&L of the Business Development division — budget planning, revenue forecasting, and delivery of financial targets
* Drive revenue growth across three core streams: direct client acquisition, practitioner attraction, and strategic partnerships
* Build a scalable, recurring revenue model — transitioning the center from individual transactions to long\-term membership subscriptions
* Design and execute the go\-to\-market strategy for membership programs
* Report on commercial performance directly to the CEO; contribute to board\-level strategic planning



  





***STREAM 1 — DIRECT CLIENT ACQUISITION***



* Build and personally manage a high\-value client database through direct outreach, private events, and VIP networking
* Organize and host private club engagements, exclusive previews, and curated experiences to convert prospects into members
* Act to acquire new clients and manage client relationships, both new and existing
* Lead the end\-to\-end sales cycle — from first contact to signed membership



  





***STREAM 2 — PRACTITIONER ATTRACTION***



* Identify and map top\-performing independent medical practitioners relevant to the center's offering, and introduce them to leadership for evaluation
* Build long\-term relationships with these practitioners; lead the process of signing and managing independent contractor agreements
* Maintain an active pipeline of practitioner prospects and track conversion from first relationship to signed, onboarded contractor



  





***STREAM 3 — STRATEGIC PARTNERSHIPS***



* Cultivate relationships across the UAE's private medical and wellness community — specialists, clinics, and complementary health providers — positioning the center as the go\-to partner for comprehensive longevity care
* Develop collaborations with complementary industries — luxury hospitality, private banking, wellness brands, and concierge services — to create new client acquisition channels
* Build strong relationships and manage contracts with corporate partners and other complementary organizations
* Structure and negotiate partnership agreements that align with the center's premium positioning



  





***TEAM LEADERSHIP***



* Lead, coach, and develop a team: align individual KPIs with overall revenue goals
* Build team structures, workflows, and performance frameworks appropriate for a premium pre\-launch environment



  





***MARKET INTELLIGENCE \& REPORTING***



* Track competitor positioning across the Dubai longevity and premium health landscape
* Contribute to the pricing architecture and membership tier design based on market data and client feedback
* Monitor performance of commercial activities using key metrics and prepare regular reports for the CEO and leadership team



  





**What We're Looking For** 




***EXPERIENCE***



* 8–12 years of business development or commercial leadership experience, with at least 3 years managing a team
* Proven P\&L ownership in a premium, client\-facing environment — luxury healthcare, aesthetic clinics, private banking, luxury hospitality, or high\-end concierge services
* Experience building and managing independent contractor or referral relationships with medical practitioners, ideally including familiarity with DHA licensing and clinical governance processes
* Established personal network in the UAE — across business, medical, or luxury lifestyle communities; UAE\-based preferred



  





***SKILLS \& ATTRIBUTES***



* Strategic thinker with hands\-on execution capability — comfortable at both board\-level planning and closing individual deals
* Commercially fluent in longevity medicine — able to speak credibly about diagnostics, biomarkers, and health optimization protocols without a clinical background
* Strong people leader: able to build, align, and motivate a small but high\-performing commercial team
* Highly presentable and culturally fluent — at ease engaging ultra\-high\-net\-worth individuals across diverse nationalities and business cultures

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**Job Description**
 The Lead QA Automation is RAKBANK's automation engineering authority, explicitly mandated to lead the bank's transformation from a predominantly manual testing organisation to an automation\-first, AI\-augmented quality engineering practice. This is a transformation role — the incumbent will inherit a landscape where the vast majority of testing is executed manually and will be expected to architect, build, and embed the frameworks, toolchains, and practices that change this reality. The Lead QA Automation reports to the Head of QA and is the technical lead for the automation engineering team — responsible for framework design, CI/CD pipeline integration, AI\-assisted testing adoption, intelligent test data management, and the delivery of measurable automation coverage growth across RAKBANK's digital and banking platforms. This role demands a rare combination of automation engineering depth, product thinking about the developer/tester experience, and the leadership conviction to drive cultural change in how RAKBANK's engineering squads think about quality.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Lead RAKBANK's QA automation transformation programme — establishing the automation vision, multi\-quarter roadmap, and coverage targets, with a firm commitment to achieving 60–70% test automation coverage across regression, integration, and API test suites within an 18\-month horizon; drive the structural shift from manual to automated quality delivery across all delivery squads, with AI\-augmented testing as a core practice.
* Architect and build RAKBANK's enterprise test automation framework estate — UI automation (Playwright / Selenium / Appium for web and mobile), API automation (RestAssured / Karate / Postman/Newman), integration and contract testing (Pact), and data validation test harnesses for the Databricks data platform.
* Integrate automation frameworks into RAKBANK's CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Harness) — ensuring automated regression suites execute on every merge/build, with clear pass/fail gates, test result dashboards, and automated failure triage.
* Drive AI\-assisted testing adoption across the QA function: implement LLM\-powered test case generation, self\-healing test selectors, AI\-based defect classification and root\-cause suggestion, visual regression testing, and intelligent test prioritisation — making RAKBANK's QA practice AI\-native.
* Implement shift\-left automation practices — embedding automation engineers within delivery squads, championing BDD\-style test authoring (Cucumber/Gherkin) that bridges business requirements and executable tests, and ensuring automation is written concurrently with feature development rather than after the fact.
* Establish intelligent test data management as an engineering discipline — designing synthetic test data generation frameworks, PII masking pipelines for cloned production data, on\-demand test data provisioning APIs, and test data catalogues — eliminating test data as a blocker to automated test execution.
* Own API and service\-layer automation — ensuring all microservices, REST APIs, GraphQL endpoints, and event\-driven integrations (Kafka, IBM MQ) have contract tests, integration tests, and schema validation automation in place.
* Govern automation coverage metrics and produce automation health dashboards — tracking coverage by squad, module, risk tier, and release stream; reporting progress against the 60–70% automation target to the Head of QA and programme leadership; driving in\-project automation as a delivery standard so that new features are delivered with automation test coverage by default, not as a post\-delivery activity; identifying and remediating automation debt hotspots on a quarterly basis.
* Architect containerised and distributed test execution environments — using Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud\-based device testing platforms (BrowserStack, Sauce Labs) to enable parallel, scalable, and on\-demand test execution without environment constraints.
* Lead and develop the automation engineering team — conducting framework design reviews, code reviews, and capability development; running automation guilds and knowledge\-sharing sessions; and recruiting and onboarding automation engineering talent.
* Evaluate and select automation tooling — maintaining awareness of the evolving test automation ecosystem, making pragmatic build\-vs\-buy decisions, and ensuring the automation toolchain is integrated into the developer portal managed by the DevEx team.
* Partner with the Head of QA on non\-functional automation — extending automation coverage into performance test scripting (JMeter / Gatling / k6\), chaos engineering experiments, and security scanning integration within pipelines.


**What We Are Looking For**
* 10\+ years in test automation engineering, with a minimum of 3 years as a Lead or Principal Automation Engineer in an agile delivery environment — ideally within a bank or digital\-native organisation.
* Expert proficiency in at least two automation frameworks across UI and API layers: Playwright or Selenium for web; Appium for mobile; RestAssured or Karate for API; and strong command of Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript as the automation language.
* Proven experience building test automation frameworks from a low\-coverage baseline — with evidence of measurable coverage growth and automation adoption achieved in a previous role.
* Hands\-on CI/CD integration experience — GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or Harness — with the ability to configure test execution stages, parallelism, and result reporting.
* Demonstrable experience or active exploration of AI\-assisted testing tools (e.g., Testim, Mabl, Applitools, LLM\-based test generation) and the ability to evaluate, pilot, and scale such capabilities.
* Experience designing test data management solutions — synthetic data generation, PII masking, and self\-service test data provisioning.
* Familiarity with containerised test execution (Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud testing platforms (BrowserStack, Sauce Labs).
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or related field. ISTQB Test Automation Engineer certification is required.

data.jd_text:
**Who We Are:** 
 At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award\-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world's fastest\-growing beauty brands. As a company, we are fueled by purpose and not profit, this allows us to approach things differently so that we can create products, content, and a community like no other. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!
   

  

**Summary:** 
 We're seeking a strategic and hands\-on
 **Head of Post\-Production** 
 to lead and elevate Huda Beauty's video content function. In this role, you will own the post\-production vision across brand campaigns, social\-first content, and marketing initiatives, while managing and mentoring a team of four in\-house editors.
   

  

 You'll work closely with Creative, Marketing, and Social teams to ensure best\-in\-class output, efficient workflows, and consistent on\-time delivery. This role requires deep post\-production expertise, strong leadership, and the ability to operate in a fast\-paced, high\-volume content environment. You'll be responsible for setting creative and technical standards, streamlining operations, developing talent, and ensuring creative excellence from concept through final delivery.
   

  

 This is a hybrid role: highly strategic, yet hands\-on when needed \- supporting shoots, defining technical approaches, and building a scalable ecosystem of videographers and freelance partners.
   

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**
* Manage and mentor a team of 4 editors
* Lead, plan, and manage post\-production for a full slate of video projects
* Manage post\-production schedules and traffic control
* Create and implement processes and workflows that enable the team to work efficiently and independently
* Guide team development, helping junior members grow towards independence
* Oversee branded storytelling, ensuring delivery of best\-in\-class assets in line with brand vision
* Juggle multiple high\-priority post\-production projects in various stages, ensuring deadlines are met
* Identify workflow gaps in post\-production and lead continuous improvement initiatives
* Develop and refine a distinctive Huda Beauty editing style \- color grading, motion graphics/animation, sound design
* Work closely with the Head of Agency to build efficient project tracking, workflow systems, and deadline rigor
* Be a force for innovation \- integrate AI or other new tools into video production where appropriate
* Build robust storage solutions and archives
* Maintain a network of freelancers/vendors to scale up for projects when needed


**Requirements**
* 10\+ years' experience in post\-production management or a closely related field
* Deep understanding of all areas of post‑production: editing, color grading, VFX, sound design
* Ability to manage multiple projects at once under tight deadlines
* Experience working in agency, brand in\-house, or post\-production house environments
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, align, and drive decisions across multiple teams
* Prior experience managing teams of 5\+ direct reports and freelancers
* Proficient with editing software (Premiere Pro is required; After Effects, etc.)
* Excellent creativity, communication, and attention to detail
* Social\-first mindset with a deep understanding of digital and platform\-native video content


**Benefits**
* Monthly "Self Love Days" (at company discretion)
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage for employee plus dependents
* Monthly coaching sessions with our in\-house Success Coach
* Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products
* Quarterly product gifting


*Huda Beauty is committed to building diverse and inclusive teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.*
