data.raw_snippet:
**POSITION OVERVIEW** 




  





 The Data Center Technical Manager is a senior engineering role within UCC Holding's Power \& Digital delivery division. The role is responsible for the end\-to\-end technical integrity of data center projects from front\-end definition through to construction hand
data.jd_text:
**POSITION OVERVIEW** 




  





 The Data Center Technical Manager is a senior engineering role within UCC Holding's Power \& Digital delivery division. The role is responsible for the end\-to\-end technical integrity of data center projects from front\-end definition through to construction handover, ensuring that power, cooling, civil, and ICT systems are designed to hyperscale and colocation standards and are fully constructable and operable at commissioning.
 



 Working in close alignment with the COO, Data Center Executive Director and the project execution team, the Technical Manager serves as the day\-to\-day technical authority on assigned projects, owning design standards, discipline coordination, OEM interfaces, and technical risk management across the full delivery lifecycle.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**Technical Leadership \& Design Management** 



* Lead multi\-disciplinary engineering teams across power, cooling, civil/structural, and ICT disciplines
* Own technical standards and design basis documentation through to FEED
* Ensure all designs are constructable, installation logic aligned, and ready for site execution
* Manage inter discipline coordination and clash resolution using 3D plant modelling tools (REVIT, etc.)



**Power Systems** 



* Oversee HV/MV/LV power architecture design including utility intake, MV switchgear, transformers, and LV distribution
* Manage UPS, battery storage, and generator system design and OEM interfaces
* Ensure power redundancy models are correctly implemented, targeting AI\-ready campuses
* Coordinate protection, metering, and power quality studies with specialist consultants



**Cooling \& MEP** 



* Lead cooling system design including air\-side economization, chillers, air cooling, and liquid cooling for high\-density AI compute
* Target PUE benchmarks in line with hyperscale client requirements; industry benchmark for AI campuses is 1\.2–1\.4 PUE
* Oversee plumbing, drainage, HVAC, and fire suppression system design and integration
* Interface with energy modelling teams to validate system performance and efficiency projections



**Civil, Structural \& Building** 



* Manage civil and structural design scope including foundations, raised floor systems, data halls, and façade
* Ensure structural designs accommodate equipment loadings, seismic considerations, and phased capacity expansion
* Oversee M\&E services coordination within building fabric to eliminate site clashes and rework



**ICT, Cabling \& Connectivity** 



* Oversee ICT infrastructure design including structured cabling, fiber backbone, and carrier\-neutral meet\-me rooms
* Ensure DCIM\-readiness is embedded in design from the outset to support operational efficiency post\-handover
* Coordinate with network operators and hyperscale clients on connectivity and meet\-me room requirements



**Commissioning Alignment** 



* Engage the commissioning team from FEED stage to ensure testability and safe energization sequences are designed in
* Define and review CX documentation including CX plans, ITPs, FAT and SAT procedures
* Ensure technical handover packages are complete, accurate, and meet client O\&M requirements



**HSE \& Quality** 



* Embed safety by design principles across all engineering disciplines
* Own HAZOP/HAZID planning and chairing, ensuring action close\-out is tracked
* Manage quality assurance processes for design deliverables including review gates, checking, and sign\-off



**Client \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Act as primary technical interface with hyperscale and colocation clients during design development
* Lead technical clarification meetings with clients, authorities, and utility providers
* Represent UCC in technical workshops with OEMs, specialist consultants, and external design teams



  





**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE** 




**Essential** 



* Degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or a related discipline (BEng / MEng)
* 10\+ years of engineering experience in mission\-critical facilities or data center projects
* Demonstrated experience delivering hyperscale or large\-scale colocation data center projects
* Deep working knowledge of data center power architecture
* Strong cooling systems experience
* Proven ability to lead multi\-disciplinary design teams of 10\+ engineers
* Experience with FEL/FEED\-driven delivery models
* Proficiency in design tools including AutoCAD, REVIT, or equivalent
* Working experience in the Middle East or comparable international markets



**Desirable** 



* LEED, BREEAM, or equivalent sustainability certification experience
* Familiarity with hyperscale client design standards (Google, Microsoft Azure, Meta, AWS, Oracle)

data.jd_text:
Syntys is a leading data center provider specializing in the design, construction, and management of data centers, catering to hyperscalers, AI infrastructure, and colocation wholesale providers across the MENA region. With a presence in more countries than any other provider in the region, Syntys is committed to delivering scalable, secure, and efficient digital infrastructure solutions. Our offerings include colocation and built\-to\-suit facilities, meticulously tailored to meet the growing demands of the industry. In this capacity, Syntys plays a pivotal role in supporting the region’s economic growth by fostering innovation and attracting investment in the digital economy.
 



  





 The Site Selection \& Expansion Senior Manager is responsible for identifying, evaluating, securing, and enabling hyperscale\-ready data center sites across assigned markets within the MENA region. Reporting to the Vice President – Infrastructure \& Site Selection, the role owns the complete technical site selection lifecycle, from market screening and site origination through technical due diligence, utility engagement, permitting strategy, infrastructure planning, land acquisition support, and development readiness.
 



  





 The position is responsible for evaluating power availability, transmission infrastructure, fiber connectivity, water availability, environmental constraints, planning regulations, and constructability to deliver investment\-grade sites capable of supporting hyperscale, AI, cloud and wholesale colocation developments.
 



  





 Working closely with utilities, transmission companies, telecom operators, planning authorities, government entities, landowners, consultants, hyperscalers, and internal engineering teams, the role ensures each site meets Syntys' technical, commercial, and operational requirements.
 



  





**ROLE ACCOUNTABILITIES** 




  




* Identify, screen, and shortlist potential sites within assigned markets, including greenfield land identification, brownfield redevelopment, and existing facility due diligence.
* Develop long\-term market expansion strategies based on hyperscaler demand, cloud availability zones, latency requirements, AI infrastructure growth and regional digital infrastructure strategies.
* Identify greenfield, brownfield, powered shell and redevelopment opportunities suitable for hyperscale developments.
* Develop and maintain an active land bank aligned with forecast demand and expansion roadmap.
* Maintain relationships with developers, investment funds, industrial zones, government agencies and real estate partners to secure off\-market opportunities.
* Carry out technical and commercial assessments of target sites covering zoning, environmental, access, and infrastructure readiness, and prepare findings for the VP’s go/no\-go decisions.
* Score and rank shortlisted sites based on utility proximity, power and fiber availability, expansion potential, and regulatory ease, and present recommendations to the VP.
* Prepare early modular/hybrid concept designs and tests fit for shortlisted sites in assigned markets, following the VP\-approved design playbook.
* Run day\-to\-day coordination with government bodies, utility providers, and telecom operators within assigned markets to secure pre\-approvals, grid connections, and fiber access.
* Build infrastructure feasibility reports and cost models for assigned sites for the VP and executive go/no\-go decisions.
* Run negotiations with landowners, developers, and real estate agents on acquisitions, JV structures, or long\-term leases within assigned markets, bringing terms to the VP for approval.
* Oversee due diligence and legal review for assigned markets in coordination with internal legal teams.
* Prepare site\-level inputs for hyperscaler SOQs (Statements of Qualification), technical compliance, service level agreements (SLAs), and regional forecasts for assigned markets.
* Align regional site strategy with hyperscaler location priorities, latency requirements, and expansion targets, in partnership with the VP.
* Apply the “Syntys Design Playbook” within assigned markets to drive site selection alignment with modularity, cost efficiency, energy sustainability, and hyperscaler readiness and ensure new sites conform to company standards and future\-proof engineering practices.
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams, engineering, legal, commercial, and operations to align site development with company\-wide priorities and execution plans.
* Manage and coach a small team of site selection specialists/analysts in their markets, reviewing their work and providing day\-to\-day directions, setting clear objectives, monitor performance, and provide regular feedback to ensure team goals align with business outcomes.
* Assess constructability and phasing strategies for multi\-building campus developments and evaluate site suitability against Syntys Design Playbook and hyperscaler design standards.
* Lead technical engagement with transmission and distribution utilities.



  





**EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS** 




  




* Minimum 10\+ years of progressive experience in site selection, infrastructure planning, and land development.
* At least 3 years in a senior management role handling infrastructure and land strategy in data centers, industrial parks, or hyperscale environments.
* Strong experience working with government bodies, utilities, telecom operators, and environmental agencies in the MENA region.
* Experience engaging directly with transmission utilities, power authorities, and telecom providers.
* Experience in permitting industrial or mission\-critical developments.
* Proven track record in delivering land deals, utility enablement, and permitting in fast\-paced, growth\-driven environments.
* Experience engaging directly with hyperscalers and wholesale clients is highly preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Urban Planning, Real Estate, Architecture, or a related field.
* Master's degree in Infrastructure Planning, Real Estate Development, MBA, or Engineering Management is preferred.
* Fluent in English; Arabic language capability is preferred.

**Position: Contracts / Commercial Manager** 




 Location: Lusail
 



  





**Job Summary:** 




 We are looking for an experienced and results\-driven
 **Contracts / Commercial Manager** 
 to oversee the full contract lifecycle across multiple infrastructure projects. This role involves managing contract administration, claims, payments, and commercial strategy, while ensuring compliance and reducing risks. You will work closely with project teams, clients, and stakeholders to support successful project delivery and protect the company’s interests.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* **Contract Management:** 
 Take ownership of managing and administering contracts across multiple large\-scale project sites, ensuring that all contractual terms, obligations, and deliverables are met.
* **Contractual Correspondence:** 
 Draft, review, and respond to formal contractual communications to protect the company’s position and ensure accurate, timely communication.
* **Risk Management:** 
 Identify potential risks in contracts and project execution, develop mitigation strategies, and provide proactive advice to reduce exposure to claims or disputes.
* **Claims \& Variations:** 
 Oversee the preparation and negotiation of claims, variations, and time extension requests, ensuring all submissions are well\-supported and aligned with contractual rights.
* **Contractual Compliance:** 
 Ensure that all project operations comply with the terms of the contract, local regulations, and internal company policies — including obtaining approvals from clients or authorities when required.
* **Dispute Resolution:** 
 Assist in managing and resolving disputes, whether through negotiation, mediation, or formal dispute resolution mechanisms, to avoid costly escalations and maintain project momentum.
* **Stakeholder Coordination:** 
 Work closely with internal teams, subcontractors, consultants, and clients to align on commercial and contractual matters and maintain strong working relationships.
* **Team Leadership:** 
 Guide and support contract administrators and commercial staff across project sites, encouraging best practices and continuous improvement in contract management.
* **Cost\-Plus Contract Experience:** 
 Prior experience in administering Cost\-Plus Contracts is highly desirable — especially the ability to manage cost tracking, payment mechanisms, and ensure transparency in reimbursable works.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience:** 



* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
* Chartered membership or equivalent professional certification (e.g., MRICS, MCIOB, CIArb) is highly preferred.
* Minimum of 15\+ years’ experience in contracts and commercial management, ideally on multi\-site, large\-scale infrastructure projects.
* **Hands\-on experience with major roads, infrastructure, and drainage projects is essential.**
* Experience working with the Public Works Authority (PWA / Ashghal) is a strong advantage.
* Solid understanding of Cost\-Plus, Lump Sum, and other common construction contract types.



  





**Skills \& Attributes:** 



* Excellent negotiation and communication skills, both verbal and written.
* Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail and problem\-solving capabilities.
* In\-depth knowledge of construction laws, industry standards, and best practices in Qatar.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong leadership qualities with a collaborative and solution\-oriented approach.

**Job Summary** 




 The Scheduler \- Planning \& Project Control is responsible for developing, monitoring, and maintaining project schedules to ensure timely and efficient execution of construction and engineering projects. * Extract and analyze resource requirements based on approved project schedules

* Perform schedule updates and coordinate with project teams to ensure schedule accuracy and alignment

* Communicate schedule concerns, risks, and delays effectively to project stakeholders and management
* Develop and maintain summary\-level schedule reports including Gantt charts, milestone reports, critical path analysis, and performance variance reports

* Facilitate and actively participate in weekly schedule review meetings and planning discussions
* Ensure compliance with project planning procedures, company standards, and client requirements



  





**Mandatory Requirements** 



* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent qualification in Construction, Engineering, or related discipline
* Mechanical Engineer with knowledge of Electrical and Instrumentation works highly preferred

**Investment Director \- Doha, Qatar** 




**The platform** 
 A Doha based alternative investment platform. This vertical is a six\-person investment team spanning education (GCC), infrastructure and secondaries (both global), plus opportunistic deals in other sectors.
 



  





 The teams strategy combines direct minority equity and co\-investments alongside leading global sponsors, with target deployment of c.$1bn per annum across the team.
 



  





 The portfolio shows both breadth and sponsor quality:
 


* **Direct:** 
 a GCC K\-12 schools portfolio and a global lifestyle hospitality platform.
* **Co\-investments:** 
 a global branded consumer business, a US mid\-market alternative asset manager, and a premium European education group.
* **Secondaries / continuation vehicles:** 
 core infrastructure including a major UK airport and a global subsea telecoms network.



  





**The role** 
 A senior, mandate\-shaping hire to lead the firm's education investing, focused on the GCC and building on an established K\-12 schools platform. The Director will own education deals end\-to\-end while contributing to the team's wider direct and co\-investment activity, operating with significant autonomy alongside senior leadership and external sponsors.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 



* Originate and screen GCC education opportunities, with a focus on K\-12 and premium/international schools.
* Execute deals end\-to\-end: modelling, valuation, due diligence, structuring, negotiation and documentation.
* Structure direct minority equity and co\-investments alongside global sponsors.
* Prepare and present investment committee materials.
* Steward portfolio assets: board engagement, performance monitoring, value creation and exit.
* Support the team's wider direct, co\-investment and secondaries activity across infrastructure and other sectors.



  





**Requirements** 



* Education\-sector experience, ideally schools platforms (K\-12 / international / premium); GCC or emerging\-markets exposure advantageous.
* Strong end\-to\-end execution across direct equity and co\-investments, including structuring and negotiation, M\&A
* Excellent commercial judgement, with the ability to lead diligence and present to an IC.
* Relationships across the education ecosystem (sponsors, operators, advisors) a strong plus.
* Familiarity with Shari'a\-compliant structures beneficial but not essential; English fluency required, Arabic an advantage.



  





**Location** 
 Doha, Qatar. Relocation support available.

data.jd_text:
A leading organization in Qatar is seeking an experienced Head of Translation to lead its Translation function and drive the delivery of high\-quality Arabic and English language services across the organization.
 



 This is an excellent opportunity for a seasoned translation professional with strong leadership capabilities, exceptional linguistic expertise, and the ability to manage a high\-performing team in a dynamic corporate environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Lead and manage the Translation Department, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of translation services.
* Supervise, mentor, and develop a team of translators and language specialists.
* Establish and maintain quality assurance standards and translation best practices.
* Review and approve complex translations for accuracy, consistency, and cultural relevance.
* Coordinate translation priorities across multiple business units and stakeholders.
* Develop departmental processes, workflows, and performance metrics to improve efficiency.
* Ensure strict confidentiality when handling sensitive corporate documents.
* Drive continuous improvement through the adoption of translation technologies and terminology management.



  





**Candidate Profile:** 



* Bachelor's degree in Translation, Linguistics, Arabic, English, or a related discipline (Master's degree preferred).
* 10\+ years of professional translation experience, including several years in a managerial or team leadership role.
* Native or near\-native proficiency in both Arabic and English, with exceptional written communication skills.
* Proven experience leading and developing translation teams.
* Strong organizational, stakeholder management, and project management skills.
* Experience within the banking, legal, government, or large corporate sector will be an advantage.
* Proficiency with Computer\-Assisted Translation (CAT) tools is desirable.



  





**Preference will be given to candidates who are currently based in Doha,**

data.jd_text:
**Your day to day**
* Ensures all food is prepared fresh and is of the highest quality
* Ensure the correct preparation and presentation of dishes in accordance with menu cards and produced on a consistent basis.
* Strictly adheres to all recipes, methods and instructions from supervisor.
* Consistently checks temperatures in foods and follows proper procedures in regards to chilling, re\-heating, and holding food.
* Checks outlet upon arrival to determine status of outstanding safety, or equipment issues
* Checks outlet prior to leaving to ensure cleanliness, proper disposal/removal of food, and proper storing and labeling
* Responsible for accuracy in daily inventories and requisitions.
* Assist the Head Chef in controlling and analyzing on an on\-going basis, the following:
* Quality levels of production and presentation, including employee cafeteria.
* Guest Satisfaction.
* Merchandising and promotions.
* Operating, Payroll, Food costs according to budget.
* Sanitation, Cleanliness and Hygiene.
* Food photo sessions for all new menus – set standard.
* Maintenance of recipe cards for all menu items.
* Staff attendance, rosters
* Assist in production, preparation and presentation of all food items to ensure highest quality at all times.
* Supervise and control the kitchen to meet work requirements.
* Assist Head Chef with inspections of physical of kitchen areas including cold rooms and equipment.
* Assumes responsibilities of Head Chef in his absence.
* Assist in the preparation and testing of outlet and promotional menus following the guidelines: Requirements, competition, trends, recipes, potential cost, availability.
* Maintain and keep up to date training record.
* Ensure team members are informed about new procedures, special events in the hotel, daily functions and food cost and to received feedback.
* Ensure hygiene and sanitation, all precautions on Fire, Health and Safety are taken in the kitchen and that all employees are will trained in this aspect.
* Display good time management techniques with proper planning and control.
* Strives to continuously improve flow of production
* Check regularly perishable food items received for quantity and quality standards.
* Assist Head Chef in the planning \& ordering of food stock in accordance with the volume of business.
* Perform related duties and special projects as assigned.


****What We Need From You****
**FINANCIAL RETURN**
* Assist the Head Chef in supervising the functioning of all Kitchen employees’ facilities and costs to ensure maximum Food \& Beverage departmental profit is achieved.
* Controls and decreases waste by maintaining logs to submit daily/weekly
* Observe and comply with the company’s requisition and purchase order system


**RESPONSIBLE BUSINESS**
* Comply with and ensure adherence to all of the hotel’s policies and procedures
* Comply with all occupational health and safety policies and procedures
* Attend all scheduled meetings
* Inform on a daily basis the Head Chef of all relevant information in operational matters including information, which does not require the Head Chef’s action.
* Liaise with F \& B Controls for food costing, ordering and supply.
* Liaise with departmental heads for co\-ordination of functions and activities.
* Coordinate with kitchen stewarding for proper sanitation, maintenance of equipment, cleaning of cold stores, supply of service dishes, during service hours.
* Maintain a good working relationship with all staff and colleagues throughout the hotel and sister properties.
* Maintain in good working order all hotel property.
* Maintain a positive and professional attitude at all times


**PEOPLE**
* Assist scheduling of kitchen staff to ensure proper cover of shift as per business requirements.
* Recommend increments, promotion and transfer of chefs to Head Chef and under his guidance conduct such functions as employee orientation, coaching and supervision, if necessary, to ensure appropriate productivity.
* Assist Head Chef in conducting formal on\-the\-job training session for kitchen employees.
* Utilize coaching skills and demonstrate the development of other team members.


**GENERAL**
* Communicate effectively with all other departments
* Attend meetings, training sessions and any other required meeting or training session.
* Identify opportunities to innovate service delivery and product offering to meet and exceed client expectations.
* Ensure safe work practices are adopted at all time and report any OHS concerns immediately to your direct manager or HR Manager.
* Ensure consistency in quality of appearance and taste, and the best quality menus using the freshest ingredients.
* Effectively participate in the organization of ordering, cost controlling and wastage of food.
* Lead by example and ensure all procedures (HACCP, Health and Safety, and Food Safety Management) are maintained to the required standards to which training has been received, and are being followed by all kitchen members.
* Manage and deliver the production needs of the kitchen to the required standards.
* Manage time through effective planning of work, maintaining a high level of productivity.
* Achieve customer satisfaction rating of above expectations.
* Meet maximum creativity and understanding of food, by creating dishes and assisting with menu development.
* Assigned projects are completed within designated timeframes
* Reports, presentations and other administrative duties are consistently on a high standard; and free of errors and omissions.


****What We Need From You****
**PERSONAL CHARACTERISTICS**
**Education**
* Formal Hospitality Management qualifications in Culinary Institute– desirable
* Completion and awarded Intermediate Food Hygiene Certification
* Completion and awarded HACCP Certification


****Experience****
* At least 5 years previous experience in a hotel or branded units
* Minimum 2 years in similar capacity
* Experience in a high cover International /Mediterranean cuisine
* Knowledge in preparation of all Pastry and bakery products and all culinary operations.
* Knowledge of volume production and ability to maintain the highest quality standards.


**Technical**
* Competent Word, Excel, PowerPoint and software packages
* Competent Oral and Written Communication Skills
* Ability to follow standards recipes and convert quantities mathematically
* Ability to taste all foods to assure correct preparation
* Knowledge of stock control, rotas and budgetary controls


**Personal Attributes**
* ‘Can do’ attitude and a high level of energy
* Professionally groomed
* Able to manage task simultaneously; and priorities
* Flexible and aware of the pressure points within the kitchen environment and adapt to each situation with maturity and calmness.
* Hands\-on attitude, leads by example
* Always goes the extra mile to ensure guests satisfaction.


 Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

data.raw_snippet: We're supporting an established Doha\-based Global Institutional Investor that is seeking to expand its infrastructure team. They benefit from a strong deal flow and focus on Core\+ investments across all Infrastructure sub\-sectors with a mix of minority/control stakes and co\-investments.
data.jd_text:
We're supporting an established Doha\-based Global Institutional Investor that is seeking to expand its infrastructure team. They benefit from a strong deal flow and focus on Core\+ investments across all Infrastructure sub\-sectors with a mix of minority/control stakes and co\-investments.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Deal Execution:** 
 Lead the end\-to\-end execution of infrastructure transactions, from initial screening and complex financial modelling to final documentation and closing.
* **Deployment \& Sourcing:** 
 Support the Head of Infrastructure in analysing a high volume of inbound opportunities, ensuring rapid but rigorous evaluation of risk\-adjusted returns.
* **Investment Structuring:** 
 Structure both minority and control positions, with a specific focus on achieving mid\-teen IRRs.
* **Portfolio Monitoring:** 
 Maintain active oversight of portfolio companies, including board involvement and strategic monitoring to ensure asset performance aligns with the firm’s yield\-focused mandate.



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 



* **Experience:** 
 6\-10 years of experience, ideally evolving within a reputable Infrastructure PE fund.
* **Technical Expertise:** 
 Proven independence in leading valuation workstreams within Infrastructure in addition to a strong commercial understanding of various infrastructure sub\-segments.
* **Language \& Culture:** 
 An additional European language is a plus. Candidates should be motivated by a relocation to Doha
* **Agility:** 
 A "self\-starter" mindset. Proven ability to thrive within lean teams and liaising directly with senior internal and external stakeholders.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You**
 Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! As a
 **Commercial Director** 
 , you’re not leading commercial strategy across multiple segments and revenue streams – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Here's what you'll do during a typical day:
   

  

* Own commercial strategy and execution: Develop and implement integrated commercial strategies across all revenue streams — including Group, Conference, and Events (GCE), Rooms, Food and Beverage, Leisure, and Spa — to drive top\-line performance and market share growth
* Maximize revenue and profitability: Partner with General Managers and Finance to ensure commercial decisions support revenue goals, optimize cost of sales, and deliver profit and margin targets
* Lead pricing and forecasting strategy: Oversee revenue management practices including pricing, rate strategies, demand forecasting, and business reviews to optimize revenue across all segments
* Align sales and marketing efforts: Coordinate on\-property and regional sales, marketing, eCommerce, and public relations activities to support brand positioning and drive demand
* Adapt to market dynamics: Monitor trends, assess competitive landscape, and adjust commercial strategies to stay ahead in evolving market conditions
* Strengthen stakeholder relationships: Build trusted relationships with owners, operators, Hilton corporate teams, and external partners to align goals and create long\-term commercial value
* Cultivate a high\-performing team: Drive engagement and retention through performance management, professional development, and recognition programs


**Qualifications**
**What It Takes to Make the Stay**
 At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member
   

  

 A passion for spreading the light and warmth of
 **Hospitality** 
 . Acting with
 **Integrity** 
 and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through
 **Leadership** 
 . A belief that
 **Teamwork** 
 drives the best outcomes. A sense of
 **Ownership** 
 and accountability. And a focus on the
 **Now** 
 , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
   

  

**About Us**
**Join an Award\-Winning Workplace Culture**
 At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.
   

  

 Our award\-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world\-class brands , and a company\-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.
   

  

 Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.
   

  

 Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

data.jd_text:
**If you’re looking to unlock new job opportunities, take a look at the possibilities right on your doorstep here at HSBC.**
 HSBC Corporate Banking provides international financial services solutions that support businesses ranging from large corporates to mid\-market enterprises in a variety of industry sectors all over the world. Leveraging the strength, scope and expertise of our global product network, Corporate Banking is positioned as an essential partner to large and mid\-market enterprises seeking to maximise their potential internationally, offering streamlined business access to HSBC’s international network and broad range of market leading banking products and services.
   

  

**The Role**
 HSBC’s Corporate \& Institutional Banking (CIB) – International Mid\-Market (IMM) team in Qatar is looking for a high\-performing Relationship Director to manage and grow a portfolio of internationally minded Corporates and with revenues from $100m to over $2bn.
   

  

 You’ll act as a trusted advisor to clients with cross\-border ambitions, connecting them to HSBC’s international network and full suite of corporate banking solutions.
   

  

**In This Role You’ll Be Responsible For**
* Growing and deepening client relationships
+ Expand existing IMM relationships and originate new\-to\-bank opportunities aligned to HSBC’s international strategy.

* Be a strategic advisor
+ Provide consultative insights to help clients navigate complex cross\-border and global market dynamics.

* Own the client experience
+ Deliver best\-in\-class service and act as a senior escalation point for client needs.

* Drive sustainable revenue growth
+ Partner with product specialists (e.g., Treasury \& Cash Management, Trade, FX, Lending/Debt solutions) and colleagues across HSBC’s global network to increase HSBC’s share of the client’s global wallet.

* Lead credit and risk discipline
+ Credit assessment, deal structuring, approvals support, and ongoing monitoring across the portfolio.

* Manage operational, regulatory and financial crime risk
+ Ensure adherence to internal controls, policies, and external regulations.

* Build networks and market profile
+ Strengthen internal connectivity and enhance HSBC’s presence in the local business community and with professional intermediaries.


**What You’ll Need (minimum Requirements)**
* Bachelor’s degree is required to obtain a work permit.
* 10\+ years’ experience in Corporate/Commercial Banking or Financial Services with relationship management accountability.
* Strong knowledge of corporate banking products: cash management, trade, FX, lending/structured solutions.
* Solid credit and lending experience, including complex facilities and risk assessment.
* Strong stakeholder management and ability to collaborate across product and risk teams.
* Exceptional communication and influencing skills.
* Client\-centric mindset, commercial acumen, and ability to deliver in a fast\-moving environment.


 For further details and application information please visit our careers site.
   

  

 We support our staff to adopt flexible and alternative ways of working where possible, including working from home and different hours subject to approvals.
   

  

 HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working, and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Chief Investment Officer (Confidential)
 



**Location:** 
 Doha, Qatar
 



  





 The Opportunity
 



 We are conducting a confidential search for an exceptional Chief Investment Officer to lead the investment strategy, investment platform, product innovation, and capital markets activities of a rapidly growing investment business.
 



  





 This is not a traditional portfolio management role.
 



 The successful candidate will combine institutional investment expertise with commercial leadership, bringing the ability to design investment products, originate investment opportunities, raise institutional capital, and build scalable investment platforms serving sovereign wealth funds, institutional investors, family offices and high\-net\-worth clients.
 



 The CIO will play a central role in shaping the firm's future investment strategy while partnering closely with Executive Management and the Board to drive long\-term growth.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 


* Investment Strategy \& Portfolio Leadership
* Develop and execute the firm's investment strategy across public and private markets.
* Lead strategic asset allocation and portfolio construction across multiple asset classes.
* Provide investment recommendations to Executive Management, Investment Committee and Board.



  





 Develop investment policies, governance frameworks and portfolio risk management processes.
 



 Monitor macroeconomic developments, capital markets and emerging investment opportunities globally.
 



  





 Investment Platform \& Product Development
 



 Lead the development, structuring and launch of institutional investment products.
 



 Design and oversee:
 


* Listed investment funds
* Private investment funds
* Alternative investment funds
* SMAs
* Co\-investment platforms
* Structured products
* Bespoke institutional mandates
* Work closely with Legal, Compliance, Operations, Finance and Distribution to successfully commercialize investment solutions.
* Develop differentiated investment propositions for institutional investors, sovereign wealth funds, pension funds, insurers, family offices and UHNW clients.
* Partner with distribution teams to support fundraising initiatives, investor presentations and product positioning.



  





 Investment Origination \& Transaction Execution
 



 Lead the sourcing and execution of investment opportunities across multiple asset classes
 



  





 Oversee:
 


* Financial modelling
* Valuation
* Commercial analysis
* Due diligence
* Investment Committee papers
* Transaction structuring
* Negotiations
* Execution



  





 Coordinate external advisors including investment banks, legal counsel, consultants and placement agents.
 



  





 Institutional Capital \& Commercial Leadership
 



 Develop long\-term relationships with:
 


* Sovereign Wealth Funds
* Pension Funds
* Insurance Companies
* Family Offices
* Institutional Asset Managers
* Banks
* Development Finance Institutions
* Strategic Partners



  





 Support capital raising initiatives through strong institutional engagement.
 



 Represent the firm with investors, regulators and industry stakeholders.
 



 Identify strategic partnerships and new business opportunities that strengthen the investment platform.
 



  





 Leadership
 


* Build and lead a high\-performing investment organization.
* Develop investment professionals across research, portfolio management, product development and investment execution.
* Promote a culture of disciplined investment decision\-making, innovation, collaboration and commercial excellence.
* Serve as the principal investment adviser to Executive Management and the Board.



  





 Candidate Profile
 



 The successful candidate will demonstrate experience across most of the following areas:
 



 Investment Leadership
 


* Leading multi\-asset investment strategies
* Strategic and tactical asset allocation
* Investment Committee leadership
* Portfolio construction
* Investment governance
* Risk management



  





 Listed Funds
 


* Demonstrated experience managing, overseeing or launching listed investment funds or publicly traded investment vehicles.
* Investment Product Development
* Hands\-on experience designing, structuring and launching investment products including institutional funds, alternative investment vehicles, SMAs, structured products or bespoke client mandates.



  





 Asset Class Experience
 



 Strong experience across several of the following:
 


* Public Equities
* Fixed Income
* Private Equity
* Private Credit
* Infrastructure

**About QNB**
 Established in 1964 as the country’s first Qatari\-owned commercial bank, QNB Group has steadily grown to become the largest bank in the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region.
   

  

 QNB Group’s presence through its subsidiaries and associate companies extends to more than 31 countries across three continents providing a comprehensive range of advanced products and services. The total number of employees is more than 28,000 serving up to 20 million customers operating through 1,000 locations, with an ATM network of 4,300 machines.
   

  

 QNB has maintained its position as one of the highest rated regional banks from leading credit rating agencies including Standard \& Poor’s (A), Moody’s (Aa3\) and Fitch (A\+). The Bank has also been the recipient of many awards from leading international specialised financial publications.
   

  

 Based on the Group’s consistent strong financial performance and its expanding international presence, QNB currently ranks as the most valuable bank brand in the Middle East and Africa, according to Brand Finance Magazine.
   

  

 QNB Group has an active community support program and sponsors various social, educational and sporting events.
   

  

**Job Purpose Summary**
 The incumbent will be part of senior leadership responsible for independently leading and managing the Strategy Development team under Strategy and Business development department. Responsibilities include owning, leading, managing and executing the portfolio of strategy assignments for group wide business/ support divisions or countries across QNB Group’s international network with minimal supervision. These would be managing the full portfolio of strategy assignments such as full\-scale regional strategies, individual country strategies (for all applicable lines of business) or business unit strategies. The incumbent will also be responsible to support any specific requests and mandates coming from the Executive Management, including GCEO interviews, Board presentations and public documents.
   

  

**Essential Duties \& Responsibilities By Dimensions**
* Shareholder \& Financial:
* Responsible for managing the portfolio of Group\-wide strategy assignments (domestic \& international)
* Develop metrics and key performance indicators (KPIs) for performance measurement and monitoring purposes related to assigned strategy and implementation projects on a periodic basis
* Own and lead the development as well as review of the financial plan for strategy assignments
* Assist the SEVP and EVP in identifying, analyzing and monitoring issues that impact or could affect the profitability, growth and productivity of the organization (domestic \& international).
* Implements KPI’s and best practices for Senior Vice President, Strategy Development.
* Act within the limits of the powers delegated to the incumbent and delegate authority to the respective staff and monitor exercise of the same.

**Job Description – YooPlatform Head (Product \& Growth)** 




**Overview** 




 YooPlatform is Flowciti’s software suite powering service validation, access, and entitlements for banks, real estate, and retail. It includes modules like YooValidate, YooPass, YooAccess, and YooManage — delivering integrated benefits, access control, and tokenized service entitlements.

 **Product \& Growth Head** 
 of YooPlatform. This role sits at the intersection of commercial strategy, client success, and platform performance — with full ownership over growth, profitability, and cross\-functional coordination.
 



**Note:** 
 Product management — including backlog, feature specs, sprint delivery, and QA — is owned by
 **Rokket** 
 . This role does
 **not** 
 manage developers or build features directly, but it does
 **own the roadmap, prioritization, and commercial packaging.** 




  





  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Business Ownership** 



* Own YooPlatform’s commercial strategy, roadmap priorities, and deployment performance.
* Define what success looks like for each vertical (e.g., banking, real estate, benefits), and package the modules accordingly.
* Lead pricing strategy and client proposals with support from Finance and senior management.



**Growth \& Client Success** 



* Identify and close new business opportunities.
* Lead product demos, proposals, and commercial onboarding of clients.
* Ensure successful deployments and account expansion across key clients (e.g., banks, real estate developers, benefit aggregators).
* Build long\-term client relationships and be their main strategic contact.



**P\&L Accountability** 



* Responsible for YooPlatform’s profitability — including revenue growth, delivery costs, and unit economics per client/module.
* Work with Finance to track contribution margin, delivery efficiency, and commercial viability of new features or pricing models.
* Make trade\-offs based on financial and strategic impact — not just client requests.



**Internal Coordination** 



* Act as the main bridge between YooPlatform business and Rokket (product development), Viritti (client support), and the Group (finance, strategy).
* Coordinate with Rokket’s product manager to translate business cases into product specs — without managing the delivery team.



  





  





**You’ll Succeed If You Are…** 



* A former
 **founder** 
 , early\-stage
 **operator** 
 , or
 **product/growth leader** 
 in a B2B tech or SaaS business.
* Strong in
 **commercial judgment** 
 , client\-facing delivery, and product positioning.
* Comfortable with
 **P\&L thinking** 
 and making prioritization decisions that balance client value with business health.
* A natural cross\-functional leader who can speak both the language of clients and tech teams.



  





  





**Working Model** 



* Reports to:
 **Group Managing Director. Future reporting lines may evolve based on leadership structure.**
* Location:
 **Bahrain**
* Works closely with:
 **Rokket GM, Rokket Product Manager, Viritti team**



  





  





**What You’re Not Expected to Do** 



* Manage developers, write specs, or run sprints.
* Own QA or release processes — this sits with Rokket.
* Handle accounting, but you will be held accountable for profitability and commercial outcomes.

talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in over 70\+ countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.
   

  

 Since launching in Kuwait in 2004, talabat, the leading on\-demand food and Q\-commerce app for everyday deliveries, has been offering convenience and reliability to its customers. talabat’s local roots run deep, offering a real understanding of the needs of the communities we serve in eight countries across the region.
   

  

 We harness innovative technology and knowledge to simplify everyday life for our customers, optimize operations for our restaurants and local shops, and provide our riders with reliable earning opportunities daily.
   

  

 At talabat, we foster an innovative environment where our talabaty employees can strive to create a positive impact across the region through the use of our platform.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
 Senior Specialist, Special Projects \& Performance role is part of the regional Chief Business Officer organizational structure. The role involves analyzing talabat’s business performance, preparing data\-driven insights for senior management, conducting in\-depth market analyses to unlock topline and bottom\-line opportunities, leading special projects, and ensuring talabat is on track to hit PnL targets.
   

  

**What’s On Your Plate?**
**Reporting Business Performance**
 This role will help drive strategic projects and generate insights for the business. The individual will be working very closely with senior management and be responsible for four main scopes:
   

  

* Analyze Data: Dive into talabat’s performance metrics, identifying key trends, anomalies, and areas for improvement.
* Prepare Reports: Create comprehensive and insightful reports for senior management, highlighting key drivers of change and actionable insights.
* Communicate Findings: Present findings in a clear and concise manner, often translating complex data into understandable recommendations for decision\-makers.


**Conducting Analytical Deep Dives**
* Country\-Specific Analysis: Perform detailed analyses of different talabat markets, focusing on identifying turnaround opportunities, growth and profitability areas.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work with various departments to understand and address cross\-functional issues impacting business performance.

**Role Summary** 




  





 The Microwave Project Manager is responsible for the end\-to\-end planning, execution, and delivery of microwave transmission and backhaul network projects within telecom environments. The role ensures the successful deployment of point\-to\-point and point\-to\-multipoint microwave links, IP/MPLS backhaul integration, and transmission network upgrades, while maintaining high standards of quality, safety, regulatory compliance, and timely delivery.
 



 The role requires strong coordination across RF planning, transmission engineering, civil works, and field deployment teams, as well as effective management of vendors, subcontractors, and equipment suppliers.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead the end\-to\-end delivery of microwave transmission and backhaul network projects.
* Define project scope, schedules, budgets, resource plans, and delivery milestones.
* Manage deployment of microwave infrastructure including:



 Point\-to\-point microwave links
 



 Point\-to\-multipoint systems
 



 IP/MPLS backhaul integration
 



 Transmission network upgrades and capacity expansions
 


* Coordinate closely with RF planning, transmission engineering, civil works, and field implementation teams.
* Oversee site acquisition activities, technical site surveys, and line\-of\-sight (LOS) analysis.
* Manage tower infrastructure works including installation, alignment, and commissioning of antennas and microwave equipment.
* Ensure seamless integration of microwave backhaul with core and access network elements.
* Monitor and control project risks, issues, dependencies, and performance metrics.
* Manage relationships with vendors, subcontractors, and equipment suppliers to ensure quality and compliance.
* Ensure adherence to regulatory requirements, including spectrum licensing and telecom authority approvals.
* Track project progress and provide accurate status reports to internal stakeholders and clients.
* Ensure delivery within agreed timelines, budget constraints, and quality standards.



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Proven experience in telecom project management, with strong focus on microwave transmission or backhaul networks.
* Solid understanding of microwave technologies, transmission systems, and telecom network architecture.
* Project management certification such as PMP or PRINCE2 is preferred.



  





**Key Skills** 



* Microwave transmission systems (SDH, IP\-based microwave, hybrid networks)
* RF planning, link budgeting, and path analysis
* Project planning, scheduling, and execution control
* Vendor, subcontractor, and stakeholder management
* Risk, issue, and change management
* Budgeting, cost control, and financial tracking
* Strong leadership, communication, and coordination skills



  





**Work Environment** 



* Combination of office\-based project planning and field/site execution activities
* Regular coordination with telecom operators, infrastructure providers, and regulatory bodies
* Frequent site visits, including remote and outdoor locations as required

data.jd_text:
**The kind of PM we're looking for**
 You've got 2\-4 years under your belt at an independent pharma or healthcare agency, enough to know how MLR works, what a tight timeline actually means, and how to keep five things moving without losing the thread on any of them. You're not a coordinator looking to level up, and you're not a senior PM who needs to own the strategy. You're in that sweet spot where execution is your superpower and you genuinely love it.
   

  

 You thrive when the environment is lean, the team is direct, and no one's waiting on three layers of approval to make a call. If you've come from a large networked agency, this might feel different, in a good way, if you've been craving it.
   

  

**What you'll do**
* Plan and execute pharma marketing projects across cross\-functional teams, keeping everything moving from kickoff through delivery
* Build and own project timelines, tracking milestones, dependencies, and risks before they become problems
* Coordinate internal teams across creative, account, strategy, and analytics, you're the connective tissue
* Run status meetings, kickoffs, and checkpoints that are tight, useful, and don't waste anyone's time
* Maintain project documentation, status reports, and workflow trackers with obsessive consistency
* Monitor budget burn and flag scope shifts early, you catch things before they become conversations
* Keep projects inside established workflows and escalate when something's about to go sideways


**What This Role Is Not**
 This is not a budget ownership role. It's not scope negotiation or team management. And if your planning horizon is quarters rather than days, this won't be the right fit. This role is about execution, doing it well, doing it fast, and doing it with the kind of calm that steadies the people around you.
   

  

**What You Bring**
* 2\-4 years of project management or coordination experience inside a pharma or healthcare independent agency environment
* Hands\-on familiarity with Ziflow and Slack; comfort picking up new tools quickly
* The organizational instincts to track what others miss without being asked
* A communication style that keeps teams aligned, direct, clear, no noise
* A solutions\-first mindset: you don't just flag problems, you walk in with options
* Energy for execution, you're wired for the day\-to\-day, not the 30,000\-foot view


**Compensation \& Benefits**
* $91,000 to $110,000 USD
* Full medical and dental benefits
* 15 days vacation plus one additional day per year of service, unlimited flex time
* $500 home office stipend at time of hire
* Our hiring package is ever\-evolving to meet the needs of our team


**The environment**
 P10 is remote\-first, always has been. The team moves fast, the clients are direct, and the work is real. You'll report to our Project Director, and work inside a structure that's flat enough that your contributions are visible and your voice is heard.
   

  

 If you've been looking for a place where independent thinking is rewarded and nobody's waiting on a committee to make a call, this is it.
   

  

 Interested in working with us? Apply online today.
   

  

**Not an agency\***
 The layer\-laden teams. The prehistoric processes. The impersonal, ego\-driven dog\-and\-pony shows. Take what you think you know about agencies and burn it. P10 was born of the idea that if something isn’t working, or could work better, change it. And that’s exactly what we did. We know that what we’re not makes us who we are. And we’re not just another agency. We are people driven by a palpable passion and purpose, felt by our clients from the very first conversation.
   

  

 P10 brings together a team of diverse, remote\-only seasoned professionals to deliver exceptional value for our clients. Dare to do something different \- join us.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.jd_text:
**ROLE PURPOSE:** 
 The Project Commercial Director is the senior commercial within Company’s Development Division, responsible for the end\-to\-end commercial stewardship of Company’s large\-scale coastal mixed\-use masterplan development and all associated packages. The role integrates four core disciplines — Commercial Management, Procurement Management, Cost Management, and Contract Management — to protect Company’s financial interests, optimise value delivery, and ensure full contractual compliance across all project phases, from pre\-contract commercial strategy through to final account settlement. The incumbent serves as the primary commercial interface with contractors, the PMC, institutional stakeholders, and provides authoritative commercial advisory to the Chief Development Officer and Development Division leadership on all matters affecting project cost, risk, and financial performance.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:** 



* Lead the commercial strategy for all development packages, including construction, infrastructure, and specialist consultant appointments, ensuring alignment with Company’s programme and financial objectives.
* Establish, maintain, and enforce a commercial governance framework covering reporting protocols, risk registers, change control procedures, and early warning mechanisms across all active contracts.
* Drive value engineering and commercial optimisation initiatives across the tender, award, and execution phases to protect budget integrity without compromising design or delivery quality.
* Provide authoritative commercial advisory to the CDO leadership on all matters affecting project cost, contractual risk, and financial return, including shareholder submissions.
* Serve as Company’s senior commercial interface with stakeholders, ensuring all commercial positions are accurate, defensible, and aligned with the approved business case.



**B. Procurement Management** 



* Support the full procurement lifecycle from strategy definition through to Letter of Award (LOA), covering pre\-qualification, RFP issuance, commercial evaluation, BAFO/LAFO, approval, and contract execution.
* Develop, maintain, and monitor procurement programmes across all active and pipeline packages, ensuring LOA milestones are achieved in alignment with the Integrated Master Schedule.
* Oversee the appointment and ongoing performance management of the Integrated PMC, Cost Consultant, and other strategic sub\-consultants, ensuring deliverables are contractually defined and KPIs are actively monitored.



**C. Contract Management** 



* Administer FIDIC\-based contracts (Red, Yellow, and/or Silver Book) across all construction and consultancy appointments, ensuring full compliance with contractual obligations, notice requirements, and dispute resolution provisions.
* Establish and enforce contract management protocols including Early Warning Notices, Engineer’s Instructions, Compensation Events, and Variation Order management, maintained with complete audit\-trail documentation.
* Manage contractor claims and dispute resolution processes, including entitlement assessment, time impact analysis, and negotiation, with the objective of achieving fair and timely resolution without recourse to formal arbitration.
* Monitor contractual milestone compliance, performance KPIs, and liquidated damages provisions; advise COMPANY leadership on entitlement to withhold or apply agreed contractual remedies.
* Lead contract close\-out processes and final account negotiations, ensuring all accounts are settled within agreed timeframes and in accordance with the terms of each contract.



**D. Cost Management** 



* Own the project cost management framework from budget establishment through to final account, covering Approved Cost Baseline, Estimated Cost at Completion (ERC), and Actual Cost reporting aligned to COMPANY financial reporting cycles.
* Direct the Cost Consultant in preparation and maintenance of detailed Cost Plans, Bills of Quantities, benchmarking analyses, and independent cost assessments to validate contractor pricing and claims.
* Establish and maintain project\-level cash flow forecasts, cost\-to\-complete models, and contingency management registers, with monthly performance reporting to the CDO and Finance Division.
* Report cost performance (Budget vs. Committed vs. Forecast vs. Actual) to senior leadership, highlighting trends, variances, risks, and recommended corrective actions in a clear, decision\-ready format.
* Identify, quantify, and manage cost risks, scope changes, and variation impacts; maintain a real\-time Change Management Register tracking all approved and pending cost movements against the baseline.



**E. Team \& Stakeholder Leadership** 



* Lead, manage, and develop the Commercial Management team within the Development Division, establishing clear accountability structures, performance targets, and professional development pathways.
* Build team capacity and commercial capability through structured mentoring, delegation, and knowledge transfer.
* Maintain effective working relationships across Company’s four\-party project ecosystem (Contractor, PMC, TSC, and Employer\-side Delivery team), ensuring commercial matters are managed with professionalism, transparency, and appropriate confidentiality.



  





**Minimum Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Quantity Surveying, Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a closely related built environment discipline.
* Master’s degree in Construction Law, Commercial Management, Project Management, or Business Administration is preferred.



  





**Professional Certifications:** 



* MRICS (Member of the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors) — strongly preferred.
* MCIPS (Member of the Chartered Institute of Procurement \& Supply) — desirable.
* PMP (Project Management Professional) or PRINCE2 Practitioner — desirable.



  





**Years of Experience:** 



* Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in commercial management, cost management, procurement, and contract administration on large\-scale real estate, infrastructure, or mixed\-use development projects, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership or director\-level role.

data.jd_text:
**Company Description**
  

**Work with Us. Change the World.**
  

 At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.
   

  

 There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.
   

  

 We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.
   

  

**Job Description**
  

**Job Summary**
  

 We are seeking a
 **Senior Marine Ecologist** 
 to join our Environment team in AECOM Bahrain’s Office.
   

  

 The role will involve leading and delivering marine EIAs and technical advisory services for coastal and offshore development projects, including marine environmental surveys. You’ll apply your strong academic background in marine biology to deliver practical, client\-focused solutions, ensuring regulatory compliance and promoting sustainable marine management.
   

  

 This role offers the opportunity to combine scientific expertise with technical leadership and delivery, driving coastal and marine ecosystem resilience in one of the world’s most dynamic marine environments.
   

  

**Duties \& Responsibilities**
* **Leadership** 
 : Lead project team in delivering coastal and marine projects across a range of sectors, including ports, coastal utilities, reclamation, dredging, subsea infrastructure and coastal resilience projects.
* **Project delivery** 
 : Scope, plan and deliver multidisciplinary marine environmental environmental assessments and monitoring projects on time and within budget; manage risk and schedule.
* **Technical delivery** 
 : Lead all technical aspects of marine EIA delivery, including client and subconsultant engagement, whilst ensuring regulatory compliance and high\-quality outputs, including the preparation of high\-quality deliverables (e.g. EIAs, ESIAs, EMPs, EMMPs and DMMPs).
* **Agency coordination** 
 : Engage with local regulatory bodies and stakeholders, or regional equivalents, as required.
* **Baseline and monitoring surveys** 
 : Design, plan and execute marine environmental surveys to identify and assess the status of benthic habitats and associated fauna and flora, fisheries, marine megafauna, seabirds, and water and sediment quality.
* **Business development** 
 : Lead proposals, including technical approaches. Strengthen client relationships and expand marine ecology\-related market opportunities.
* **Cross\-disciplinary coordination** 
 : Integrate marine ecological insights with a strong theoretical understanding of coastal modelling and marine engineering disciplines, including ports, coastal utilities (e.g. ROPs and WWTPs), reclamation, dredging, subsea infrastructure and coastal resilience.
* **Nature\-based solutions** 
 : Advance ecological restoration approaches such as living shorelines, reef, seagrass and mangrove restoration, and climate resilience strategies for coastal and marine habitats.
* **Mentorship** 
 : Mentor junior scientists, review technical contributions and foster professional growth.
* **Safety culture** 
 : Promote strong safety practices for vessel operations, diving and working in remote marine environments.
  


**Person Specification (Personality Attributes)**
  

 We are seeking a Senior Marine Ecologist with the personal qualities to lead and inspire.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will bring a resilient mindset and a high level of commitment, ensuring projects are delivered to the highest technical standard achievable with reliability and focus. They will demonstrate a confident yet approachable leadership presence, fostering a collaborative spirit across multidisciplinary teams. Adaptability is key, as changing circumstances demand flexibility, while a practical problem\-solving orientation keeps work moving forward.
   

  

 Strong communication skills and a clear sense of integrity underpin their approach, alongside curiosity and innovation that drive fresh ideas. Calm under pressure, they bring steady judgment and sound decision\-making to every challenge.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* BSc (Hons.) in Marine Biology or closely\-related discipline; MSc and/or PhD much preferred.
* Minimum PADI ‘Rescue Diver’ or UK HSE ‘SCUBA’ diving qualification and 2\+ years of professional scientific diving experience.
* Possession of a valid driving license.
  


**Specific skills required**
* 8\+ years of marine environmental consultancy experience in the field of EIA and Permitting. Proven track record in leading and delivering multidisciplinary EIAs, ESIAs and permitting for environmental projects across a range of marine sectors.
* Familiarity and proven experience with local and regional environmental regulatory framework(s) preferred.
* Familiarity and experience with lenders’ requirements, for example, IFC Environmental and Social Performance Standards (notably PS6 \- Biodiversity and Sustainability) preferred.
* Very strong technical writing skills for reporting and permit\-related documentation; highly adept at stakeholder engagement and agency coordination.
* Competent in the planning and delivery of field surveys, including underwater remote video (DDV, ROV, BRUVS), SCUBA diver\-based survey techniques, water and sediment sampling, and benthic infauna and plankton sample collection.
* Familiarity and basic aptitude with GIS (ArcGIS, QGIS) and PRIMER statistical software would be an asset.
* Sound knowledge in the use and application of AI in the field of environmental assessment and project delivery would be an asset.
  


**Additional Information**
  

 Authorised to work in Bahrain and previous registration with SCE preferred.
   

  

*At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously.* 
***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***
  

**About AECOM**
  

 AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD\&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well\-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.
   

  

 AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public\- and private\-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16\.1 billion in fiscal year 2025\. Learn more at aecom.com.
   

  

**What makes AECOM a great place to work**
  

 You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects \- both in your local community and on a global scale \- that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting\-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award\-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community \- where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

data.jd_text:
**Company Description**
 Mantis is a leading, conservation\-focused hotel group with eco\-lodges, waterways, and curated eco\-resorts located all over the world. Sustainable travellers have been enjoying eco\-tourism, safaris, and adventure travel with Mantis since 2000\. Rooted in conservation, Mantis pursues sustainable business practices and develops tourism products that are respectful of the environment and communities in which they operate. Whether small and intimate or vast and complex, on a sweeping African plain, beach\-side escap,e or bustling city, each is an exceptional place for guests to find themselves. While uniquely different in the experiences they offer, all are linked through a collective obsession to be extraordinary, to be rare in a world that mass\-produces sameness.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As the Sales and Marketing Director, you will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, expanding our customer base, and maintaining strong relationships with key clients and stakeholders. You will oversee the creation and implementation of marketing campaigns, manage the marketing budget, and ensure effective resource allocation. Your leadership will be pivotal in mentoring and motivating the sales and marketing team, setting clear objectives, and fostering a collaborative and results\-driven environment.
   

  

**What Is In It For You**
* Engage in conservation efforts and help preserve wildlife.
* Enjoy sustainable adventures with exclusive rewards.
* Celebrate locality and heritage in a vibrant community.
* Advance your career with global development opportunities.
* Drive change through impactful social initiatives.
* Collaborate with a passionate, innovative team.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Sales Strategy and Execution: Develop and implement comprehensive sales strategies to achieve revenue targets, identify new business opportunities to expand the customer base, and maintain strong relationships with key clients and stakeholders. Additionally, monitor market trends and competitor activities to adjust strategies accordingly.
* Marketing and Branding: Oversee the creation and execution of marketing campaigns to promote the resort, enhance the brand's visibility and reputation through various channels, including social media, email marketing, and partnerships, and develop and manage the marketing budget, ensuring effective allocation of resources.
* Team Leadership: Lead and mentor the sales and marketing team, fostering a collaborative and results\-driven environment, set clear objectives and performance metrics for the team, and conduct regular performance reviews while providing ongoing training and development.
* Customer Relationship Management: Ensure exceptional customer service and satisfaction at all touchpoints, implement and manage CRM systems to track customer interactions and feedback, and develop strategies to enhance guest loyalty and repeat business
* Event Management: Coordinate and oversee events, conferences, and promotions at the resort, and collaborate with other departments to ensure successful execution of events.
* Reporting and Analysis: Prepare regular reports on sales and marketing performance, including analysis of key metrics, present findings and recommendations to senior management, and use data\-driven insights to refine strategies and improve outcomes.


**Qualifications**
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business Administration, or related field (master’s preferred).
* Experience: Minimum 7 years in hospitality industry sales and marketing, with a demonstrated track record of achieving sales targets and driving revenue growth.
* Leadership: Strong leadership and team management skills, with experience in leading and motivating cross\-functional teams.
* Communication: Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities, adept at building and maintaining relationships with key stakeholders.
* Technical Skills: Proficient in digital marketing strategies, CRM software, and analytics tools to optimize marketing campaigns and customer engagement.
* Strategic Thinking: Ability to think strategically and execute methodically, leveraging data\-driven insights to refine strategies and enhance business outcomes.


 Additional Information
   

  

**Our commitment to Diversity \& Inclusion:** 
 We are an inclusive company and our ambition is to attract, recruit and promote diverse talent.
   

  

**Why work for Accor?** 
 We are far more than a worldwide leader. We welcome you as you are and you can find a job and brand that matches your personality. We support you to grow and learn every day, making sure that work brings purpose to your life, so that during your journey with us, you can continue to explore Accor’s limitless possibilities.
   

  

 By joining Accor, every chapter of your story is yours to write and together we can imagine tomorrow's hospitality. Discover the life that awaits you at Accor, visit https://careers.accor.com/
   

  

**About Mantis Collection:**

Mantis grew from Adrian’s vision to restore and rewild degraded farmland which he developed into a widely\-acclaimed Private Game Reserve.
